catalogName: Project L.O.O.T. Universal D&D 5e Item & Provision Catalog

items.Properties / Flavor: A gracefully curved, single-edged blade engineered for rapid draw cuts and fluid slashing motions. Favored by nimble skirmishers and desert riders, it moves with effortless finesse.
A double-edged thrusting blade measuring two feet in length with a simple crossguard. Nimble rogues and dual-wielding duelists prize its light balance and rapid striking speed.
A slender rapier or longsword crafted with an aerodynamic crossguard and buoyant alchemical alloys. Speaking its command word releases the weapon to hover and fight independently for several rounds.
A sinister notched blade blackened with necrotic ichor that prevents natural healing. Wounds inflicted by this weapon continue to bleed profusely every round until treated with magical medicine.
A fearsome two-handed blade forged from red dragon teeth that leaves a trail of embers with every swing. It deals extra fire damage on hit and unleashes a cone of dragon breath when commanded.
A paradoxically forged blade of volcanic obsidian infused with permanent glacial permafrost rime. Striking an opponent inflicts both searing fire and biting cold damage simultaneously.

An ancestral double-ended martial weapon favored by the Valenar elves featuring curved steel scythe-blades on both tips. A trained martial artist wields it in continuous spinning arcs to deliver lightning-fast bonus strikes.
A greatsword whose crossguard is fashioned from the fossilized talons of an ancient blue dragon. It deals extra slashing damage against true dragons and protects the wielder from breath attacks.

An exquisitely curved silver blade balanced so lightly that it seems to slice before you swing. It functions as a +2 magical weapon and grants an additional melee attack as a bonus action every round.

A blade sharpened to a molecular monomolecular edge that slices through matter with effortless perfection. It maximizes damage dice against objects and can sever limbs from opposing combatants on critical hits.
A heavy two-handed sword whose broad cutting edges are bonded with an enduring silver alloy. It delivers devastating cleaving strokes that burn the corrupt flesh of werewolves and night hags.
A slender dueling sword featuring a silver-plated thrusting tip and an ornate swept-hilt basket. It allows nimble fencing masters to pierce supernatural horrors with precise silver strikes.
A double-edged short blade layered with pure silver to combat creatures vulnerable to sacred metals. It moves swiftly in off-hand fighting, ensuring reliable damage against fiends and shapeshifters.

A rapier whose blade is composed of liquid mercury held in rigid aerodynamic tension by magnetic magic. It bends around enemy shields to strike exposed vulnerabilities, delivering armor-piercing critical strikes.
A needle-thin dueling sword forged from glacial ice-steel that leaves frost rime on the floor. Thrusting into a foe chills their muscles, slowing their movement and imposing cold damage.
A curved slashing blade carved from the serrated tooth of a territorial mountain drake. It strikes with swift draconic fury, dealing bonus fire damage and cleaving through hides.
A slender, lightweight piercing blade fitted with an oversized circular basket hilt for small hands. It balances with agile precision, allowing nimble duelists to parry heavy weapons effortlessly.

This +1 rapier serves as a bardic spellcasting focus and adds your Charisma modifier to weapon damage rolls when you sing in battle. Slender silvery fuller grooves are tuned to whistle harmonic chords with every thrust.

This +1 shortsword deals an extra 1d6 cold damage and reduces the target's movement speed by ten feet until their next turn. Frost coats the razor edge of this pale steel blade, exhaling freezing mist into the air.

This +2 curved sword passes through mundane armor, dealing force damage instead of slashing and ignoring shield bonuses. Translucent cosmic glass sparkles with tiny distant stars along its razor-thin edge.
A polished brass shield embossed with the vigilant image of a wide-open watchful eye. Wielding it grants advantage on initiative rolls and wisdom perception checks.
A heavy kite shield inlaid with silver runes that hovers independently upon a spoken command word. It orbits the user to protect their flank, leaving both hands completely free for weapons.

A masterwork platinum-rimmed shield that hums with potent, woven abjuration counter-frequencies. It grants advantage on saving throws against all spells and forces spell attacks against you to have disadvantage.
A round steel shield emblazoned with a sculpted facial visage that shifts expression upon command. The wielder can change its grimace from jovial laughter to terrifying battle rage as a bonus action.

A concave bronze buckler that generates an invisible localized magnetic ward against missile fire. It grants extra armor class against ranged weapon attacks and pulls arrows aimed at nearby allies toward itself.
A kite shield polished to a golden mirror finish that radiates warm, welcoming sunlight in darkness. It sheds bright light that harms vampires and can flash brilliant illumination to blind foes.
A lightweight buckler fashioned from rare Xen'drik darkwood that provides the strength of forged steel. It imposes no armor penalties and floats effortlessly on water surfaces.
A round buckler sculpted with a roaring golden lion head with glowing topaz eyes. Bashing an enemy emits a deafening lion's roar that frightens nearby foes and knocks the target prone.
A convex pavise shield sculpted from the hardened skull plate of a mature subterranean landshark. Planting the shield into earth grants tremorsense and allows you to burrow ten feet under cover.

When a melee attacker misses you while you wield this shield, thorny tendrils lash out to deal 1d4 piercing damage to the aggressor. Living briars are tightly bound around an ironwood boss that never withers.

While holding this shield, you can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Ancient bronze plating is encrusted with luminescent barnacles and engraved with triton heraldry.

Holding this shield grants a +1 bonus to AC and gives you advantage on saving throws against psionic charms and telepathic spells. Faceted hexagonal crysteel panes are fitted into a seamless silver lattice frame.

This buckler allows the wielder to deliver a 1d6 piercing shield bash attack as a bonus action following a melee strike. A conical steel center spike juts out from a reinforced disc of hardened ironwood and bronze.

Attacking from hidden positions or behind stunned foes adds an extra 2d6 slashing damage with this brutal butcher blade. A thick wedge of carbon steel is ground with a meat-hook spur and wrapped in grease-stained cord.

Forged by the empire of Dhakaan, this +1 greatsword disrupts alien aberrant flesh and scores critical hits on an 19 or 20 against aberrations. Lustrous plum-colored byeshk metal is etched with goblinoid war honorifics.

A dark canvas backpack packed with a crowbar, hammer, pitons, hooded lantern, oil, rations, and tinderbox. It provides specialized tools tailored for subterranean infiltration, lock bypass, and urban thievery.

This golden peacock feather writes without ink and can animate simple illustrations on parchment for short theatrical demonstrations. The vibrant plume shifts color depending on the emotion behind the words.

An intricately patterned Calishite silk carpet that hovers effortlessly in mid-air upon a command word. It carries multiple passengers across the skies at swift speeds, controlled entirely by thought.
A lightweight wooden framework covered in waxed silk worn as a compact back harness. Unfurling the wings allows forest scouts to glide safely between giant canopy trees across forest valleys.
Theatrical garments tailored with bright silks, faux gems, and exaggerated flourishes. Actors and tricksters wear it on stage or to blend into carnival crowds during masquerades.

A specialized harness and saddle tailored for unusual mounts such as griffons, pegasi, or giant lizards. It incorporates security straps and wing-clearance channels for safe aerial or subterranean riding.

A tailored ensemble of black velvet robes and an unyielding faceless helm worn by Waterdeep's Masked Lords. It conceals your identity, vocal timbre, height, and thoughts from all physical and magical detection.
Soft leather slippers embroidered with swirling cloud motifs that lift your heels off the ground. They allow the wearer to dash as a bonus action and tread across water or mud without sinking.

You ignore difficult terrain caused by loose sand, mud, or snow, leaving no physical tracks behind as you travel. Braided palm reeds and desert leather form these lightweight, comfortable slip-on sandals.
Crafted from supple brown leather reinforced with flexible iron spring plates along the soles. They ensure the wearer moves at full speed regardless of encumbrance and triple jump distances.
A hauberk of interlocking steel rings worn between layers of quilted linen to absorb incoming cuts. It shields the torso comfortably and can be discreetly worn beneath everyday noble clothing.
A polished blue sapphire suspended from a delicate platinum chain that warms against the chest. The wearer is completely immune to contracting any natural or magical disease.
A tarnished bronze key whose teeth seem to constantly shift and realign when not observed. It has a five percent chance of unlocking any locked door it is inserted into before vanishing forever.
A heavy iron key sculpted with the hilt of a broadsword that hums with martial resolve. Inserting it into any locked portal opens a temporary gateway into an ancient extradimensional armory.
An exquisitely light hauberk woven from interlocking links of silvered elven mithral. Any character can wear this armor and gain its defensive benefits without possessing medium armor proficiency.
A key sculpted from shifting shadow-glass that alters its teeth to match any mechanical keyhole. It opens locks with advantage and allows the bearer to step through shadows behind locked doors.
Heavy steel shoulder guards embossed with charging ram heads that lock into place during combat. They reduce incoming physical damage from frontal attacks and allow you to bull-rush opponents.
Thick iron vambraces reinforced with riveted dwarven plates that lock across the forearms. Bracing your arms together creates a temporary shield of force that absorbs heavy physical missile volleys.

A hooded brass lantern that traps a peaceful, friendly spirit whose presence radiates soft emerald light. The spirit stabilizes dying companions within thirty feet and warns the party of nearby undead.
A sealed brass lantern that produces bright illumination without consuming oxygen or fuel. It provides reliable light inside airless vacuums and signals nearby spelljamming ships.
A clay flask containing one pint of refined lamp oil that burns cleanly for six hours in lamps. Splashing it across a creature and igniting it deals recurring fire damage for two rounds.
A sticky amber oil that burns hotter than ordinary lamp oil and cannot be extinguished by water. Hurling it coats targets in clinging chemical flames that burn until smothered.
A translucent azure glass bead that dissolves immediately when dropped into water or placed on the tongue. It instantly quenches the user's thirst as if they had consumed a full pint of fresh water.
An exquisite frosted glass bottle containing sweet, intoxicating floral perfume crafted from fey essences. Applying it grants advantage on Charisma checks against humanoid creatures for one hour.
A heavy brass flask sealed with lead and stamped with fiery sultan seals. Unstopping the bottle releases a fierce efreeti who may grant wishes, fight as an ally, or attack in a vengeful rage.

A tall framed glass mirror whose surface reflects misty corridors leading into extradimensional cells. Looking into the mirror can snare creatures inside one of twelve extradimensional prison chambers.
A thick, sticky secretion harvested from the tentacles of a subterranean carrion crawler. Making physical contact with the mucus paralyzes the victim completely for one minute.
A fine mineral powder ground from toxic underworld minerals that blows into eyes and lungs. Inhaling the dust results in immediate, agonizing blindness that lasts for one hour.
A silver hand mirror that reflects events that occurred in the room up to one century ago. Holding it reveals historical conversations, phantom footsteps, and clues left by previous occupants.
A glass phial filled with enchanted draconic blood that hangs from a braided gold chain. It grants a +2 bonus to sorcerer spell attack rolls and save DCs while restoring sorcery points during rests.
A faceted ruby phial pulsing with primordial arcane blood that crackles with raw metamagic power. It grants a +3 bonus to sorcerer spell DCs and attack rolls while replenishing five sorcery points.
A sparkling glass phial filled with shimmering multicolored fairy dust that floats upward when uncorked. Sprinkling it across a creature grants them a flying speed of thirty feet for one minute.

A sealed glass bottle containing a swirling cluster of genuine miniature constellations. Releasing a star illuminates entire cavern complexes with soft starlight or discharges a radiant nova in battle.
A hand mirror of polished silver that reflects the silvery voids and floating islands of the Astral Plane. Touching the glass allows you to project an illusory astral double to confuse attackers.
A glass flask filled with pressurized alchemical naphtha and white phosphor that ignites on air contact. It blankets a fifteen-foot area in clinging liquid flames that burn continuously.

Uncorking this glass vessel releases an illusion of a full-rigged warship that sails on command or stores cargo inside an extradimensional hold. A perfectly detailed miniature schooner bobs on real sea brine within.

Looking into this silver-framed hand mirror lets you cast mirror image at will and major image twice per dawn. Polished obsidian glass reflects whimsical faerie lights that dance behind the viewer's reflection.

Coating firearm ammunition in this consecrated ash doubles the damage dice of your next ranged firearm attack. A bone vial holds powdered marrow harvested from sanctified martyrs and preserved in holy oil.

Drinking this thick herbal draft immediately cures the frightened condition and halts encroaching psychological madness. Bitter milky fluid is stoppered in a thick medicinal glass bottle with an amber wax seal.
This graduated brass flask automatically mixes and measures alchemical reagents to brew simple potions twice as fast. Miniature dials and measuring gauges line the heat-resistant crystal beaker.
Drinking this airy vapor lets you walk on clouds and fog banks as if they were solid ground for one hour. Swirling white mist is trapped inside a rounded glass flask that feels weightless in hand.
A small wooden raven talisman carved from sacred rowan wood that trembles before imminent misfortune. It alerts the owner to nearby ambushes and allows the reroll of one critical saving throw daily.
A sharpened ash wood stake chased with spiraling alchemical silver wire along its point. Driving it into the heart of an incapacitated vampire paralyzes the monster permanently.

Wearing these raised wooden sandals allows you to walk across wet mud or river shallows without soaking your feet or slipping. Polished paulownia wood is elevated on sturdy wooden teeth and fastened with red fabric thongs.
A slender baton carved from lightweight pearwood that feels balanced for musical conducting. Waving it in the air produces orchestral melodies and choral notes that carry across three hundred feet.
A miniature wooden wardrobe charm hung upon a silver link chain around the neck. Whispering a command instantly changes your clothing and gear into another stored outfit suited for social deception.

Brass-rimmed leather goggles fitted with multiple adjustable magnifying lenses and tiny steam exhausts. They grant sharp vision through obscure smoke and provide microscopic magnification for delicate tinkering.
A complex brass screwdriver mechanism with shifting gears that transforms into any artisan tool. It increases artificer spell attack rolls and DCs, and grants temporary cantrip knowledge.
A precision brass multi-tool mechanism that smoothly transforms into any artisan tool you imagine. It provides a +2 bonus to artificer spell attack rolls and DCs while granting cantrip mastery.
A tiny brass bee construct fitted with delicate gossamer wings that buzzes with clockwork precision. It flies ahead to scout dangerous rooms, transmitting sensory feedback through tiny crystal eyes.
A precision long gun fitted with an adjustable brass telescopic sight and hair-trigger mechanism. It doubles normal firearm range and lands deadly armor-piercing shots from concealed positions.
A collapsible bronze tripod mounting a repeating crossbow fed by a rotary gear mechanism. Deployed on the floor, it tracks moving hostiles and fires defensive bolts automatically.
A heavy clay flowerpot inscribed with ancient sylvan runes along its circular rim. Planting a mundane shrub inside causes it to animate thirty days later as a loyal awakened shrub companion.
A rusty iron sphere measuring three inches across that unfurls into interlocking steel bands when hurled. It wraps around a large or smaller creature, restraining them securely until pried loose.

A dark iron weapon etched with infernal brimstone script that stays scorching hot to the touch. Any humanoid slain by this weapon has their soul instantly channeled directly into the River Styx as a lemure.
A massive iron kettle that simmers with nourishing beef and vegetable stew without requiring fire or meat. It produces enough hearty food daily to feed up to one hundred starving townsfolk.
A battered iron cooking pot etched with hag coven recipes that brews strange fey concoctions. It animates inanimate tin toys and brews potent polymorph broths when stirred with hemlock.
Ten heavy forged iron wedges designed to be driven into stonework or door frames with a mallet. Explorers jam them beneath dungeon doors to spike them shut against pursuing monsters.
A scepter of fluted brass or blackened iron capped with a cut gemstone that channels arcane formulas. It serves mages as an authoritative conduit for slinging offensive spell bolts.
A portable two-handed auger powered by an alchemical steam boiler fitted with diamond-tipped bits. It bores through solid granite, iron plates, and vault walls at remarkable speed.
An ancient U-shaped string instrument supported by two curved arms and a crossbar strung with gut. It produces celestial, resonant tones ideal for classical recitals and epic heroic odes.
A small brass handbell with an internal clapper that rings with a sharp, high-pitched tone. Travelers string it to tripwires to construct perimeter alarms around dark campsite perimeters.
A stick of white calcium carbonate that leaves distinct, powdery marks on stone walls and floors. Explorers use it to trace navigational arrows and mark cleared dungeon corridors.
A durable sheet crafted from cleaned, stretched, and scraped animal skin that resists tearing. Scribes use it for official charters, legal permits, and enduring historical maps.
A stick of colored resin wax that melts over a candle flame to seal letters and documents. Stamping a signet ring into the warm wax creates an authentic, tamper-evident personal seal.
A sealed flask containing volatile amber oil that ignites spontaneously when exposed to open air. Hurling the vessel causes it to shatter into clinging flames that burn victims continuously.
Harvested from the digestive sacs of giant subterranean grubs and sealed in reinforced ceramic jars. Splashing it across armor corrodes structural iron and inflicts lingering acid burns.
A pressurized metal canister filled with iron oxide and fine aluminum powder that ignites at extreme heat. It melts through iron portcullises and reinforced locks within seconds.
A dark resin that vaporizes immediately into acrid smoke upon contact with air or flame. Inhaling the noxious vapor inflicts recurring necrotic damage every round until properly healed.
A clear, volatile chemical liquid that vaporizes into a sweet-smelling inhalant gas. Creatures breathing in the cloud fall into a heavy magical sleep for eight hours.
A clear, tasteless alchemical draught that breaks down mental defenses against interrogation. An affected creature cannot knowingly tell a lie, compelled to answer questions truthfully.
A bubbling fiery-orange draught that feels scalding hot to the touch through its iron flask. Drinking it raises your Strength score to twenty-five, allowing you to lift stone boulders with ease.
A pressurized chitin gland harvested from an ankheg worker fitted with a bronze pump nozzle. It sprays a fifteen-foot cone of digestive acid that dissolves organic matter and burns armor.
A heavy crossbow bolt tipped with an alchemical fulminate warhead that detonates upon kinetic impact. Striking a target releases an explosive blast of fire that damages surrounding creatures.
A crossbow bolt tipped with a phosphorus-packed iron cage that bursts into white-hot chemical fire on impact. It ignites flammable clothing and structures, burning targets continuously.
A phial containing pure, uncoagulated blood harvested from an ancient vampire lord. Consuming it temporarily grants darkvision, supernatural strength, and predatory life-draining melee strikes.
A briarwood smoking pipe carved in the likeness of a roaring red dragon with ivory fangs. Exhaled smoke shapes itself into miniature figures of dragons, goblins, or beasts that harmlessly drift.
A twelve-inch green leaf that expands into a ten-foot buoyant floating lily pad when placed in water. It carries up to six humanoids across swamp waters and remains completely impervious to piranhas.
A full-face brass mask equipped with twin bubbler tubes and caustic neutralizing filters. It provides fifteen minutes of breathable air underwater or in dense smoke.

This faceted midnight stone can be used as a material component to permanently bind an elemental or fiend within its depths. Deep obsidian-blue facets swirl with trapped smoke and dark arcane binding sigils.
Consists of a hollow steel blowpipe, shaping jacks, shears, tweezers, and crucible tongs in a heat-resistant roll. It allows artisans to shape glass vials, beakers, lenses, and decorative flasks.

A sturdy traveler's robe adorned with numerous cloth patches depicting mundane tools and beasts. Detaching a patch manifests the illustrated item immediately, such as daggers, lanterns, mules, or rowboats.
A plush cloth doll stuffed with dried lavender that purrs softly when held in the arms. Hugging the doll soothes anxiety and grants advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
A loose-fitting outer garment tailored from wool or linen with wide draping sleeves and a cowl hood. Spellcasters, monks, and scholarly sages wear it comfortably over everyday tunic garments.
A forest-green traveling cloak woven from overlapping water-repellent leaves that rustle softly. Pulling the hood overhead unfolds a leafy canopy that keeps the wearer dry in torrential rainstorms.

A tan desert poncho woven from coarse camel hair treated with moisture-retaining alchemicals. It grants comfort in extreme desert heat and allows the wearer to move across loose sand dunes at full speed.
A dense woolen cloak layered with overlapping downy feathers from a giant forest owlbear. It grants advantage on perception checks relying on scent and sight while muffling footsteps in the wild.
A shimmering cloak woven from iridescent dove plumage that radiates soothing ambient light. It sheds soft white illumination, grants a feather fall reaction, and boosts charisma checks.
A heavy traveling cloak interwoven with thin, flexible lead foils that deflect eldritch radiation. It grants advantage on saving throws against contamination and reduces incoming necrotic damage.
A sixty-foot length of supple silk cord that moves like a serpent when command words are spoken. It fastens itself to knots, coils automatically, and snakes up sheer cliffs on command.
A silk streamer that ripples continuously as though buffeted by an invisible gale wind. Attuning to it grants permanent feather falling, gaseous form, and the power to summon wind walls.

A beautifully crafted squeeze-box adorned with cheerful silk ribbons that produces infectious dance tunes. It raises bard spell save DCs and allows the performer to cast Otto's irresistible dance once daily.

Arrows drawn from this featherweight quiver shed all weight in flight to grant advantage on ranged attack rolls made at long range. The quiver is woven from enchanted dandelion seeds and emerald velvet.
Opening this elegant parasol shades the holder in a refreshing ten-degree cool breeze and repels natural rain completely. Pale silk canopy is painted with cheerful sunbursts and golden marigolds.

This silk coat provides AC 12 + Dexterity modifier and allows the wearer to turn a critical hit into a normal hit once per rest. Luxurious indigo silk is embroidered with white waves and golden protective talismans.
An articulated limb crafted from wood, steel, and alchemical joints that replaces a lost body part. It functions identically to the original organic limb and cannot be removed against your will.
A longsword forged from hardened heartwood that cuts with the density of seasoned steel. It deals bonus nature damage on strike and allows the wielder to cast ensnaring strike once daily.
A living cedar staff twined with blossoming wild herbs that radiates restorative pastoral magic. It stores healing charges, allowing the bearer to cast goodberry, cure wounds, and lesser restoration.

Every dawn, this wax-sealed wooden canteen fills itself with a pint of restorative honey water that cleanses minor fatigue. The polished cedar exterior is carved with honeycomb patterns and foraging worker bees.

Opening this lacquered wooden box three times a day reveals a fresh, warm meal of seasoned rice, pickles, and grilled fish. Red and black lacquer coats a compact cedar container secured with a cloth furoshiki wrap.

A deck of illustrated cards depicting chromatic and metallic dragons used in popular tavern wagering games. Gamblers play it across Waterdeep's drinking halls to win coin and read opposing body language.
A geometric vellum notebook filled with complex fractal equations and metaphysical math proofs. It enhances spacetime spells, boosts transmutation DCs, and allows mathematical dice manipulation.
A multi-tiered wooden board with carved stone playing pieces representing dragons, heroes, and kings. Intellectual nobles and tacticians play it to sharpen strategic intellect and study battle.

A large iron cauldron engraved with dancing dryads that brews restorative herbal potions and broths. Placing a slain humanoid inside with gold coins restores them to life as if by the raise dead spell.
A whimsical deck of parchment cards depicting colorful illusions and minor magical wonders. Drawing a card unleashes whimsical effects such as summoning butterflies, gold sparks, or minor boons.
A suit of articulated plate or mail held together by quick-release toggles and hidden latch pins. The wearer can doff the entire suit as a single action to avoid drowning or escape grapples.
A serpentine tattoo that moves across the bearer's forearm like a live ink snake. It allows the wielder to grasp distant foes with shadowy tendrils and pull them close in combat.
Jagged ink claws tattooed across the bearer's hands and arms that crackle with magical energy. It makes unarmed strikes magical with a +1 bonus and unleashes thirty-foot force slashes.

Intricate ink patterns resembling interlocking chain links woven across the bearer's arms and shoulders. While you aren't wearing armor, it grants an unarmored armor class equal to twelve plus your dexterity.
A living seedpod wrapped in golden vines and blossoming jasmine flowers from the Conclave. It sprouts into a loyal wooden centaur construct that defends the grove and carries allies.
A golden fountain pen with an everlasting ink reservoir that never runs dry or smudges. It writes in any color of ink upon command and can transcribe spoken words onto parchment automatically.

A needle containing glowing ink that etches a magical tattoo representing a single cantrip onto skin. Activating the tattoo allows the bearer to cast the cantrip once before the needlework fades away.
A magical needle that inscribes a single 1st-level spell onto the flesh in swirling decorative script. The bearer can cast the stored spell once without expending components before the ink dissolves.
Intricate ink needlework depicting arcane formulas of a 3rd-level spell along the forearm. Activating the tattoo unleashes the spell immediately before the ink evaporates into faint mist.
A carefully shaped goose or raven quill pen with a split nib that draws up ink cleanly. Scribes and wizards use it to draft documents and transcribe spell formulas into grimoires.
Comprises a brass sextant, an astrolabe, a navigational compass, and a leather-bound star chart. It enables sailors and overland explorers to plot true courses and avoid losing their bearings.
A leather satchel containing brass dividers, compasses, measuring calipers, and colored inks. It allows surveyors and explorers to draft precise maps of uncharted subterranean caverns.
A sealed glass vial containing pitch-black, quick-drying gall ink for writing and cartography. A single ounce is sufficient to transcribe dozens of manuscript pages or map sheets.

Woven from deep emerald wool, this enchanted traveling cloak radiates a subtle barrier of warding energy. It bolsters the wearer's physical defenses and reinforces their resilience against magical hazards.
An illuminated vellum scroll that holds the channeled matrix of a potent 2nd-level spell. Reciting its incantation casts the magic instantly, consuming the paper in a flash of mystical light.
A scorched steel cuirass that constantly emits faint wisps of harmless gray smoke and the smell of coal. It provides dramatic theatrical flair without impeding physical defense or movement.
A sentient metal sphere etched with Siberys dragonshards that attaches to a warforged's body. It provides tactical advice, translates forgotten languages, and stabilizes its host in emergencies.
An iridescent suit of heavy plate crafted from the hyper-dense club shell of a giant mantis shrimp. It deflects sonic concussions and reflects sonic shockwaves back at attacking foes.
A translucent sea-snail shell holding a pulsating drop of bioengineered evolutionary mutagen. It transforms into a hybrid crab-turtle construct with armor-crushing pincers and impenetrable shell.
A heavy flanged steel mace inlaid with gold runes designed to shatter inanimate constructs. It deals massive bonus damage against golems and constructs, landing automatic critical destructions.
An illuminated vellum scroll that holds the channeled matrix of a powerful 3rd-level spell. Reciting its incantation casts the magic instantly, consuming the paper in a flash of mystical light.
A sharp, monochromatic grimoire inscribed with elegant calligraphy that hums with radiant ink. It empowers enchantment and illusion spells, stinging opposing minds with cutting verbal wit.

A folding fan crafted from the incandescent scarlet wing feathers of a firebird that radiates gentle heat. Waving it unleashes a gust of purifying fire that dispels magical gloom and cleanses disease.

Holding this oiled paper umbrella open allows the user to descend safely from any height at a gentle drifting pace. Oiled blue paper canopy is reinforced with flexible bamboo struts and adorned with crane feathers.

Calligraphy painted using this inkwell animates slightly on the page, dancing gently to convey the artist's mood. Deep black ink made from pine soot rests inside a glazed ceramic pot shaped like a sleeping frog.
A wooden tribal mask carved into the ferocious visage of a jungle predator with inlaid shell eyes. Wearing it allows the user to cast animal friendship and speak with animals three times daily.
A stylized hawk mask carved from polished birch and rimmed with silver feather inlays. Wearing it grants a sixty-foot flying speed and advantage on initiative rolls in aerial combat.

A featureless mask of starless cosmic obsidian that drinks in all ambient facial light. Wearing it swallows the wearer's mind from psychic detection and allows them to erase their presence from memory.

A hooded cloak woven from shadowfell threads that billows with faint ribbons of twilight darkness. It grants advantage on stealth checks and allows the wearer to turn invisible as an action in dim light.
A leather gas mask equipped with replaceable charcoal and lead filters designed for exploring the ruins. It prevents inhaled contamination from dense delerium fog for up to eight hours.

Wearing this funerary mask grants resistance to necrotic damage and allows communication with positive undead ancestors. Carved from pale fossilized livewood, it depicts serene, immortal elven features adorned with platinum leaf.

Wearing this mask gives you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight out to one mile. Hammered gold sheet is shaped into the regal face of a falcon with painted lapis lazuli eye rings.

Wearing this carved mask lets you speak with plants and animals and cast pass without trace once per long rest. Pale cypress wood is hand-carved with benevolent woodland spirit features crowned with dried lichen.
A stylish cloak woven from adaptive enchanted thread that shifts appearance at a mere thought. The wearer can alter its color, pattern, cut, and perceived fabric quality to blend into any crowd.
Rough linen hand wraps inscribed with boxing prayers and soaked in hardened mineral salts. They turn unarmed strikes into lethal magical weapons and grant temporary stamina when hitting foes.

A wooden palette, assorted badger-hair brushes, mixing oils, natural pigments, and stretched linen canvas. It enables artists to paint portraits, sketch architectural maps, and create camouflage banners.
A deck of fifty-four painted linen cards depicting monarchs, knights, and seasonal astrological suits. It provides entertainment around campfires and allows rogues to practice sleight of hand tricks.
A miniature silver box containing a tiny sacred holy relic such as bone ash or robe thread. Clerics clutch it in their hands to invoke Channel Divinity and manifest miracles.

Spinning thread upon this enchanted handloom allows the user to cast sleep at 4th level or send illusory dream messages across planes. Intricate silver spools hold ethereal thread spun from fallen starlight.
A green tallow candle that burns with an eerie emerald flame that cannot be snuffed by water. It provides illumination even when submerged under high ocean pressures in underwater trenches.
A sacred tallow candle dedicated to a specific alignment that burns with divine radiance for four hours. While lit, it empowers cleric and druid spells and can summon an avatar to cast gate.

A matched ritual set of a silver handbell, an illuminated prayer book, and a beeswax candle. Performing the tripartite ritual dispels regional curses, banishes possessing spirits, and sanctifies graves.
A slender taper molded from bee or tallow wax around a braided cotton wick. It burns for one hour, shedding bright light in a five-foot radius and dim light for five feet.

A twisted pink beeswax candle scented with honeysuckle that burns with a soft lavender flame. Its light reveals hidden fey creatures, dispels fairy illusions, and grants sweet dreams to nearby sleepers.
A phosphor-coated glass monocle held in a brass frame that amplifies ambient nocturnal light. It grants sixty feet of green-tinted darkvision without revealing the wearer's position.

When lit, this black wax candle consumes nonmagical flames within thirty feet and darkens bright light to dim light for one hour. The wick burns with a chilly violet ember that gives off no heat or smoke.

This rune brand enhances your firearm attack range by fifty percent and reveals hidden enemy weak points. An abstract eye motif pulses with faint cerulean light upon the wielder's firearm grip or forearm.
Includes glass beakers, a copper retort, measuring scales, and various stabilizing powders for chemical synthesis. It permits practitioners to distill volatile extracts, acids, and smoke concoctions.
A convex polished glass lens mounted inside a brass ring with a carved rosewood handle. It grants detailed examination of minute clues, runes, and gemstones, or focuses sunlight into flame.
An ornate ceramic jug carved with ocean waves and fitted with a lead stopper. Speaking command words causes it to pour endless fresh water in gentle streams, fountains, or geysers.
Delicate wire spectacles fitted with multi-layered crystal lenses that rotate into place. They magnify tiny details up to thirty times, granting advantage on investigation checks within one foot.
Curved crystal spectacles set into a golden frame chased with soaring raptor feathers. They grant advantage on visual perception checks and allow clear sight across vast horizons.

A teardrop-shaped violet psionic crystal that dissolves into mental focus when held against the temple. It allows a spellcaster to apply the Subtle Spell metamagic to one spell without expending sorcery points.
A jagged amethyst crystal that vibrates with hyper-accelerated psionic thought waves. Crushing it allows you to cast a spell with a casting time of one action as a bonus action instead.
A glowing ruby psionic crystal that radiates aggressive telepathic resonance. When you roll damage for a spell, crushing the crystal allows you to re-roll up to three damage dice.
A smooth sapphire crystal that projects a calm, calculated mental aura when held. Using it protects chosen allies from suffering full damage from an area-of-effect spell you cast.
A topaz crystal that hums with enduring temporal energy when attuned to your mind. Channeling its power doubles the duration of your next concentration spell up to twenty-four hours.
A tiny mechanical eyeball fitted with brass crawling legs and an adjustable crystal lens. It scuttles beneath closed doorways to transmit audio and visual scouting feedback to its operator.
Bulbous brass goggles fitted with amber crystal lenses that detect infrared thermal heat signatures. They reveal living warm-blooded creatures through dense smoke, magical fog, and total darkness.
A blackened steel crossbow fitted with an integrated shadow-lens sight and silenced prod. Bolts loosed from the weapon produce no audible sound and deal bonus necrotic damage from darkness.

When swung under daylight, this +1 curved sword refracts sunlight into dazzling flashes that can blind opponents on a critical strike. The blade is ground from crystalline quartz that sparkles with rainbow spectrums.

Consulting the astrological dials of this pocket instrument allows you to cast augury without expending spell slots twice per day. Rotating golden gears and astrological sign markers are protected under domed crystal lens.
A perforated copper vessel suspended on three chains designed to burn aromatic incense. Lighting incense inside summons an air elemental that swirls around you to shield against missile attacks.

A warhammer crafted from solid solar-forged brass that glows with the burning righteous wrath of the Boros Legion. The wielder can hurl the hammer to unleash an explosive blast of fire before it magically returns to hand.

A heavy portable brass mortar cannon engineered by the Izzet League to launch volatile mizzium payloads. It fires concussive explosive fire shells that blast barricades or sprays molten metal over sweeping arcs.
A backpack brass contraption of bubbling retorts, coiled copper tubing, and glass gauges. It allows a spellcaster to attempt casting spells they haven't prepared by channeling chaotic arcane energy.
A brass flamethrower handset linked to an alchemical fuel reservoir worn at the hip. It projects a ten-foot cone of searing fire, though consecutive bursts risk backfiring in an explosion.
Three wooden pipes bound with tarnished wire that smell faintly of river damp and copper. Playing them summons swarms of rats from nearby sewers that obey your telepathic commands.
An ordinary-looking wooden walking cane fitted with a polished brass ferrule. Speaking a command word transforms the cane instantly into an ordinary steel longsword.
Heavy steel masonry chisels, stone hammers, trowels, plumb bobs, and measuring chalk lines in a bag. It permits stonemasons to carve stone blocks, identify architectural weaknesses, and bypass walls.
A short-barreled blackpowder gun featuring a flared brass muzzle designed to spray lead shot across wide arcs. It delivers devastating spread damage against grouped enemies at close range.

Activating the clockwork lever on this polearm spins multiple serrated circular sawblades to shred armored monster hide. Whirring brass gears and notched iron discs buzz viciously at the end of a long iron shaft.

Firing this short-barreled scattergun deals 2d8 piercing damage in a fifteen-foot cone to unbalance charging monstrosities. Flared brass muzzle bell is strapped to a scorched walnut stock with steel banding.
A leather roll containing ten uses of sterilized bandages, herbal balms, tourniquets, and splints. Applying its contents stabilizes a dying companion without requiring magical healing.
A greasy brown salve distilled from pungent swamp roots that is rubbed liberally over exposed skin. A single application repels biting flies and prevents jungle parasites for twenty-four hours.

A pungent green unguent concocted from purified troll marrow and regenerative alchemical herbs. Rubbing it over wounds restores ten hit points every round for one minute and regenerates severed fingers.
A curved war scythe forged from blackened tomb iron that radiates freezing necrotic chill. Striking a living creature reaps their vital essence, healing the wielder for half the damage dealt.

Shattering this frozen shard encases an enemy within twenty feet in freezing rime that reduces speed to zero on a failed save. Blue glacial ice harvested from the Plain of Ice never melts under mundane summer temperatures.
A spiral brass horn chased with lightning motifs and destructive thunder runes. Sounding it releases a concussive cone of thunder damage, though it risks catastrophic backfire.

A polished goat horn wrapped in silver wire that produces no sound detectable by ordinary human ears. When blown, its silent warning can only be heard by one designated creature within six hundred feet.
A finely lacquered lute inlaid with mother-of-pearl accents that resonate with minor sensory magic. Playing the instrument creates harmless, shifting visual illusions that dance around the performer.
A curved brass war horn inscribed with northern warrior runes that roars like thunder. Sounding it summons spectral berserkers from Ysgard to overrun opposing forces for one hour.
A carved minotaur horn chased with intricate subterranean labyrinth paths along its length. Sounding it disorients enemies within thirty feet, stripping them of direction and spatial memory.

A handheld leather drum painted with vibrant musical runes that resonates with harmonic inspiration. It provides a +2 bonus to bard spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing a Bardic Inspiration die.
A curved brass instrument that flares into a wide bell capable of projecting deep, resonant calls. Watch officers and heralds sound it to announce royal arrivals or sound city-wide alarms.

Winding this curved horn emits a terrifying sonic howl that forces creatures in a thirty-foot cone to succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened. Polished ram horn is reinforced with banded iron and runic wolf engravings.

Blowing this heavy horn grants all allies within sixty feet advantage on saving throws against fear and 10 temporary hit points. Plated in crude iron bands, the horn bears battle trophies and scratched goblinoid war runes.

Beating this tribal hand drum preserves oral histories and lets the drummer cast heroism on up to three allies once per rest. Taut dire wolf hide is stretched over a hollowed ironwood frame carved with clan lineage pictographs.

Sounding this brass war horn dispels magical silence and grants allies within thirty feet advantage on attack rolls for one round. Thick brass horn bells are hammered with martial goblin crests and wrapped in weathered leather.
A spherical stone globe measuring one foot across that sits embedded into pedestals in public plazas. Stepping within five feet cleanses dirt, mud, and stains from clothing and armor instantly.
Fine clothing woven with iridescent threads that shimmer with subtle sensory illusions. It shifts colors to complement your mood and grants advantage on performance checks in high society.
A fine suit of tailored clothing that magically repairs tears, rips, and frayed seams automatically. Leaving it undisturbed for one minute restores the garments to pristine tailored condition.
A tall black felt top hat that twitches and rustles faintly inside its satin crown. Reaching into the hat allows the bearer to pull out a live bat, rat, or frog three times daily.
Simple utilitarian garments including a linen shirt, wool breeches, and a sturdy belt. It represents standard workaday clothing worn by peasants, farmers, and artisans across the city.
Durable woolen trousers, a belted tunic, leather boots, and a hooded cloaking mantle. It provides weather-resistant comfort and warmth for long overland treks along dusty trade roads.
A carved ivory feather that expands into a full-sized wooden swan boat when placed into water. It glides across lakes and rivers with swift magical propulsion, carrying up to thirty passengers.
An enclosed passenger coach equipped with cushioned interior bench seating and leaf-spring suspension. It transports noble dignitaries through city avenues in refined aristocratic comfort.
A light, fast two-wheeled war vehicle designed to carry an archer and driver at high galloping speeds. It circles enemy formations with swift flanking mobility during pitched plains warfare.

A graceful, flexible dragon-prowed war vessel engineered by northern raiders for ocean voyages and beach landings. Its shallow draft allows it to sail directly onto sandy shores for rapid infantry disembarkation.
Sleek boots dyed bright crimson, fitted with silver winged buckles at each heel. Clicking the heels together doubles your walking speed and forces disadvantage on enemy opportunity attacks.
Heavy leather marching boots fitted with enchanted, shifting soles that reshape during steps. The wearer leaves behind the footprints of any humanoid creature of their choice to mislead trackers.
Supple leather boots crafted from the hide of a desert bulette that glide across loose sands. The wearer moves across mud, sand, and loose gravel at full speed without leaving any tracks.
High riding boots crafted from soft dove-colored leather that barely touch the ground when walking. They allow the wearer to cast levitate on themselves at will to float twenty feet in the air.
Soft leather boots adorned with downy white goose feathers embroidered along the ankles. When falling from great heights, they slow your descent rate so that you land gently on your feet.
Winged boots crafted from azure leather that lift the wearer slightly above rough terrain. They grant an effortless twenty-foot hover speed and allow dashing as a bonus action across water.

While wearing these supple leather boots, your jumping distance is tripled and you take no damage from falls under thirty feet. White fur trims the cuffs alongside brass buckles shaped like sprinting hares.

Stomping your heel into the ground casts earth tremor at 2nd level to shake footing and unbalance surrounding adversaries. Thick granite soles are riveted to rugged ox-hide boots reinforced with heavy iron toes.
Includes a copper siphoning tube, hydrometer, fermentation bung, and hops-measuring scales in a crate. It enables brewmasters to ferment ales, stouts, and medicinal herbal wines.
A straight, sturdy ten-foot ash pole that can probe murky waters and test suspicious flagstones. Dungeon explorers tap it ahead of marching ranks to trigger pit traps and pressure plates.
A heavy rifle whose barrel is forged in the shape of an open-mouthed red dragon with brass scales. It channels alchemical blackpowder into explosive fiery projectiles that detonate in burning flame.

This heavy portable artillery piece fires explosive lead spheres that deal 4d8 bludgeoning damage and knock targets prone. Thick wrought-iron cannon barrel is mounted on reinforced shoulder braces with recoil-absorbing springs.
A wooden pole wrapped in pitch-soaked linen that burns brightly for one full hour. It casts bright illumination across a twenty-foot radius to dispel subterranean darkness.
A heavy pewter tankard engraved with hops and barley that magically neutralizes intoxication. Any alcoholic beverage consumed from the tankard leaves the drinker completely sober.

A carved stone flagon sculpted in the shape of a curling wyrm that infuses plain water with draconic magic. Drinking from it grants restorative healing, alchemical fire, or resistance to elemental breaths.
A simple pewter mug or earthenware drinking tankard that holds one pint of liquid. Common folk and adventurers drink ale, mead, or water from it in taverns across Faerûn.
A medallion wrought from silver or pewter depicting the sacred holy symbol of a deity. Clerics and paladins wear it around their neck to channel divine spellcasting magic.
A carved brass or silver plate depicting a divine crest riveted directly onto a shield face. A paladin or cleric uses the decorated shield as a sacred spellcasting focus in combat.
A wooden box measuring twelve inches long that unfolds into a full-sized rowboat or ship. Speaking command words causes the timber to assemble into a seaworthy vessel within seconds.
A reinforced steel ten-foot pole fitted with internal tension springs and release buttons. It collapses down into a compact six-inch rod that can be easily tucked into an adventurer's belt.

A rugged woodcutter's broadaxe forged from hardened meteoric iron that hungers for dense wood. It deals triple damage against wooden structures and plant creatures, severing thick trunks effortlessly.
An arcane focus wand carved from evergreen pines harvested from the freezing plane of Risia. Casting spells that deal cold damage causes icy frost to bite deeper into opposing foes.
A heavy broadaxe inscribed with sylvan runes of fey timber-craft that sings when swung. It deals maximum damage against plant creatures and wooden structures, cleaving through barriers easily.
This mason's chisel freezes stone or metal on contact to make brittle fractures easy to carve without loud noise. Frost coats the hardened steel tip regardless of ambient temperature.
An ornate throne carved from weirwood and copper that links a spellcaster's mind to a ship's hull. Channelling magic into the seat propels massive galleons across wildspace at supernatural speeds.
A powerful, brave breed of guard dog trained to defend homesteads and pull small carts. Small humanoids such as halflings and gnomes frequently ride them into battle as loyal mounts.
A leather headstall fitted with a steel bit that rests in a mount's mouth, connected to reins. It allows the rider to steer, brake, and communicate direction to their horse with precision.
A reinforced leather saddle fitted with high cantle and pommel supports to brace a mounted warrior. It braces the rider firmly in place, granting advantage on saving throws to avoid being unseated.
A comfortable, lightweight leather saddle designed for long-distance trail travel and daily riding. It distributes the rider's weight evenly across the horse's spine to prevent fatigue.
A twin-nozzle brass backpack powered by compressed alchemical steam and volatile kerosene. Igniting the thrusters grants a sixty-foot flying speed and leaves behind a cloud of scalding vapor.

Fastening this bridle to a mount doubles its overland travel pace and lets the rider cast haste on the mount once per day. Braided red silk reins are fastened with embossed silver bits depicting charging elven stallions.

Fastening this backpack apparatus deploys four mechanical legs that carry you up sheer walls at forty feet per round. Polished steel gears and articulating piston legs fold neatly behind a leather chest harness.
A segmented steel canister packed with volatile explosive salts that detonate upon impact. Throwing it releases a deafening sonic shockwave that stuns and disorients all creatures in a room.
A pressurized metal canister filled with stinging alchemical vapor that irritates eyes and lungs. Inhaling the gas causes severe coughing, blindness, and disadvantage on all physical attacks.
A pinch of sparkling azure sand that absorbs surrounding heat when tossed into the air. It conjures a fifty-foot oasis of cool shade and fresh spring water that lasts for eight hours.
A sling bullet or firearm round cast from lead infused with pulverized delerium dust. Striking a target detonates a chaotic temporal burst that teleports the victim twenty feet in a random direction.

Planting this enchanted acorn into soil instantly grows a thirty-foot defensible tree or casts plant growth in the area. A massive petrified golden acorn pulses with the raw fertility of the Primordial Forest.

Burning this bundle of dried herbs cleanses the area of foul odors and provides advantage on saves against airborne spores. Dried sage, lavender, and sweetgrass are tied tightly together with natural hemp twine.
A cured leather bladder lined with beeswax and secured by a tethered wooden stopper. It carries four pints of fresh drinking water to sustain an adventurer through arid wilderness treks.
A braided cord of dark fibrous tendrils that writhes hungrily when thrown toward a target. It snares and binds a creature within twenty feet, restraining them in an unbreakable knot.
A heavy backpack holding a crowbar, hammer, ten pitons, ten torches, a tinderbox, rations, and waterskin. It contains the essential baseline survival equipment required to explore dark dungeon ruins.

A colorful backpack filled with a bedroll, two theatrical costumes, candles, rations, waterskin, and disguise kit items. It allows traveling bards and acrobats to perform across tavern circuits in style.

A sturdy backpack containing a bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, ten torches, ten days of rations, and waterskin. It provides all necessary wilderness sustenance for long-distance expeditions across untamed terrain.
Two bulbous glass chambers set into an ornate brass cage filled with measured fine sand. It trickles with precise accuracy to measure sixty minutes for magical rituals or timed infiltrations.
A polished brass dodecahedron that ticks with absolute mathematical rhythm when wound. Placing it on the ground creates a field of order that cancels wild magic surges for one hour.
A tin case containing a shallow frying pan, plate, cup, and nesting fork, knife, and spoon. The kit clasps together tightly for clean storage inside an adventurer's backpack.
A balanced brass balance scale equipped with graduated weights and copper weighing pans. Merchants use it to weigh precious coin clippings, raw gemstone nuggets, and alchemical powders.
A small carved bone or brass whistle that produces a shrill, piercing blast across long distances. Scouts and city guards use it to signal distress or coordinate tactical team maneuvers.

Blowing this wrought-iron whistle summons a pair of fiery spectral hounds to track quarry across any terrain for one hour. Hot soot and faint embers puff from the mouth of the whistle with every breath.
A palm-sized plate of polished steel protected within a hinged wooden casing. It lets explorers peek around dangerous dungeon corners or signal companions across sunlit valleys.
A spring-loaded iron jaw trap fitted with razor teeth that snaps shut when stepped upon. Chained to a tree or heavy stake, it restrains beasts and imposes physical puncture damage.
A personalized gold or brass ring engraved with a family crest, mercantile mark, or guild emblem. Pressing it into hot sealing wax leaves an official mark on letters and legal warrants.
A spiraling electrum band set with a pulsing cerulean conduit stone that channels raw aether. It siphon excess magical discharge from incoming enemy spells to replenish the wearer's spell slots.
A heavy silver chain adorned with carved platinum gills and bubble-shaped moonstones. It surrounds the wearer's neck with fresh air, allowing underwater breathing and immunity to toxic gases.
A silver pendant set with a polished bloodstone shaped like a teardrop. It instantly stabilizes the dying wearer at the start of their turns and doubles hit point recovery from hit dice.
A slender gold band engraved with delicate downy feathers that feel weightless on the finger. When the wearer falls, it instantly casts feather fall to ensure a safe, drifting descent.
A band of intertwined electrum loops that spin freely around each other without friction. It ensures difficult terrain does not impede your movement and makes you immune to paralysis.
A heavy ring carved from a single piece of dark lapis lazuli and lined with silver filigree. It stores up to five levels of spells cast into it, allowing any wearer to unleash them later.
A polished silver ring set with an aquamarine that ripples like liquid when exposed to moonlight. It allows the wearer to stride across any liquid surface as if it were firm solid ground.
A flexible silver band carved with coiled grasshopper legs that tightens comfortably on the finger. It allows the wearer to cast jump on themselves as a bonus action at will.
A heavy gold ring set with a clear quartz intaglio depicting a fortress gate. It shields the wearer from telepathic intrusions and conceals their alignment from magical detection.
A heavy copper band sculpted with three animal heads: a wolf, an owl, and an eagle. It allows the wearer to cast animal friendship, fear against beasts, or speak with animals.
A heavy lead ring set with a cloudy beryl stone that becomes transparent when pressed. It allows the wearer to see through up to one foot of solid stone, wood, or dirt to spot hidden chambers.

A plain iron ring inscribed with the military pledge of a royal house or mercenary company. If the wearer drops to zero hit points, the ring instantly ends their life to prevent capture and interrogation.
A silver ring set with an aerogel sphere that traps a microscopic bubble of pure atmospheric air. In vacuum or toxic atmospheres, it projects a clean air envelope around the wearer for one hour.
A brass band set with a smoldering fire opal that feels reassuringly warm against the finger. It grants the wearer permanent resistance to all forms of fire damage.
A pale silver ring set with an everlasting sapphire that never loses its freezing chill. It protects the wearer with permanent resistance against all cold damage.
A copper ring shaped like a coiling snake set with a sparkling blue topaz. It absorbs electrical shockwaves, granting the bearer permanent resistance to lightning damage.
A ring carved from dark jade that resists corrosive alchemical degradation. The wearer gains continuous resistance against caustic fluids, bile, and acid damage.
A band of blackened silver set with an onyx intaglio depicting an unyielding skull. It shields the wearer's life essence with permanent resistance to necrotic damage.
A band of dense adamantine inlaid with pure crystalline quartz that deflects kinetic energy. It grants the wearer permanent damage resistance against magical force damage.
A woven platinum band set with a purple amethyst that hums with serene mental stillness. It fortifies the wearer's mind, granting permanent resistance to psychic trauma.
A silver ring set with an unyielding white pearl that warms whenever deception is spoken nearby. It grants advantage on insight checks to detect lies and allows the wearer to cast zone of truth.
You can use an action to telekinetically push or pull an enemy up to twenty feet toward or away from you. A cabochon moonstone is set into a band of twisting aquamarine waves and silver foam.

This ring grants resistance to cold damage and allows you to unleash a fifteen-foot cone of freezing breath once per dawn. Carved from blue ice that never melts, the band is engraved with snarling wolf fangs.
A knife forged from shadowfell glass that vanishes from sight when cloaked in darkness. Landing a sneak attack from dim light teleports the wielder into adjacent shadows.
A sleek stiletto forged from dark shadowfell obsidian that whispers dark secrets to its wielder. Striking a target from stealth leaves them deafened and silenced by swirling magical shadows.
A ceremonial dagger whose guard is sculpted like the coiled wings of a young silver dragon. It deals bonus cold damage on strike and sheds soft silver moonlight across a fifteen-foot radius.
A stiletto forged from dark shadow-metal that vanishes from perception when drawn in darkness. Striking a target from stealth leaves them blinded and silences their vocal cords for one minute.
A pair of curved punch daggers carved from the talons of an apex hunting raptor. Wielding both blades simultaneously allows the fighter to execute rapid rending cross-slashes in melee.
A sharpened hawthorn stake treated with alchemical tracking tinctures that drinks blood on contact. Impaling an undead or beast allows the hunter to track the quarry across infinite distances.
A compact stabbing knife forged from unblemished cold iron designed for occult monster slaying. It bypasses supernatural damage reductions, dealing true physical trauma against devils and hags.

Attuned psionic wielders add their Intelligence or Wisdom modifier to damage rolls made with this crystalline piercing weapon. Translucent amber crysteel is grown from psionically resonant sand mined in Sarlona.

Cutting your own palm with this ritual dagger empowers your next damaging spell with an extra 2d8 necrotic damage. A curved obsidian blade is bound to a bone handle stained with dried sacrificial crimson.
A heavy crossbow fitted with an alchemical reservoir that bathes loaded bolts in clinging liquid fire. Struck targets ignite in roaring flames that burn continuously until extinguished by water.
A smooth, polished Eberron dragonshard that stores up to one hundred pages of text and illustrations. Placing a finger on the crystal projects glowing illusory text directly into the bearer's mind.
A pair of linked leather bags designed to drape across the rear of a riding or pack saddle. They provide twenty pounds of convenient exterior storage for rations, bedrolls, and waterskins.
A band of polished turquoise carved with overlapping fish scales that remains cool against the skin. It grants the wearer a swimming speed of forty feet through turbulent waters.
A glowing crimson draught that sparkles with radiant motes when gently swirled in its glass vial. It rapidly closes severe lacerations and soothes broken bones to deliver potent restorative healing.
Constructed from boiled leather hardened in hot oil and stitched together with supple shoulder joints. It provides baseline protection while allowing total freedom of stealthy movement.
A stiff leather hip holster embossed with brass gear etchings and quick-draw silver buckles. It magically feeds ammunition into holstered sidearms and allows the wearer to draw with lightning speed.
Finely cured leather armor reinforced with subtle mithral studs that feels like soft silk. Speaking a command word disguises the armor as ordinary fashionable clothing of any style.

A leather sling woven with shimmering golden fleece cords that manipulates ricochet trajectories. When a projectile launched from this sling strikes a creature, it ricochets to hit a second target within ten feet.
A tailored suit of vulcanized leather reinforced with airtight seals and brass pressure valves. It provides total environmental protection in astral space and allows thruster-assisted maneuvering.
A rust-colored leather pouch that contains enchanted fuzz balls attuned to wilderness creatures. Throwing a ball manifests friendly beasts such as brown bears, giant badgers, or mastiffs.
A supple leather sash adorned with hanging brass bells that emit embers when jingling. It grants fire resistance, boosts acrobatics checks, and wreaths the wearer's kicks in scorching flames.
A heavy leather belt fitted with a gimballed brass gyroscope that spins continuously around your waist. It grants absolute physical equilibrium, making you immune to being knocked prone.
Armguards fashioned from tough ironwood bark bound with supple sylvan leather cords. When the wearer isn't wearing heavy armor, their skin hardens to provide an armor class of sixteen.

You can draw or stow weapons housed in this scabbard as a free action without expending your object interaction. Tooled black leather is reinforced with oiled brass rollers and a swift-release spring lock.

This leather apron grants resistance to fire damage and allows the wearer to handle white-hot metals barehanded without harm. Heavy oiled dragon-leather is equipped with tool loops and charred brass grommets.
A cold-iron lantern that burns with razorvine sap, emitting a sharp razor-green illumination. Its light pierces magical gloom in Sigil and reveals invisible planar razorvine traps.
A cylindrical tin lantern fitted with glass panels and a sliding metal hood to regulate light. It burns for six hours per pint of oil and can be shuttered to dim illumination instantly.
A four-sided bronze lantern containing swirling motes of the four elemental planes. Turning the selector dial shifts the flame to emit fire warmth, water mist, gale wind, or stone light.
A heavy iron lantern that burns rendered beast fat to produce a dim, violet-tinted revelation flame. Its illumination reveals invisible footprints, blood trails, and concealed supernatural horrors.

The pale blue flame inside this iron lantern reveals invisible creatures within thirty feet and grants advantage against possession. Ornate stained glass panels depict psychopomp guides leading spirits across tranquil waters.

This lantern sheds magical darkness in a twenty-foot radius through which only the lantern bearer can clearly see. Pierced wrought-iron filigree casts twisting silhouette patterns across walls and stone floors.

This hooded lantern sheds black flame that illuminates magical auras and hidden footprints within thirty feet. Blackened iron filigree holds panes of dark glass through which violet flame flickers without heat.
This crown gives the wearer advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against subterranean reptilian creatures. Jagged beaten brass points are decorated with polished colored glass and river gems.

Lighting this folding paper lantern ensures anyone sleeping within its warm glow awakens refreshed and free from bad dreams. Ribbed bamboo and translucent rice paper are painted with floating cloud spirits.

This glass lantern houses an enchanted giant firefly that sheds thirty feet of warm golden light without needing fuel. Slender brass wire cages a blown-glass bulb filled with fresh moss and a docile glowing insect.
A compact yew recurve bow built for rapid arrow delivery in dense forest cover or confined alleys. It enables skirmishers and scouts to fire on the move without sacrificing mobility.
A stout length of ash or oak measuring six feet long and capped with brass ferrules. Monks and wanderers utilize its balanced length to parry attacks and deliver swift, fluid strikes.
A tall wooden bow crafted from fine yew heartwood that matches the archer's height. It requires great physical training to draw, launching bodkin arrows across staggering tactical distances.
An elven recurve bow crafted from flexible white wood carved with ancient oaths of retribution. Naming an enemy as your sworn foe grants advantage and devastating piercing damage against them.
An elegant wooden walking staff capped with three tiny brass cradles that hold small trinkets. Up to three tiny objects can be made to float and spin gracefully around its head.
A carved yew staff adorned with intricate bird carvings and fluttering dried feathers along its grip. It can be tapped to mimic the distinct calls of dozens of songbirds and woodland predators.
A living branch of polished cherry wood that sprouts fresh green leaves along its knotted length. Tapping its base against fertile ground causes colorful harmless wildflowers to sprout instantly.
An arrow crafted with an adamantine core that cannot be broken or snapped by any physical force. It can only be destroyed if subjected to the disintegration spell or placed within an artifact.

A slender staff carved from supple rowan wood capped with a gleaming heart-shaped amethyst. It allows the wielder to cast charm person, command, and comprehend languages, or redirect mental enchantment spells.
A dark wooden staff carved with crawling beetles and swarming hornet hives along its length. It unleashes a thirty-foot cloud of stinging biting insects that heavily obscures the area and bites foes.
A recurve bow strung with distilled zephyr winds that whisper softly when drawn to full length. Arrows loosed from its string are guided by howling winds that ignore wind penalties.

A tall wooden quarterstaff capped with an eagle figurine that repels airborne predators. Flying beasts and winged humanoids cannot make opportunity attacks against the wielder and suffer disadvantage on melee strikes.
A twisted branch of petrified vampiric wood that pulses with dark, parasitic life. It allows the wielder to control blights and cast vampiric touch, though it hungers to drain the bearer's blood.
A wooden staff carved with serpentine scales that twists subtly when grasped in combat. Hurling it onto the ground transforms the staff into a giant constrictor snake that obeys your commands.
A walking staff carved from seasoned elder wood that hums with grounded sylvan resonance. It functions as a quarterstaff in combat while serving as a conduit for nature spellcasting.
A tall wooden quarterstaff carved with mystic runes and capped with a polished focus crystal. It serves double duty as a martial bludgeon and an arcane spellcasting instrument.

A heavy quarterstaff harvested from an ancient ironwood tree that strikes with the density of forged steel. It functions as a +1 magical weapon and can be braced into the ground as an unyielding barricade.
An ash arrow fitted with a copper needle tip connected to a micro-galvanic capacitor. Impacting an armored opponent discharges high-voltage electricity that shocks and paralyzes the foe.
A gnarled oak staff budding with green leaves that hums with ancient woodland vitality. It boosts nature spell save DCs, casts plant growth, and can sprout into an unyielding wooden wall.

Arrows shot from this +1 shortbow curve around half and three-quarters cover to strike elusive targets without penalty. The recurve limbs are carved from twin intertwined stag horns taken from mystical prairie jackalopes.

This petrified wooden staff lets the wielder cast entangle and barkskin using charges refreshed at every sunrise. Gnarled ironwood roots twist around a raw green emerald focus that pulses with earthen energy.

This living wooden staff never rots, functions as a +1 quarterstaff, and lets you cast pass without trace once per dawn. Verdant green leaves bud and bloom continuously along the polished living branch.
Vertical strips of tempered steel riveted to thick leather backing protect the torso and limbs over chain mail. It delivers substantial defense against heavy blows for veteran front-line legionaries.
Speaking a command word causes roaring magical fire to erupt along the length of this steel blade. Its strikes inflict searing thermal damage that ignites flammable materials on impact.
An iron flanged head mounted on a reinforced steel shaft engineered to dent plate armor. Clerics and crusaders frequently wield it as an emblem of sacred martial duty.
A compact steel hammer perfectly balanced for close melee swinging or short-range hurling. Forge workers and skirmishers keep one strapped to their belts for sudden close-quarters defense.

A break-action firearm with twin steel barrels capable of discharging heavy buckshot shells independently or simultaneously. It sweeps corridors with devastating widespread pellet patterns in confined urban conflicts.
A heavy brass fire-pot supported by lion claws chased with swirling flame patterns. Kindling a fire within summons a fierce fire elemental bound to fight on your behalf.
A tempered steel chisel engraved with primeval giant runes of craft and creation. It enables artisans to inscribe magical runes of flame, frost, and stone onto weapons and shields.
A dense chunk of lodestone and granite that pulses with deep tectonic stability. Activating metamagic grants you temporary resistance to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
A glowing ember-shard that radiates roaring furnace heat and dancing sparks of flame. When you cast a metamagic spell, an eruption of flame engulfs nearby enemies in searing thermal burns.
A heavy forge hammer etched with dwarven fire runes that crackles with heat when drawn. Striking an opponent inflicts concussive blunt trauma accompanied by roaring bursts of searing flame.
A double-barreled shotgun whose steel barrels and stock have been cut down for quick concealment. It unleashes a deafening roar and widespread buckshot pattern that obliterates close targets.
A two-handed saw weapon fitted with a revolving chain of razor steel teeth driven by a steam engine. Revving the engine shreds through dense wooden barricades, shields, and monster hides.

These heavy steel gauntlets increase your unarmed strike damage to 1d8 bludgeoning and allow you to catch incoming projectile weapons. Intricate petal-shaped plates overlap along the wrists and knuckles like blooming roses.

This +2 greataxe deals double damage to stone constructs and can trigger a targeted localized earth tremor once per short rest. Massive bearded steel blades are etched with dwarven runes of tectonic sundering.

Throwing this javelin causes it to transform into a bolt of starlight that deals 3d6 radiant damage and illuminates the strike zone. Meteoric steel forms the star-tipped point fastened to a sleek ash shaft.

This +1 greataxe deals extra damage to labyrinth dwellers and prevents the wielder from ever becoming lost in mazes. Broad double-crescent steel blades are etched with winding labyrinthine pathways and bull horns.
A collection of drying clippers, glass vials, a mortar and pestle, and pouches of preserving poultices. It enables trained wilderness apothecaries to forage medicinal herbs and brew healing draughts.
A shimmering ruby red liquid that smells of crushed cherries and warm winter honey. Drinking its contents instantly knits flesh and mends cuts to restore vitality.
A rose-tinted, effervescent potion with heart-shaped bubbles that swirl playfully within. Drinking it causes the imbiber to regard the next creature they see as their true love.
A thick, musky potion containing ground manticore pinion feathers and distilled beast blood. Drinking it sprouts leathery spiked wings from your shoulders that grant swift aerial flight.
A swirling, airy potion that feels like cold mountain mist against the throat when swallowed. It allows the drinker to walk atop clouds, fog, and smoke as if they were solid stone.
A quivering translucent green gelatin stored in a wide-mouthed glass jar that tastes of lime and vinegar. Eating it turns your body into malleable ooze, allowing you to slip through one-inch cracks.
A thick, stone-gray brew containing powdered giant bones and mineral oils that tastes of chalk. Drinking it grants temporary resistance to all physical damage and immunity to being knocked prone.
A translucent draught that vaporizes into pale clouds within its bottle whenever unstoppered. Drinking it transforms you and your gear into a misty cloud that can fly and slip through tiny fissures.
A tiny phial containing an effervescent green liquid that continually shrinks in perceived volume. Drinking it shrinks your size to tiny, granting advantage on stealth and dexterity checks.
A thick gray concoction that grinds like wet sand when swirled in its glass phial. Ingesting it grants superhuman physical prowess, raising your Strength score to twenty-three for one hour.

A cold blue draught rimed with frost crystals that numbs the tongue when swallowed. It raises the consumer's Strength score to twenty-three and grants resistance to freezing temperatures for one hour.
A shimmering purple serum that reflects distorted facial illusions on the liquid surface. Ingesting it grants the ability to cast dominate person to compel absolute obedience from a humanoid.

A thick molten-red serum that tastes of sulfur and cinnamon and warms the body completely. Drinking it grants immunity to extreme volcanic heat and allows you to stride across molten lava without sinking.
An earthy brown tonic containing distilled sensory fluids from a bulette's auditory canal. Drinking it grants sixty feet of tremorsense, allowing you to pinpoint subterranean movement.
A metallic silver draught that tastes of blood and iron shavings that sets heavy in the stomach. Drinking it turns your skin into hardened iron, granting resistance to slashing and piercing damage.
A warm herbal tonic brewed from rare Othelm mountain roots that invigorates physical stamina. Consuming it removes one level of exhaustion and grants advantage on Constitution saving throws.

Drinking this inky draught allows you to step through shadows up to sixty feet as a bonus action for ten minutes. Swirling pitch-black liquid leaves no moisture on the glass and tastes like chilled winter air.

Consuming this fiery tonic allows you to exhale a twenty-foot cone of concussive roaring thunder that deafens foes. Bubbling crimson fluid crackles with tiny sparks and smells sharply of ozone and sulfur.

Feeding this tonic to a dying or wounded follower immediately stabilizes them and restores 2d8+2 hit points. Effervescent amber tonic fizzes energetically within a rugged brass-capped traveling flask.

Drinking this crimson potion prevents the user from being knocked prone or restrained during a charge for one minute. Thick red liquid smells of roasted iron and blood, pulsating with rhythmic concussive bubbles.
A porcelain doll dressed in fine Victorian silks that stores a recorded voice message. When designated trigger conditions occur nearby, the doll speaks the programmed sentence in an eerie voice.
A leather-bound grimoire inscribed with Bigby's personal hand-magic formulas and giant rune studies. It empowers force spells, boosts wizard spell DCs, and manifests protective spectral hands.
A crystallized mote of potentiality that shifts between multiple temporal states when viewed. Crushing the shard allows the user to re-roll any failed check or manipulate time flow.
