A pair of delicate flesh-colored earpieces crafted by House Dimir that adhere invisibly to the ear canal. They allow secure, telepathic audio communication across the entire sprawling city without fear of eavesdropping.

A tailored suit or gown woven from transmutational threads that stores five different outfits within its weave. Speaking a command word alters the style, cut, and color into any of the stored designs.
A menacing weapon forged with serrated barbs and cruel counter-hooks designed to inflict horrific trauma. Landing a critical hit deals an extra seven points of catastrophic physical damage.
A narrow strip of parchment inscribed with the basic phonetic runes of an introductory cantrip. Reading the scroll casts the cantrip instantly before the parchment crumbles into harmless ash.
A masterwork parchment sealed with gold leaf that hums with concentrated 4th-level spell power. Speaking the incantation discharges the spell immediately, burning the vellum into glowing embers.
A sacred vellum scroll inscribed with complex geometrical sigils containing a potent 5th-level spell. Reading it unleashes high-tier magical energy, vaporizing the scroll upon release.

A protective parchment ward inscribed with ancient banishing runes against a specific creature type. Reading it projects an impenetrable five-foot barrier that prevents the chosen monsters from approaching.

A leather grimoire disguised as an ordinary romance novel that stores complex illusion and trickery spells. It empowers wizard illusion magic and allows the caster to swap positions with an illusory decoy.
A scorched metal-bound spellbook that smells of ozone and crackles with stored kinetic thunder energy. It empowers evocation spells, dealing bonus force damage and knocking targets backward.

A velvet-bound spellbook embossed with silver filigree hearts that details subtle mental enchantment arts. It enhances enchantment spell save DCs and makes charmed creatures completely oblivious to the magic.
A pump-action shotgun fitted with a perforated heat shield and bayonet lug for brutal close-quarters combat. It cycles heavy gauge shells swiftly to clear defensive trenches and fortified doorways.
A durable leather coat lined with extradimensional inner pockets and false hems. It conceals up to six weapons or items from physical searches, allowing discrete urban smuggling.
A wooden box filled with parchment scraps, specialized inks, sealing waxes, and fine quill pens. It enables skilled scoundrels to fabricate legal documents, royal permits, and guild charters.

A stylish ink tattoo that shifts across your skin like flowing liquid, taking any shape or color you desire. It allows you to cast disguise self once daily to effortlessly alter your physical appearance.

A mirrored leather case containing cosmetics, theatrical greasepaint, prosthetic noses, and assorted false hair. It allows an infiltrator to alter facial features and adopt convincing civilian personas.
Interlocking rings forged from indestructible ultra-dense dark adamantine metal. Any critical hit landed against the wearer is converted into a normal, non-critical strike.
Heavy articulated plate crafted from black, unyielding adamantine ore that absorbs catastrophic kinetic shocks. It completely negates the extra damage from all incoming critical hits.

Massive gauntlets forged from adamantine plates salvaged from an ancient titan's fallen siege armor. Wearing them allows you to hurl boulders across hundreds of feet and crush castle gates with bare fists.
A collapsible wooden flight frame covered with the stretched, cured wing membranes of a wyvern. Jumping from heights allows the user to glide silently through the air across vast canyon chasms.

This master-forged hammer scores automatic critical hits on structural objects and ignores damage resistance on constructs. Heavy dark adamantine forms a faceted rectangular striking block etched with goblin runes.

Wearing this pauldron allows you to spend a reaction to grant an adjacent ally a free disengage or dodge action. Articulated blackened steel plates are etched with tactical deployment grids and unit markers.
A shadowy cloak cut in scalloped folds reminiscent of leathery bat wings. It allows the wearer to fly while gripping the edges in darkness and even transform into a bat.
A flowing crimson mantle with golden embroidered flame patterns that dance in warm breezes. Spinning in combat ignites a vortex of protective fire that harms approaching foes.
A flowing cloak crafted from the pelt of a displacer beast that bends ambient light. It projects an illusory duplicate beside the wearer, forcing all attack rolls against them to suffer disadvantage.
A weathered leather sailing jacket lined with concealed extradimensional pockets and false linings. It stores dozens of small contraband items and grants a +5 bonus to sleight of hand checks.
A circular gold brooch engraved with a fortress wall that fastens a cloak at the shoulder. It grants resistance to force damage and makes the wearer completely immune to magic missile spells.
A rough cloak fashioned from the pelt of a hell hound that smells strongly of brimstone and ash. It allows the wearer to transform into a fiery hell hound complete with breath weapon attacks.

A feathered cloak woven from the shed plumage of a true immortal firebird that pulses with undying warmth. If the wearer suffers fatal trauma, the mantle erupts in a cleansing fireball that restores them to full vitality.
A diaphanous veil of frozen rime that drapes delicately over the face without melting. It wraps the wearer in an aura of sub-zero cold, freezing incoming missile attacks and chilling attackers.
A coat of scale armor fashioned from overlapping blue drake scales bound with copper rivets. It grants permanent lightning resistance, swimming speed, and imposes no disadvantage on stealth checks.
A thick mantle patchwork tailored from lion fur, dragon scales, and goat hide. It grants fire resistance, advantage on perception checks, and can emit a terrifying predatory roar.
A heavy wolf pelt draped with the snarling head worn as a hood over combat armor. It grants advantage on pack tactics combat checks and provides insulation against sub-zero mountain cold.
A thick, shaggy parka tailored from white yeti pelt that blends into snowy mountain landscapes. It grants total cold resistance and provides camouflage advantage on stealth checks in snow.

This mantle gives its wearer a flying speed of sixty feet and advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with good-aligned celestials. Pristine white flight feathers rustle softly as if catching an ethereal mountain draft.

Wearing this fur cloak gives you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell and cold resistance. Thick gray timber wolf fur is secured across broad shoulders with an antler-toggle clasp.

This cloak grants a climbing speed of thirty feet and lets you transform into a giant raven once per long rest. Sleek black feathers from northern Huginn ravens overlap smoothly across heavy velvet shoulders.

Wearing this rat-fur cloak lets you speak with rodents and summon a swarm of rats to defend you once per dusk. Patchwork gray fur is pinned at the throat by an interconnected knot of three mummified rat tails.
Polished brass armbands engraved with geometric warding symbols that shimmer with abjuration magic. When worn without armor or shields, they project an invisible barrier that bolsters defense.
Soft leather slippers soles lined with microscopic adhesive setae like those of a spider. They allow the wearer to walk upright across walls and inverted ceilings with hands free.
Intricate silver bracers set with multifaceted prism crystals that amplify illusion and cantrip magic. Whenever you cast a cantrip, you can immediately cast that same cantrip again as a bonus action.
A sleek quiver tailored from black velvet that cloaks stored ammunition in silence and shadow. Arrows drawn from the quiver produce no sound in flight and deal bonus necrotic damage from stealth.
Whenever you grapple a creature, these leafy bracers dig thorny barbs into the target to deal 1d6 piercing damage each turn. Braided green briar stems flex comfortably against the wearer's forearms.

Fastening these golden clasps onto mundane footwear gives the wearer a high jump height equal to their full movement speed. Sculpted miniature wings of hammered gold flutter lightly whenever feet leave the earth.
Water harvested from uncorrupted subterranean aquifers deep beneath the ruins and blessed by clerics. Drinking it restores five hit points, cures mundane sickness, and washes away toxic residue.

Swinging this burning censer releases soothing incense that suppresses the effects of fear and confusion in a thirty-foot radius. Pierced brass sphere swings from heavy chains, emitting sweet floral frankincense smoke.
A woven cloak of midnight blue velvet that dampens hostile arcane vibrations around the shoulders. It grants the wearer permanent advantage on saving throws against all hostile magical spells.
A sweeping polearm forged from the serrated jawbone of a monstrous dire tracker hound. It vibrates when in proximity to wounded prey and inflicts vicious bleeding lacerations on strike.
A vellum grimoire containing intricate summoning circles and true names of extraplanar entities. It bolsters summoned aberrations, celestials, and fiends with bonus temporary vitality in combat.
A heavy golden medallion shaped like a heart set with a pulsing cabochon ruby. Wearing it infuses the user's physique with supernatural stamina, raising their Constitution score to nineteen.
A slender bronze band crowned with a blazing sunburst emblem and a central fire-opal. Once per day, the wearer can project a searing scorching ray directly from the gem.
A braided silver circlet set with a single sparkling blue star sapphire at its brow. It expands the wearer's cognitive capacity, locking their Intelligence score at nineteen.
An iron ring sculpted with the horned head of a charging ram with ruby eyes. Expending its charges unleashes an invisible spectral ram that bludgeons targets backward with shattering force.
A heavy gold ring set with an intricately faceted sapphire that contains a swirling whirlwind inside. Rubbing the ring summons a loyal noble djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air to serve you.
A band of polished sapphire and electrum that hovers weightlessly on the finger. It grants permanent flight, immunity to lightning, and the authority to command air elementals.
A ring carved from solid granite and set with an unyielding deep-earth star sapphire. It allows the wearer to glide through solid stone walls and command earth elementals.
A large faceted quartz crystal that stores dozens of radiant light charges within its facets. It emits blinding beams, radiant cones, and dazzling flashes that leave enemies permanently blind.
A jagged pendant carved from black chardalyn stone that hums with cold necrotic power. It stores a single spell of up to fifth level cast into it, though it whispers dark madness.
A sparkling blue sapphire that crackles with turbulent tidal currents when held up to the ear. Crushing the gem underfoot summons an obedient water elemental to fight on your behalf.
A brilliant yellow diamond that rumbles with deep tectonic stability within its multifaceted interior. Shattering the stone summons an earth elemental from the earth to crush your foes.

A blood-red diamond carved into a rough heart shape that pulses with ancient giant divinations. Touching it reveals the exact direction and distance to the nearest living blood relative of King Hekaton.
A polished blue-white moonstone set in a silver crescent bezel that pulses with lunar tides. It enhances curative healing spells, adding extra vitality when cast under the night sky.
A platinum band set with a triangular prism diamond that refracts light into vivid rainbows. It allows the wearer to bend incoming laser and radiant energy, reflecting it back at attackers.

Crushing this polished golden amber gem summons a giant scorpion ally that obeys your mental commands for up to one hour. A perfectly preserved prehistoric arachnid floats inside clear fossilized pine resin.
Carrying this crimson gem allows an artificer or mage to attune to an additional magic item beyond their normal limit. A translucent crimson dragonshard is encased in a polished brass pendant cage.

Socketing a red blood-gem into this rapier adds 1d8 necrotic damage to attacks and restores hit points on critical strikes. A slender needle blade is fitted with a slotted swept hilt containing a glowing crimson blood-ruby.

This ring grants the wearer darkvision out to sixty feet and allows them to cast shadow step between dim areas once per rest. A faceted midnight-blue sapphire is set into a band of twisting iron filigree.
While wearing this silver ring, you can walk on air as if it were solid ground during clear starry nights. A cluster of tiny diamond chips sparkles like an open night sky on a delicate platinum band.
This tall polearm mounts a heavy axe blade balanced by an opposing hook atop a reinforced ash shaft. Its extended reach allows infantry to strike over front ranks and trip incoming chargers.
A powerful mechanical bow constructed with a steel prod and a cranked windlass to load heavy bolts. It drives projectiles through thick armor at long range with lethal kinetic impact.
A leaf-shaped iron head set upon a flexible wooden shaft suitable for thrusting or throwing. It provides disciplined formations with defensive reach and simple, reliable lethality.
A slender, lightweight throwing spear weighted specifically for long aerodynamic flight. Skirmishers loose volleys of javelins to soften shield walls before closing into melee.
A long single-edged blade mounted atop a six-foot ash pole to deliver devastating sweeping cuts. Its extended reach allows polearm masters to control battlefield space and intercept charging foes.
A formidable ten-foot wooden shaft tipped with a narrow armor-piercing steel spike. Infantry regiments brace pikes into a bristling wall to halt incoming cavalry charges.

A barbed ebony spear that flies with supernatural reach and strikes with extra necrotic damage. If the wielder rolls a critical failure, the cursed shaft curves violently backward to impale its thrower.

A versatile weapon of Krynnish wanderers featuring a pointed brass spear tip on one end and a leather sling fork on the other. It functions equally well as a thrusting spear or a ranged sling that whistles eerily in the wind.
An ancient spear tipped with jagged flint soaked in centuries of berserker blood offerings. Landing a killing blow with this spear grants the wielder 2d6 temporary hit points.
An extended polearm whose axe blade and top spike are electroplated with gleaming silver. It allows formation soldiers to strike werebeasts from safe reach behind sturdy shield walls.
A sweeping polearm whose forged blade mirrors the distant curve of the world's horizon. Its spatial enchantments allow the wielder to extend its striking reach across forty feet without moving.
A polearm whose serrated blade mimics the razor forearm of a giant golden praying mantis. It strikes with lightning speed, catching opposing blades to disarm foes with fluid martial sweeps.
A heavy crossbow fitted with a solar focusing prism over the flight groove that charges bolts. Loosing a bolt ignites it into a searing spear of solar fire that illuminates and pierces darkness.
A barbed polearm whose steel axe blade is permanently darkened by centuries of absorbed vital fluid. It inflicts bleeding wounds on strike and channels drained vitality to heal the wielder.

A sweeping polearm forged from sub-zero glacial steel that stays rimed with permanent rime. Striking an opponent chills their blood, dealing bonus cold damage and reducing their movement speed by ten feet.
A lightweight hand crossbow carved in the likeness of a diving peregrine falcon with swept wings. Firing bolts from high ground or while falling grants advantage and adds extra piercing damage.

Whenever you drop an enemy to zero hit points with this halberd, you gain temporary hit points equal to your fighter or paladin level. Channeling grooves along the heavy axe blade draw life essence into a crimson gemstone hilt.

Specialized skinning blades, bone saws, preservation jars, and chemical tinctures designed for harvesting beast organs. It allows hunters to extract usable trophy components and alchemical reagents from slain monsters.
A bubbling amber draught that radiates an intense, primal scent of an apex predator. Drinking it temporarily masks your human scent and causes lesser beasts to treat you with deference.
Dark ink needlework etched onto skin that depicts swirling shadows and raven feathers. It grants darkvision, allows the bearer to halve incoming damage as a reaction, and boosts stealth.

Sturdy leather-wrapped binoculars fitted with luminescent amber lenses tuned to beast trails. Looking through them highlights faint scents, disturbed foliage, and hidden monster lairs in vivid relief.

A polished river stone that stores a vivid emotional memory recorded by a Sensate philosopher. Touching the stone allows the bearer to re-experience the stored sensation, granting insight into ancient events.
A small gray fleece pouch that feels cold and rustles with animal fur inside. Reaching in produces fuzzy balls that transform into beasts like badgers, wolves, or panthers to obey your commands.
A wand tipped with the sensitive, twitching feathery antennae of an adult subterranean rust monster. Touching it to nonmagical metal armor or weapons corrodes the metal into useless crumbling rust.
A heavy spring-loaded iron cage trap paired with an internal chemical pheromone dispenser. It attracts predatory beasts across miles and snaps shut with unbreakable locking mechanisms.

Switching forms alters this weapon between a sweeping polearm scythe and twin handheld curved ripping claws. Chitinous monstrous claws and sharpened steel blades are bound with beast tendons and dark wax.

Bearing this brand allows you to track wounded foes across any distance and gain +2 to damage against them. An inverted hanging hunter rune is scarred into the palm, itching when blood is spilled nearby.
An iron spade inscribed with keystone runes of eternal rest that digs through earth effortlessly. Striking undead with the shovel deals bonus radiant damage and prevents them from rising again.

items.Properties / Flavor: Heavy iron cuffs joined by a thick welded chain, secured with an internal keyed tumbler mechanism. They restrain the limbs of prisoners, preventing somatic spellcasting and weapon handling.

items.Properties / Flavor: A sturdy glass bottle sealed with a snug cork stopper that holds up to one and a half pints. It stores wine, holy water, lamp oil, or volatile alchemical liquids safely.

items.Properties / Flavor: A solid iron lever with a flattened chiseled notch designed for prying open sealed crates and stubborn doors. It grants mechanical advantage when applying physical leverage against sturdy obstacles.

items.Properties / Flavor: A brass aeronautical compass that tracks atmospheric ley currents and brumestone altitudes. It keeps flying skyships on true course through cloud cover and detects planar storms.

The needle of this brass navigational tool spins toward the strongest concentration of geomantic ley energy in the region. Polished brass casing houses a dial inscribed with the elemental and temporal glyphs of Midgard.

A thick atlas filled with shifting parchment maps detailing planar ley lines and portal geometries. It enhances teleportation magic, allowing the caster to teleport as a reaction when targeted by attacks.
A delicate origami bird folded from vellum that animates and takes wing when whispered to. It flies tirelessly across Waterdeep to deliver a written message directly to its intended recipient.
A slender copper wand tipped with a trembling compass pointer made of magnetized lodestone. Pulsing with divination magic, it points toward hostile creatures concealed within sixty feet.

A polished brass medallion bearing the crossed crest and watchful eyes of Waterdeep's City Watch. When worn by authorized officers, it grants telepathic communication with fellow guards and ward alerts.

A complex brass contraption fitted with spinning gimbal rings and an audible ticking pendulum. It spins furiously and chimes rhythmically when within five hundred feet of an active nimblewright construct.
A square-headed dwarven warhammer carved with deep fault-line chasms that hums with seismic power. Striking the ground sends ripples through stone floorboards, knocking surrounding enemies prone.
A pocket watch compass whose silver needle floats in zero-gravity starlight oil. It points toward active planar portals and anchors the bearer against being banished or pushed into pocket dimensions.
A bell-mouthed brass pistol fitted with resonating tuning forks that discharges high-frequency sound waves. The concussive wave deafens enemies, imposes thunder damage, and knocks targets prone.

This wand holds seven charges to disrupt enemy timing, forcing targets to repeat or lose their reactions on failed saves. A spiraling glass baton holds an oscillating brass pendulum that swings at unnatural speeds.

Pinning this mechanical bird to your lapel provides a melodious wake-up chime at a pre-set time and repeats greetings politely. Tiny enameled copper feathers conceal miniature gears and a whistling brass bellows.
A spring-wound brass launcher that propels an iron grappling hook up to sixty feet with a sharp pull. An internal cog mechanism rapidly recoils the steel wire to haul the user up to ledges.
A brass surveyor's compass that automatically measures linear distances and topographical elevation. It assists cartographers in drafting immaculate dungeon and wilderness maps with speed.
A belt crafted from supple dragon scales that fastens with a carved jade dragon head buckle. It increases monk ki save DCs and allows the wearer to regain expended ki points in a surge.
A fist-sized stone carving of the Boros Legion crest that hums with martial discipline. Speaking its command word animates the stone into a loyal, fiery roc construct that fights on your behalf.
A velvet standard woven with giant war runes that whips fiercely in the wind. Planting it into the ground bolsters allies with courage, grants temporary hit points, and repels fear.

A leather eye patch embossed with the crest of Jarlaxle Baenre that rests comfortably over one eye. It prevents mind reading, grants advantage on perception checks, and sees through magical illusions.
Supple silver boots coated in frictionless liquid mercury that glide across all terrain types. They allow the wearer to ignore difficult terrain, sprint across walls, and disengage freely.

Allies within thirty feet of this hoisted standard gain +1 to attack rolls and saving throws against fear. Heavy scarlet silk is embroidered with the clockwork gears and rampant lion crest of the Free City.

When planted in the ground, this banner grants allied retainers and followers advantage on morale checks and attack rolls. A gold-fringed battle standard is emblazoned with a proud griffin crest atop an ash pole.

Fastening this banner to a lance or polearm inspires nearby allies with immunity to fear and +5 feet of movement. Rich scarlet brocade is embroidered with a soaring golden dragon and gold thread tassels.

A contoured steel cuirass fitted with leather straps to guard the chest and vital organs against piercing blows. It leaves the arms and legs unimpeded for maximum combat flexibility without noisy bulk.
Fashioned from the hardened exoskeleton plates of giant subterranean monstrosities and bound with sinew. It provides the protective qualities of breastplate while remaining completely non-metallic.

A finely crafted breastplate or scale shirt interwoven with protective elemental runes. It provides the wearer with continuous damage resistance against a specific energy type such as fire, lightning, or cold.
A curved broadsword carved from the massive ivory canine of an apex subterranean dread-hound. It grants advantage on tracking wounded quarries and inflicts vicious bleeding lacerations on strike.
A suit of copper-plated breastplate armor laced with conductive insulated coils and capacitors. It absorbs incoming lightning damage and discharges stored energy into attacking melee foes.

This stylish armored longcoat provides an AC of 15 + Dexterity modifier (max 2) and muffles the wearer's footfalls. Concealed chain mesh is sewn between layers of waterproofed charcoal wool and stiff leather collars.

When standing adjacent to an ally wielding a shield, both you and your ally gain half cover against ranged attacks. A large rectangular tower shield of banded bronze and boiled leather features interlocking side grooves.
A wooden broomstick bound with dried straw that hovers in mid-air when commanded. It carries up to four hundred pounds through the sky at speeds surpassing ordinary horses.
Heavy iron gauntlets etched with jagged barbarian runes that crackle with brute arcane power. Wearing them elevates the user's physical Strength score to nineteen regardless of natural prowess.
A crystalline flask wrapped in copper conduits that stores concentrated arcane magical potential. A spellcaster can tap its energy to cast a high-level spell without expending their own slots.
A fist-sized chunk of dark, unpolished volcanic basalt that feels extraordinarily heavy. Touching it to unworked stone summons an earth elemental that rumbles forth to pulverize your enemies.

A heavy leather-bound tome detailing ancient physical regimens and dietetic secrets of vitality. Studying the manual over forty-eight hours permanently increases your Constitution score and maximum by two.
An illuminated manual describing forgotten gladiatorial weight routines and martial biomechanics. Reading it thoroughly grants a permanent two-point increase to your Strength score and maximum.
A delicate treatise on balance, acrobatic footwork, and kinetic reaction times bound in supple lizard skin. Studying its contents permanently raises your Dexterity score and maximum by two.
A jagged obsidian shard that leeches color and warmth from the surrounding atmosphere. Activating metamagic allows you to curse an enemy with debilitating necrotic despair and disadvantage.
Spectacles set with translucent rose quartz lenses that emit a gentle, warm luminescence. Looking through them allows the wearer to cast charm person three times daily with charismatic warmth.
A heavy tome bound in hammered steel plates containing formulas for smelting an iron golem. Completing the four-month crafting ritual breathes life into an unstoppable construct warrior.
A thick stone-bound grimoire inscribed with chiseling rituals to awaken a stone golem. Finishing the eighty-day magical masonry process creates an immense, slow-moving guardian.

A grim tome bound in preserved ghoul skin that whispers sinister anatomical necromancy secrets. It empowers necromancy spells and allows the wizard to assume the chilling physical traits of an undead.
A leather grimoire studded with brass constellations and glowing lenses that track planar stars. It empowers divination magic and allows the wizard to alter the d20 rolls of nearby creatures.
A heavy leather-bound primer stamped with the scroll-and-quill sigil of Lorehold College. It boosts spell attack rolls and DCs for history and radiant spells, and grants temporary spell slots.

A masterwork silver longsword that resonates with the ancient choral melodies of bardic history. It grants cutting words reactions, boosts bardic inspiration, and lands devastating sonic critical strikes.

Inscribing this arcane symbol upon your skin grants two additional spell slots of 1st level refreshed after a long rest. The bloody rune writhes beneath the flesh like a living worm when arcane power surges.

Studying this sacred codex permanently increases your spell save DC by 1 for radiant and light-based magic. Golden pages bound in hammered sun-brass bindings illuminate the area with warm comforting light.

A water-resistant belt pouch divided into dozens of tiny compartments holding pinch-sized spellcasting materials. It provides spellcasters with all non-costly material components required for incantations.
A multifaceted cut quartz crystal polished to channel raw weave energy into coherent magical evocation. Mages wear it mounted in a pendant or wand to direct their arcane spells.
A brightly painted wand tipped with a miniature burst of carved wooden sparks. It discharges harmless colorful firework bursts, whistling sparks, and crackling sounds to dazzle spectators.
A thin glass wand housing a swirling ribbon of violet luminescence that crackles faintly. It discharges volleys of glowing darts of magical force that strike targets without missing.
A slender wand carved from blackened rowan wood wrapped in copper wire to focus combat spells. It increases spell attack rolls and allows the caster to ignore half cover when slinging magic.
A faceted blood-red ruby that attaches firmly to the pommel or guard of any simple or martial weapon. It transforms the bonded weapon into a spellcasting focus for the warrior's arcane spells.
A wand carved from petrified birch wound with interlocking silver chain links. It expends charges to paralyze humanoid targets with hold person, immobilize monsters, or assist in escaping bonds.
A pale bone wand carved from the femur of an owlbear and tipped with a screaming skull. It projects a terrifying spectral cone that causes enemies to drop their weapons and flee in panic.
A jagged wand forged from alchemical brass that crackles with sparks of static electricity. It discharges a brilliant blue lightning bolt one hundred feet long that electrocutes all foes in its line.
A dull grey wand made of petrified medusa flesh wrapped in lead wire. It fires a pale ray of encasing magic that leaves struck enemies completely rigid and paralyzed for one minute.

A polished brass wand fitted with a tiny quartz bell that chimes softly in the presence of mysteries. It pulses in the bearer's hand to point out secret doors and hidden mechanical traps within thirty feet.

An eccentric wand made of swirling iridescent mother-of-pearl that crackles with unpredictable wild magic. Using it triggers random chaotic phenomena ranging from fireballs and lightning to clouds of butterflies.

Awakened by an adult dragon's hoard, this spellcasting focus pulses with vibrant elemental energy. It increases spell attack rolls and save DCs while granting defensive elemental resistance reactions.
A pendant holding a Siberian dragonshard tuned to the bio-arcane frequency of a specific dragonmark. It enhances the magical abilities granted by the bearer's dragonmark and expands spell slots.
A cut scarlet and blue sphere that circles your crown while pulsing with raw mental focus. It permanently increases your Intelligence score and maximum capacity by two points.
A rod of blackened ironwood banded with spiraling silver wire that channels destructive evocation spells. It grants a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and allows the caster to ignore half cover.
An illustrious platinum wand crowned with a raw channeling diamond that focuses arcane fire. It provides a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores all half and three-quarters cover.
A solid starmetal tuning fork precisely harmonic-tuned to the planar vibration of a specific plane. It is the essential material component required to cast the plane shift spell.
A slender wand sculpted from flexible yew heartwood that feels warm and alive in the hand. Druids point it to direct primal lightning, healing winds, and thorny vine growth.
A slender tapering rod of carved hazel or dragon bone engineered to project magical energy. Wizards and warlocks point it to direct precision spell attacks across the battlefield.
This psionic focus increases spell save DC by 1 for enchantment and illusion spells cast through it. A swirling dark purple dreamstone floats within a delicate gyroscope of spun psionic copper.

A dense five-inch coin of infernal iron inscribed with diabolical torment script that holds a mortal soul. Tapping its agony fuels infernal war machines or provides temporary healing and telepathic secrets.
A heavy petrified boulder shard inscribed with the gluttonous haug rune of hill giants. It grants supreme resilience against bludgeoning attacks and allows you to double your body size.
A whistle carved from translucent blue crystal shaped like a perched lizard that produces no audible sound. Blowing it over a grave raises a loyal zombie or skeleton to serve as your undead servant.
A massive pavise shield sculpted from a single slab of cut quartz crystal that refracts sunlight. It grants superior cover, absorbs targeted rays, and reflects blinding glare to dazzle attackers.
A round wooden shield harvested from the heartwood of an ancient sentinel oak that never rots. It absorbs bludgeoning impacts, grants advantage against shove attacks, and casts barkskin.

A wand or orb tipped with a cut delerium crystal that crackles with unpredictable purple energy. It boosts spell save DCs and attack rolls, allowing the caster to overcharge spells with raw arcane fury.
A heater shield reinforced with a central delerium crystal boss that absorbs incoming magical rays. Deflecting a spell charges the crystal, which can be discharged as a retaliatory psychic bolt.
A thick, earthy brown brew with separated chalky layers that smell faintly of pine resin and mountain dust. Drinking it grants the user a climbing speed and advantage on athletic climbing checks.
A muddy liquid that continually shifts between shades of forest green and mossy brown. Consuming it allows the drinker to cast animal friendship to charm mundane beasts.
A violently shaking crimson serum that feels warm to the touch through its crystal phial. Drinking it causes the imbiber and their gear to enlarge to double size, boosting physical damage.
A shimmering, purplish fluid that mirrors the surroundings with kaleidoscopic distortions. It grants the imbiber the ability to read the surface thoughts of nearby intelligent creatures.
A milky, swirling concoction holding a small, preserved eyeball that floats suspended within. Drinking it allows the user to project an invisible sensor to spy on distant locations.
A vibrant golden elixir that bubbles cheerfully and tastes of honeyed sweet wine. Drinking it fills the warrior with temporary vitality and makes them immune to the frightened condition.
A light blue draught that floats weightlessly inside its bottle with translucent clouds. Consuming it grants the drinker an effortless flying speed for one hour of aerial maneuvers.
A thick, viscous silvery liquid that flows like liquid quicksilver within its flask. Drinking it fortifies the user's flesh to resist all forms of incoming physical and magical damage.
An amber draught glowing with radiant sparks that pulse like a youthful heartbeat. Drinking it reduces the consumer's physical age by one to ten years, restoring youthful vigor.
A yellow fluid that swirls vigorously of its own accord and radiates static electricity. Drinking it grants the benefits of the haste spell without requiring mental concentration.
A radiant red liquid that emits a pleasant soothing floral scent when unstoppered. Consuming this magical restorative cures any disease and neutralizes all active blindness and deafness.
A volatile electric-blue serum that arcs with static sparks across the inside of its glass phial. Drinking it grants lightning speed and causes your physical attacks to discharge shockwaves.
A muddy brown elixir floating with a sliver of hill giant fingernail that smells of damp earth. Drinking it grants immense physical power, elevating your Strength score to twenty-one for one hour.
A murky green elixir containing distilled beast pheromones that smell strongly of wet fur. Drinking it allows you to telepathically dominate any beast for one hour as if by dominate beast.

A swirling golden draught that sparkles with optimistic bubbles that burst with laughter. Ingesting it grants advantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw you make within one hour.
A bubbling multi-colored serum holding distilled essence of dragon fire, lion bile, and goat fury. Drinking it allows you to exhale a thirty-foot cone of searing flame that incinerates foes.
A thick crimson draught that pulses with hyper-accelerated cellular regrowth within its phial. Ingesting it restores twenty hit points at the start of your turns for ten consecutive rounds.
A dense gray potion containing suspended iron filings that tastes of crushed mineral slate. Drinking it hardens your skin into flexible metallic plating, raising your armor class to nineteen.
A silky black elixir that smells of cold night air and tastes of crushed winter berries. Drinking it grants sixty feet of darkvision and advantage on stealth checks for one hour.
A golden draught containing powdered songbird down that feels light and bubbly on the tongue. Drinking it grants advantage on Dexterity acrobatics checks and prevents fall damage for one hour.
A thick, muddy brown tonic that smells of rich soil and freshly turned roots. Consuming it grants a twenty-foot burrowing speed through loose dirt and gravel for thirty minutes.
A viscous crimson potion that bubbles violently with feral adrenaline when unstoppered. Drinking it grants temporary hit points, boosts movement speed, and adds extra melee damage on hit.
A glowing violet elixir distilled from dissolved delerium dust and pure alchemical alcohol. Drinking it replenishes high-level spell slots instantly, though it risks acute arcane contamination.
This metallic potion hardens your skin to grant resistance to all nonmagical weapon damage for two minutes. Heavy silvery sludge swirls sluggishly inside an iron flask, tasting strongly of cold iron.
A golden hilt that ignites into a searing blade of pure radiant sunlight with the flick of a wrist. It strikes fiends and undead with devastating holy power while illuminating darkened catacombs.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy flanged steel mace inlaid with holy sunburst silver filigree that hums with positive energy. Striking fiends and undead inflicts radiant trauma and disintegrates weakened foes.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A crystalline sphere that shifts between sunbeam gold and midnight violet based on the celestial hour. Touching it instantly informs the user whether it is morning, noon, dusk, or midnight outside.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A radiant sunburst tattoo etched across the chest that glows with brilliant golden vitality. It grants resistance to necrotic damage and drops the bearer to one hit point instead of zero.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Item Name: Orrery of the Sun and Moon
items.Properties / Flavor: An intricate clockwork brass model of planar celestial bodies rotating in harmonious orbits. Aligning its planetary spheres alters localized gravity and bends ambient temporal flow.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: An ancestral elven blade passed down through generations, acquiring unique magical runes from each worthy bearer. It hums with radiant brilliance and will only attune to heroes of righteous elven lineage.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: An alien sidearm recovered from crashed planar vessels crafted from seamless ceramic composites. Depressing the trigger emits a concentrated beam of coherent red energy that burns targets with radiant heat.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A crystal orb or holy token touched by the slumbering aura of a dragon's treasure hoard. It acts as a spellcasting focus that confers minor sensory advantages and elemental spell resistance.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A shimmering scarf woven from Bahamut's shed scales that radiates comforting platinum luminescence. Pulling off a scale produces restorative radiant healing, defensive shields, or holy dragon breath.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A golden heater shield sculpted with the blazing visage of a smiling solar dawn. It reflects radiant sunlight to blind attackers and channels holy smites to burn undead fiends.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A sentient sun blade crafted from gilded electrum that yearns to banish darkness and evil from the Underdark. It sheds brilliant solar daylight out to thirty feet and can cast lesser restoration to purge subterranean blights.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A magical breastplate fashioned by Therosian divine smiths that appears as shimmering liquid bronze. It melds seamlessly to your torso, grants fire resistance, and imposes no stealth penalties.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A golden two-wheeled war chariot sculpted with rearing pegasus reliefs along its curved chassis. When hitched to celestial mounts, it carries two warriors soaring through clouds at great speed.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A golden broadsword blessed by the high priests of Solamnia that shines with brilliant righteous light. It burns undead with radiant strikes and dispels fear from adjacent heroic companions.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy flail whose head is a perforated sacred censer burning with blessed divine frankincense. Striking an enemy inflicts bonus radiant damage and releases an aura of healing mist for allies.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy round shield etched with the uven rune of watchful protection and vengeance. When an enemy strikes you in melee, the shield releases a blinding flash of retaliatory radiant fury.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A radiant war carriage sculpted from polished platinum and sun-gold that hovers weightlessly above the ground. When hitched to pegasi or summoned steeds, it carries a full adventuring party soaring through the stratosphere.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: An illustrious golden diadem set with a blazing core of pure elemental sunfire that commands absolute reverence. It grants total fire immunity, radiates permanent daylight, and allows the wearer to command obedience from lesser rulers.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A matched pair of enchanted scimitars, one forged from morning sunlight and the other from twilight shadows. Wielding both simultaneously blends radiant searing slashes with shadowy life-draining necrotic strikes.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A golden heater shield polished to a brilliant mirror finish that sheds warm solar light. Bashing an enemy flashes blinding daylight that burns vampires and imposes disadvantage on attacks.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A heavy morningstar whose spiked head is forged from a jagged starmetal meteor fragment. Striking a target releases concussive radiant shockwaves that blast opponents backward.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A ring of braided solar gold set with a glowing citrine stone that warms against your finger. It grants radiant damage resistance and empowers sacred smites and healing spells.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A gilded bascinet crowned with a radiant sunburst emblem that blazes with holy solar light. It protects the wearer from psychic intrusion and projects a blinding aura that burns approaching undead.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: This golden talisman grants its bearer resistance to radiant damage and lets you cast daylight once per dawn. A radiant solar sunburst design is framed by gleaming carnelian gemstones.
items.Iconic Storefront: The Spires of the Morning Reliquary

items.Properties / Flavor: A masterwork standing harp fashioned from golden maple and strung with celestial silver wire. It enhances bardic charm spells, imposes disadvantage on saves, and casts powerful high-level nature incantations.
An exquisite tortoiseshell lyre carved with stylized water nymphs along its curved arms. It allows the performer to weave spells including wall of fire, wind wall, and stone shape.
A round-backed wooden lute adorned with knotwork carvings of woodland animals. It empowers bard spells and allows daily casting of fly, protection from energy, and animal friendship.
A three-stringed lutesque instrument carved from seasoned pearwood that sings with vibrant tones. It allows bards to cast faerie fire, entangle, shillelagh, and speak with animals.
A delicate flute carved from the hollow wing bone of a coastal harpy with mother-of-pearl accents. Playing it mimics enchanting siren songs that charm and draw humanoids toward the performer.

Playing this wooden transverse flute accelerates plant growth and charms natural beasts that fail a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. Carved from living honeysuckle wood, tiny white blossoms bloom along the tone holes.

Playing this slender bamboo flute summons gentle breezes that can disperse smoke or carry small lightweight objects through the air. Polished golden bamboo is bound with waxed red silk cord and tuned to pentatonic scales.

Playing this shrill flute forces small beasts and cowardly goblins to make a DC 12 Wisdom save or scatter in panic. A hollowed femur from a giant cave lizard is drilled with crude finger holes and wrapped in cord.
A carved pine talisman incorporating animal feathers, shed snake scales, and river pebbles. It channels the primal spirits of the wild to empower druidic magic without material components.
Ten feet of interlocking iron links designed to bind captives or secure heavy portals. It resists cutting weapons and brute force, requiring specialized tools or immense strength to shatter.
A heavy three-legged cast-iron cooking vessel fitted with a swinging wire bail handle. It sits securely over campfires to boil broth, purify water, and brew hearty trail stews.
A thick wool blanket and waterproof canvas layer rolled tightly with leather binding straps. It provides weary travelers with essential warmth and dry insulation during wilderness bivouacs.
Comprises hand shuttles, carding combs, spindle whorls, tension hooks, and wool-shearing snips. It permits weavers to spin raw wool, mend torn cloaks, and weave sturdy canvas tarps.
An articulated masterwork suit of interlocking, polished steel plates custom-fitted to the wearer's anatomy. It deflects heavy strikes with peerless resilience, though donning it requires assistance.

A suit of full plate forged from mizzium, an impossible reddish alloy developed by Izzet alchemists. Any critical hit landed against the wearer becomes a normal hit, and magic that allows a half-damage save deals zero damage on a success.
A magnificent suit of polished full plate etched with elemental warding runes along the breastplate. It grants permanent resistance to a specific damage type such as cold, fire, or lightning.
An exceptional suit of tempered plate armor imbued with permanent abjuration enchantments. It absorbs heavy kinetic impacts with ease, granting a +2 bonus to your armor class.
A peerless suit of plate armor forged from blessed starmetal and reinforced by ancient archmages. It offers virtually impenetrable defense, providing a +3 bonus to your armor class.

Gold-rimmed spectacles fitted with concentric rotating crystal lenses that analyze magical weave layers. Looking through them grants advantage on identifying active spells and boosts counterspell rolls.
A colossal suit of fully enclosed steam-powered plate armor driven by an internal mana furnace. It grants superhuman Strength, total immunity to nonmagical trauma, and mounted arm cannons.
A magnificent suit of gilded plate armor that radiates the pure warmth of the morning sun. It sheds holy daylight, burns attacking fiends with radiant retribution, and revives the wearer if downed.

This +3 plate armor grants immunity to lightning damage and unleashes chain lightning on attacking foes once per long rest. Crackling electric arcs dance continuously across cobalt-enameled full plate cuirass and greaves.

This +1 battleaxe deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage when swung with two hands and can crack subterranean rock formations. Heavy runic dwarven gold inlay runs down the wide steel cutting blade and reinforced haft.
A shimmering white pearl the size of a pigeon egg that pulses with concentrated weave light. Holding it allows a spellcaster to regain one expended spell slot of up to third level.

A small leather packet filled with sparkling, translucent gray powder that drifts weightlessly. Scattering it into the air turns all creatures and objects within ten feet completely invisible for minutes.

A pinch of arid white dust that instantly absorbs and condenses up to one hundred gallons of liquid into a tiny marble. Cracking the marble releases the full volume of water in an instantaneous torrent.
Enchanted needlework etched onto skin that holds the channeled matrix of a 2nd-level spell. Reciting the incantation casts the magic instantly, causing the tattoo to vanish completely from the body.
A luminous pink pearl held inside a filigree silver pendant that vibrates with enchanting song. It grants underwater breathing, a swimming speed, and allows the wearer to charm listeners with song.
A resin-sealed pinecone packed with alchemical flash-powder that detonates upon kinetic impact. Throwing it releases a hail of sharp pine scales and fiery sparks that disorient foes.
A fragile glass sphere containing boiling alchemical residue and pulverized delerium slag. Shattering it coats a twenty-foot area in burning violet residue that imposes severe contamination.

Swallowing this lustrous sphere grants thirty minutes of flight and casts feather fall automatically if you begin falling. A flawless silver-white pearl shines with the peaceful luminescence of the Immeasurable Sky.

Holding this luminous pearl lets you breathe underwater and swim at forty feet per round with complete natural ease. A milky river pearl glows with gentle turquoise luminescence that shifts like sunlit river shallows.

This unassuming cloth sack opens into an extradimensional pocket measuring four feet deep and two feet across. It holds up to five hundred pounds of cargo while never weighing more than fifteen pounds.
A portable cast-iron cooking brazier etched with magical runes of flame control. It perfectly sears and cooks harvested monster meats while infusing the dish with stamina-boosting nutrients.
A cylindrical brass jar containing swirling cerulean liquid that absorbs ambient kinetic force. The bearer can discharge the stored shockwave to repel attackers and deflect incoming missile volleys.
A hollow brass rod measuring a foot long that rings with a clear, resonating harmonic chime when struck. Sounding it magically unlocks and disarms mechanical doors, padlocks, chests, and chains.

items.Item Name: Gold Canary Figurine of Wondrous Power
items.Properties / Flavor: A tiny golden statuette of a singing canary carved with delicate feathers that perches in your palm. Speaking the command word transforms it into a colossal gold dragon to fight on your behalf.
Mechanical breathing apparatus implants fitted with miniature bellows and brass filters. They allow the bearer to breathe freely in water or toxic smoke and exhale gusts of purifying wind.

A dense brass orb etched with concentric orbital circles that can anchor localized gravitational planes. Dropping it creates a twenty-foot sphere of artificial downward gravity in weightless environments.
A matched pair of carved gold lion figurines small enough to fit inside a pocket. Hurling them down summons two loyal adult lions that fight ferociously alongside you in battle.
A heavy statuette of a bull elephant sculpted from white marble with ivory tusks. It transforms into a colossal living elephant capable of carrying heavy cargo and trampling enemy lines.
A statuette of a hound carved from glossy black onyx with obsidian eyes. It transforms into a loyal mastiff possessing darkvision, keen smell, and the ability to see invisible creatures.
A spherical geode of granite and amethyst that weighs fifty pounds and anchors physical matter. It turns your skin into stone defense and can petrify incoming attackers upon touch.
A jagged steel shoulder guard that attracts and harmlessly grounds stray electrical discharges. It grants resistance to lightning damage and stores absorbed shocks to empower your next melee strike.
A pear-shaped mandolin inlaid with abalone shell that produces melodious resonating notes. Bards playing it can cast cure wounds, dispel magic, protection from evil, and invisibility.
A teardrop-shaped cittern strung with brass wire that chimes with crisp, bright chords. It allows the bearer to cast barkskin, cure wounds, and fog cloud using bardic performance.
The most legendary of all bardic instruments, crafted from white ash and platinum strings. It unleashes devastating spells such as fire storm, Otto's irresistible dance, and control weather.
A supple leather sling woven from sky-falcon sinew that whistles softly when swung in circles. Stones flung from the sling are guided by howling winds that ignore cover and deal extra force damage.

Playing this celestial lap harp cures madness and allows the musician to cast calm emotions at will during performance. Flawless white marble pillars frame glowing golden strings that chime with divine harmonic resonance.

A heavy ironwood staff crowned with a gleaming crystalline orb that thrums with volatile arcane energy. It enhances spellcasting power, deflects strikes, and stores charges to unleash devastating spells.
A razor-sharp longsword forged from starmetal that snickers softly as it slices through the air. Landing a critical hit instantly decapitates any creature that possesses a neck.
Looming geometric scales and dragon runes tattooed across the ribs that pulse with abjuration wards. It provides an unarmored defense of fifteen plus your dexterity modifier up to a maximum of two.

A gigantic iron maul etched with storm giant runes that only the mightiest warriors can lift. When paired with giant strength belts, it can be hurled to release deafening concussive thunderclaps that stun giants.
A massive curved horn wrought from cold iron banded with starmetal that roars with primal fury. Sounding it summons an entire warband of spectral heroes to overrun the battlefield.

A wooden box containing horsehair brushes and jars of luminous, pasty magical paint pigments. Painting pictures on floors or walls causes the rendered objects and doorways to manifest as real physical matter.
A carved mammoth tusk horn rimed with permanent frost that sounds with the fury of howling blizzards. Blowing it coats battlefield terrain in slick ice and blasts foes with freezing gale winds.
A portable adamantine smelting cauldron that maintains internal magma heat without consuming fuel. It rapidly reforges weapons with fiery enchantments and grants immunity to extreme heat.

A blood-stained spear forged for Gruumsh's champions that vibrates with destructive martial bloodlust. It pierces through barriers, explodes in fiery shockwaves, and grants temporary hit points on kills.
Heavy interlocking plates forged from the metallic bull-hide of a slain iron gorgon. It grants immunity to petrification and releases clouds of petrifying gas against attacking foes.
A jagged shard of permanent blue ice etched with glacial giant runes of freezing fury. It wreaths your strikes in freezing blizzards and halves incoming cold and bludgeoning damage.
A long shadowy lash woven from the chill of the underworld that drags souls toward the grave. Striking a living creature drains their life force, healing the wielder for the damage dealt.

A thick dragon-skin scroll inscribed in shimmering starlight ink containing a reality-bending 6th-level spell. Channeling its formula casts the spell flawlessly before the hide dissolves into stardust.
An ancient gilded papyrus scroll radiating palpable planar heat from its stored 7th-level matrix. Reciting the sacred syllables unleashes catastrophic magical power as the papyrus disintegrates.
An opulent celestial vellum scroll containing deep metaphysical matrices of an 8th-level spell. Chanting its formula alters reality in an instant before the parchment dissolves into cosmic light.

The pinnacle of mortal scribing, etched onto indestructible solar vellum holding a godlike 9th-level spell. Reading its divine incantation unleashes multiverse-altering magic as the scroll vanishes forever.
A legendary weapon forged from starmetal that hums with supreme martial and magical perfection. It strikes with preternatural accuracy, granting a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

The legendary walking staff of Khelben Arunsun, housing the combined spirits of all past Blackstaff mages. It commands immense telepathic power, drains enemy magic, and animates Waterdeep's Walking Statues.
A colossal two-handed sword radiating a pulsing violet haze that warps surrounding spacetime. It cuts through solid matter effortlessly, landing devastating force blows that banish enemy buffs.

Stepping into this oversized wooden mortar allows the user to fly at eighty feet per round using the pestle to steer through the sky. Carved from a massive hollowed birch trunk, the wood is blackened with centuries of witch-magic.
A brass fob holding a miniaturized security seal that communicates with magewright door wards. Touching it to its attuned portal unlocks the arcane ward without requiring a physical key.
A parchment scroll inscribed with the arcane formulas of a 1st-level spell in shimmering ink. Reading the scroll unleashes its magic immediately before the parchment crumbles into harmless ash.
A masterwork steel kite shield reinforced with alchemical silver and enchanted defensive wards. It turns aside blades and arrows with greater deflection, granting an extra bonus to armor class.
A stylish felt cap trimmed with a peacock feather that shifts color depending on the light. It allows the wearer to cast disguise self at will to assume any humanoid guise.
A green velvet cap embroidered with silver bubbles and kelp fronds along its rim. While worn underwater, it creates a bubble of breathable air around the wearer's head.
A broad-brimmed felt tricorn hat adorned with an iridescent sea-gull feather. It keeps the wearer impeccably dry in ocean tempests and grants advantage on swimming navigation.

A polished brass circlet set with a sparkling cubic zirconia that projects illusory perfection. Wearing it transforms your appearance into an idealized, strikingly attractive human version of yourself.

A heavy brass diving helmet fitted with three thick circular glass ports and pressure equalization valves. It grants unlimited water breathing, darkvision, and total immunity to deep oceanic pressure.
A miniature brass pocket watch filled with whirring gears and tiny gemstone balance wheels. Once per day, its wearer can bypass the chaos of chance to treat an attack roll as an exact ten.
A thick band of warm copper inlaid with a glowing red carnelian gemstone. It grants resistance to cold damage and keeps the wearer comfortable in sub-zero arctic temperatures.
A thick band of hardened dwarven brass set with a gemstone attuned to a specific elemental plane. It grants the wearer permanent resistance against the chosen element's damage type.

A signet ring bearing the stylized arcane crest of one of Ravnica's ten ruling guilds. It stores a single utility cantrip aligned with the guild's philosophy and serves as an official badge of office.
An articulated brass gauntlet fitted with an arcane focus gemstone mounted directly over the palm. It allows an arcane caster to channel spell formulas while keeping their fingers free to hold items.
A burning red corundum stone that glows with fierce internal magma heat and flickering sparks. Cracking the gemstone summons a roaring fire elemental bound to obey your commands.
A band of polished electrum set with a radiant sunstone that glows with holy warmth. It grants permanent damage resistance against searing divine radiance and solar bursts.
A thick iron band carved with clashing clouds set with a resonant hematite stone. It dampens sonic shockwaves, granting the bearer continuous resistance to thunder damage.
A polished copper band set with a flickering mote of fairy light that dances playfully within a clear dome. It sheds dim light on command and allows the wearer to create minor sensory distractions.
A thick band of hammered volcanic gold set with a blazing fire opal that glows with ember light. It increases spell damage for pyromantic spells and grants resistance to fire damage.
Wearing this ring allows you to tap geomantic leys to recover one expended spell slot of up to 4th level each dawn. Spiraling silver and electrum wires interlace around a central uncut geode crystal.

Whenever you roll on a wild magic surge table, this ring allows you to roll twice and choose either result. A shifting iridescent opal shifts through every color of the spectrum inside an erratic bronze setting.
A slender dagger forged from an unyielding star-metal alloy that cuts through probability itself. Striking an opponent twists fate to impose disadvantage on their subsequent saving throws.

A curved dagger whose blade is fashioned from the iridescent, serrated bill of a marlin. Wielding it underwater eliminates all melee attack penalties and grants the bearer a swimming speed of thirty feet.
A polished silver crescent blade that shines with luminous moonlight, favored by archdruids and wardens. It grants a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls, save DCs, and adds 2d4 healing to curative magic.
A leather armguard fitted with empty silver dagger sheaths that never seems to run out of ammunition. Drawing from the bracer conjures two magical throwing daggers that vanish after striking targets.
A darkened steel blade set with faceted bat eyes along its pommel that hums with echolocation magic. While holding the dagger, the wielder possesses blindsight out to a range of thirty feet.
A volcanic glass dagger whose blade burns with the undying core flame of Imix. Striking an opponent inflicts searing fire damage and allows the wielder to cast fire shield and fireball.
A dagger forged from dunamis crystal whose blade flickers between past and future timestamps. Striking an opponent slows their movement to a crawl and steals their reaction for the round.

A compact stabbing knife whose steel blade is carefully electroplated with gleaming alchemical silver. It provides rogues and monster hunters with a discrete weapon capable of penetrating supernatural hide.
A versatile martial axe whose curved crescent blade is bonded with high-grade alchemical silver. It chops through enchanted hides and bypasses resistances during perilous wilderness hunts.
A colossal two-handed axe edged with thick seams of alchemical silver to maximize lethality. A single crushing swing delivers silver trauma capable of dropping rampant werebears.

A curved hunting dagger whose blade is fashioned from the fossilized digging claw of a dire badger. It grants a burrowing speed through loose dirt and deals bonus damage against burrowing subterranean beasts.
A foot-long fossilized fang of an ancient apex monstrosity wrapped with hardened leather straps. It strikes with primal bloodlust, dealing extra damage against beasts and monstrosities.
A blood-grooved dagger forged from obsidian that channels blood magic through its blade. The wielder can sacrifice their own hit points to empower spell attack rolls and increase spell damage.
A hunting knife whose blade is carved entirely from a single translucent purple delerium crystal. Piercing an enemy inflicts severe psychic trauma and disrupts their magical concentration.

This +2 scythe deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage to living plants and can cast blight once per long rest without spell slots. A blackened sickle-blade curves from a gnarled haft carved from cursed elderwood.

Hitting a spellcaster with this +2 dagger forces them to make concentration checks with disadvantage and expends one of their lowest spell slots. Its iridescent blade is forged from anti-magic lodestone that hums with quiet tension.

This versatile armament functions as a nimble silvered longsword or slots into a colossal two-handed stone maul head. A heavy granite block is hollowed to receive the longsword blade as its locking handle.

Forged from lunar meteorite iron, this +2 weapon toggles between a curved curved scimitar and a massive two-handed reaper scythe. Dark star-metal whispers softly in the dark and leaves faint vapor trails with every slash.

This hydraulic gauntlet fires a massive sharpened silver stake into point-blank foes for 3d10 piercing damage. Heavy pneumatic pistons and pressure gauges are bolted along a heavy reinforced steel forearm sleeve.

This legendary +3 greatsword unleashes crescent waves of pure moonlight that deal 4d8 radiant damage at range. A glowing aquamarine glass blade illuminates the dark with ethereal, cosmic luminescent brilliance.
A wand wrapped in sticky, silvery spider silk that never unravels or loses its tackiness. It discharges masses of thick, adhesive webs that snare and restrain creatures in a twenty-foot cube.
Steel-soled marching boots fitted with internal galvanic magnets that clamp to metal surfaces. They allow the wearer to walk upright across iron walls, ship hulls, and inverted ceilings.
A specially weighted arrow fitted with a barbed three-prong hook and fifty feet of trailing silk cord. It anchors securely into battlements or cliff edges, creating an instant climbing line.

This weighted net has an AC of 15 and requires a DC 16 Strength check to break, resisting slashing weapons without tearing. Spun from phase-spider thread, its gossamer cords glint with ethereal blue highlights.

items.Item Name: Hunter's Garb of the Blood Moon
items.Properties / Flavor: This reinforced leather duster gives AC 13 + Dexterity modifier and grants resistance to necrotic and acid damage. Weathered black leather is treated with alchemical resins and lined with deep crimson silk.

Unfolding this large bamboo frame kite allows a medium creature to glide through the air on strong coastal breezes. Sturdy oiled silk painted with soaring hawk wings is mounted on flexible laminated bamboo poles.

Expending charges from this wand casts create food and water or purify food and drink to nourish up to thirty people. Woven wheat stalks and hardened cherrywood form the slender body of this agrarian wand.
A sluggish white paste that depresses the nervous system when ingested with food or drink. The victim is paralyzed by lethargy, suffering the incapacitated condition for four hours.
Pure water sanctified through solemn clerical rituals in the name of a benevolent deity. Splashing this blessed liquid across fiends or undead burns their corrupt essence with searing radiance.
Heavy leather stitched with large interlocking iron rings designed for affordable infantry defense. While clumsy and heavy, it stops blunt trauma and stray arrows on bloody battlefields.
This slender, finely balanced piercing blade allows a wielder to strike swiftly using agility rather than brute force. A swept-hilt basket guards the hand against disarming strikes in duels.
A clear spindle of cut quartz that orbits in peaceful circles around your head. It completely eliminates the need for eating and drinking, sustaining you on cosmic planar energy.
A flanged iron mace shaped like four screaming terrified faces surrounding an obsidian orb. Waving it releases a thirty-foot spectral aura of terror that frightens and repels all opposing creatures.
A conductive silver javelin tipped with a jagged lightning fork that hums with ozone energy. Hurling it transforms the weapon into a soaring lightning bolt that carries the thrower along its path.
This icy wand holds seven charges to cast ice knife and cone of cold without requiring material components. A jagged needle of perpetual glacier ice is bound with silver wire to a driftwood handle.

Ringing this silver resonance bell calls spectral allies across planar boundaries to assist you in grueling boss battles. Fine silver filigree covers the bell body, engraved with ancient hunters' cooperation vows.

This fountain pen draws ink directly from the writer's minor blood prick, producing indelible scarlet script that never fades. A slender silver quill is tipped with a hollow ruby nib that channels blood cleanly.

Blowing this whistle produces three distinct harmonic tones that carry clearly across battlefield clamor up to half a mile. Polished silver plating covers a durable brass siren whistle fitted with a braided lanyard.
A delicate silver raven figurine that can be carried in the palm of your hand. It animates into a living bird that can deliver written messages across hundreds of miles like animal messenger.
Stiff leather armguards carved with flying falcon motifs and bound with silver laces. They grant proficiency with bows and add extra piercing damage to every launched arrow.
A finely stitched leather quiver adorned with embroidered leaves that accesses three extradimensional compartments. It stores sixty arrows, eighteen javelins, and six long bows without adding weight.
A recurve longbow carved from blackened ash strung with twisted wire that hums menacingly. Landing a critical strike with its bodkin arrows inflicts brutal, lingering internal injuries.

A small one-inch metal cube that expands into a thirty-foot-high adamantine watchtower upon speaking a command word. The indestructible structure features arrow slits, stairs, and battlement platforms for wilderness defense.
A golden recurve bow carved with decaying scales that hums with entropic necrotic energy. Arrows loosed from its string crackle with yellow lightning and inflict necrotic decay upon struck foes.
A cylindrical leather case equipped with a shoulder strap designed to hold up to twenty arrows. It keeps arrows fletched and organized for rapid drawing in archery skirmishes.

A golden longbow carved from the petrified branches of an ancient solar tree that radiates blazing heat. Loosing an arrow detonates a miniature solar flare that blinds opposing ranks and scorches fiends with holy fire.

An ethereal longbow carved from translucent celestial glass that gleams with the pinprick brilliance of distant stars. Arrows loosed from its string fall like meteor showers, showering enemy ranks in radiant damage.
A slender recurve bow crafted from flexible ash strung with woven silken zephyr breezes. Arrows loosed from this bow fly silently through the air, ignoring all wind penalties and heavy fog.
A recurve longbow crafted from living heartwood entwined with blossoming honeysuckle vines. Arrows loosed from its string trail fairy fire sparks that illuminate struck targets in glowing light.
A colossal recurve bow carved from the dense rib of a primeval subterranean titan dinosaur. It requires immense strength to draw, launching heavy ballista-sized arrows that knock monsters flying.
An ancestral elven longbow carved from the boughs of the ancient Ironwood tree that radiates wrath. Loosing an arrow wraps the target in grasping crushing brambles that restrains and pierces the foe.
A recurve longbow carved from bramble heartwood adorned with sharp protective thorns. Arrows fired from the bow sprout barbed briars that pierce armor and snare fleeing targets.

Arrows fired from this +2 longbow leave a slipstream of wind that grants following allies advantage on movement through the area. Sleek composite recurve limbs are strung with translucent bowstring spun from pure mountain wind.

This +2 composite longbow adds your Dexterity modifier twice to damage rolls made against designated enemy champions. Polished livewood limbs are painted with flowing runic tales of legendary elven cavalry ancestors.

Arrows shot from this +1 longbow transform into silent shadow darts that deal necrotic damage instead of piercing. The limbs are carved from flexible shadow-willow and strung with woven shadow-spider silk.
A waterproof parchment parcel containing volatile gray granules infused with Waterdhavian alchemical magic. It ignites with concussive explosive violence when detonated by fuse or spark.
Includes illuminated parchment, gold leaf, specialty inks, and fine badger-hair brushes. Scribes utilize these materials to craft exquisite diplomatic correspondence, heraldry, and legal scrolls.
A parchment box containing thirty-four illustrated cards depicting monsters, heroes, and beasts. Drawing and throwing a card onto the ground manifests a convincing illusory creature.
A folding fan crafted from polished mahogany slats and parchment painted with gusting clouds. Snapping it open allows the user to cast gust of wind to disperse toxic vapors and push back foes.
Heavy rawhide striking wraps reinforced with flattened iron boulders that pulse with hill giant gluttony. They augment unarmed strikes with bludgeoning force that knocks opponents prone.
A white feather that animates into a tireless messenger pigeon when whispered to. It carries a small parchment letter across hundreds of miles to deliver messages directly to designated allies.
A heavy coin of white gold stamped with the Orzhov Syndicate sunburst and weeping skull. It manifests as a flying gargoyle construct carved from marble that collects tithes and protects vaults.
A fist-sized fiery opal that burns with inner heat and can ignite weapons with permanent flame. Touching it to a weapon grants it fire damage or ignites an explosive wall of flames.
A masterfully forged suit of armor inlaid with enchanted protective filigree that shimmers in combat. It deflects strikes with superior resilience, granting a +1 bonus to your armor class.

A suit of splint armor reinforced with forged skillet plates and culinary tool hooks along the hips. It provides superior torso defense, grants fire resistance, and enhances the restorative qualities of short rest meals.
A dense bough of petrified pine encased in eternal glacial permafrost that weighs thirty pounds. Crushing a foe shatters ice fragments outward to inflict freezing trauma across adjacent enemies.
A vicious twin-headed battleaxe carved from the paired skulls and fangs of a two-headed death dog. Striking an opponent exposes their flesh to rotting rot filth that imposes disease and disadvantage.
An iron branding iron sculpted with the seal of the Inquisition that heats without fire. Pressing it against a creature marks them with a glowing brand that prevents teleportation and invisibility.

Fastening this iron gorget gives the wearer advantage on saving throws against being charmed and increases AC by 1. Heavy blackened iron plates form a high collar stamped with the legionary seal of conquest.
A slick, sticky black gel that coats skin or objects with an impossibly frictionless sheen. Applying it grants the user freedom of movement and makes them immune to grapples.
A gray, translucent oil that shifts out of phase when viewed from side angles. Coating your body in it shifts your physical form into the Border Ethereal for one hour.

Fine golden powder disguised as dust of disappearance that triggers uncontrollable coughing fits when flung. Trapped victims are incapacitated by choking spasms and suffer recurring suffocation damage.

A heavy iron cleaver whose serrated edge quivers when exposed to the scent of freshly spilled blood. It grants advantage on tracking wounded quarries and deals bonus slashing damage against bleeding beasts.
A concentrated wax ball infused with synthetic monster hormones that dissolves in warm water. Scattering the scent establishes false territorial boundaries that deter or attract wild beasts.
A glowing silver seed that pulses with pure celestial starlight when exposed to nighttime air. Cracking the seed unleashes a sixty-foot burst of radiant light that dispels darkness and blinds fiends.
A silver-flecked alchemical oil distilled from wolfsbane and consecrated spring water. Coating a weapon causes its strikes to deal bonus damage against werebeasts and prevent shape-shifting.
Crushing this runestone releases a blast of howling arctic gales that freezes enemies and creates a wall of ice. A smooth gray river pebble is chiseled with the ancient giant rune of winter storms.
A single-shot blackpowder sidearm fitted with an intricate spring-lock mechanism and polished brass barrel. It releases a thunderous crack and plume of acrid smoke to punch through medium armor.
Featuring a revolving steel cylinder holding six metal-cased cartridges, this sidearm allows continuous rapid fire. Its rifled barrel delivers lethal stopping power in gritty urban skirmishes.
A compact mechanical crossbow featuring a hand-cranked lever suitable for one-handed operation. Urban rogues and bounty hunters conceal it beneath cloaks for silent, deadly ambushes.
An advanced mechanical crossbow fitted with a top-mounted magazine feeding five bolts in succession. It allows rapid bolt discharge before requiring a full manual reload.
A mechanical prosthetic forearm forged from brass and adamantine that replaces a lost limb. It delivers devastating rocket-propelled punches and can be launched across forty feet before returning.
A multi-barreled sidearm whose rotating cluster of barrels allows consecutive firing without manual reloading. It offers four reliable blackpowder shots before requiring a full powder-and-ball cycle.
An articulated brass back-harness supporting interlocking feather blades powered by spring tension. Unfurling the wings grants sixty feet of mechanical flight and can buffet surrounding foes.

A masterwork mechanical apparatus of swirling gears and starmetal components that molds into any tool. It grants a +3 bonus to artificer spell attack rolls and save DCs while expanding magical versatility.

A mechanical clockwork minotaur figurine forged from polished brass and equipped with steam pistons. It expands into a full-sized automaton that charges enemy ranks with devastating labyrinthine fury.

An intricate clockwork owl construct fitted with polished brass feathers and rotating crystal eyes. It functions as a loyal flying familiar, transmitting darkvision sensory feedback to its attuned master.
