A mechanical forearm launcher fitted with an ammunition drum holding twenty harvested manticore tail spikes. It fires continuous volleys of serrated spikes that puncture through reinforced beast hides.
A palm-sized two-shot pistol engineered for concealment inside a waistcoat pocket or boot top. It provides a lethal surprise shot when captured or disarmed during urban social intrigues.
A long-range rifle fitted with a revolving six-shot cylinder and a wooden shoulder stock. It allows rapid consecutive rifle shots without requiring manual reloading after every trigger pull.
A massive warhammer fitted with an internal steam piston that fires forward upon impact. Landing a strike discharges explosive kinetic force that shatters armor plates and knocks foes prone.
A pneumatic pistol that propels two barbed dart electrodes trailing thin copper conductive wires. Impaling a target delivers debilitating electrical surges that incapacitate living creatures.
A circular steel shield housing interlocking planetary gears that spin upon mechanical trigger. Activating the gears creates a kinetic deflection field that knocks away incoming missile weapons.
An articulated brass and steel mechanical arm that integrates seamlessly into a lost limb socket. It operates with natural organic dexterity, cannot be disarmed, and houses a hidden tool.

An intricate six-barreled revolving pistol fitted with a central turning striker and brass grips. It cycles six shots in rapid sequence without reloading, making it deadly in close-quarters shootouts.

This double-barreled sidearm allows you to fire twice per attack action without reloading between individual shots. Precision clockwork chambers feed paper cartridges into blackened steel twin rifled barrels.

Winding this mechanical beetle transforms it into an obedient construct scout that transmits sensory visions to your mind. Polished brass plates and miniature spring-loaded gears operate six articulated legs.
A massive iron gauntlet fitted with heavy pistons and embossed with charging minotaur motifs. Landing a punch releases explosive hydraulic momentum that knocks stone pillars and enemies flying.
A two-handed energy weapon powered by specialized crystalline battery power cells. It fires continuous long-distance lasers that pierce through personal shields with surgical precision.
A futuristic two-handed heavy particle weapon that launches microscopic antimatter payloads. Impacting a target produces a catastrophic annihilation burst that disintegrates flesh, steel, and stone.

A sealed mechanical lobster forged from watertight iron equipped with internal levers and observation ports. It operates as an aquatic submersible that carries two medium humanoids across ocean trenches.
A ticking brass heart implant fitted with ruby balance springs and internal alchemical reservoirs. It stabilizes the bearer against fatal trauma and pumps restorative vigor when wounded.
A clockwork brass globe filled with crackling blue electrical conduits and glass vacuum tubes. It animates into a flying galvanic elemental drone that discharges lethal lightning arcs.
A brass clockwork apparatus fitted with whirling pendulums that measures the ticking flow of time. It allows the bearer to manipulate initiative rolls and force enemies to re-roll successful attacks.

A pneumatic shoulder-mounted projector connected to an alchemical naphtha fuel tank on your back. It fires a thirty-foot line of clinging liquid fire that ignites flammable materials and incinerates foes.

A heavy repeating crossbow fitted with an internal chronomantic pendulum and winding gears. It loops its own ammunition through temporal paradoxes, firing volleys of bolts before reloading itself from the past.
A rapid-cycling automatic sidearm fed by a curved thirty-round metallic box magazine. Holding the trigger empties a hail of lead bullets across corridors to suppress incoming infantry ranks.
A multi-barreled rotary weapon mounted on a heavy tripod carriage that is operated with a hand crank. Cranking the handle discharges hundreds of rounds per minute to obliterate charging formations.

A shoulder-mounted steel tube that propels pressurized alchemical rocket missiles across long distances. Impacting a structure or monster detonates a catastrophic concussive blast of fire and shrapnel.
An articulated harness of pneumatic brass pistons and steel struts worn over standard clothing. It multiplies physical carrying capacity fourfold, boosts jumping, and increases Strength by four.

A particle rifle forged from starmetal and aetheric glass that fires focused beams of antimagic energy. Impacting a spellcaster dispels their active spells and temporarily burns out their spell slots.
A long-barreled galvanic weapon powered by encapsulated lightning elementals in glass retorts. It fires continuous bolts of crackling electricity that pierce through multiple aligned targets.

A massive two-handed sniper rifle engineered by Percy de Rolo with an elongated rifled barrel. It fires heavy lead slugs across staggering distances, punching through reinforced barriers with lethal momentum.
A thick-bored handheld cannon engineered to launch miniature explosive blackpowder charges. It fires parabolic explosive shells that detonate across a ten-foot area in concussive fire and shrapnel.

This +2 harpoon deals an extra 2d6 lightning damage and can pull creatures up to two sizes larger toward you on hit. The jagged barb is carved from a colossal cephalopod beak fastened with woven sea-kelp cords.

Striking the ground with this +2 warhammer releases a shockwave that knocks surrounding foes prone and buries them in rubble. A massive block of glacial ice encases a dense granite core mounted on reinforced oak.
A portable assortment of brass calipers, micro-gears, jeweler screwdrivers, and soldering irons. It allows engineers to craft and calibrate clockwork curios and experimental contraptions.
An assortment of miniature tin snips, fine files, jeweler hammers, soldering flux, and copper wire. It equips craftsmen to repair clockwork gadgets, mend tin pots, and calibrate traps.
A sealed brass cylinder filled with stabilized glowing galvanic fluid that stores raw arcane charge. It powers experimental magitech contraptions, lightning weapons, and clockwork automatons.
An extradimensional orifice disguised as an ordinary burlap sack that opens into the gullet of an alien entity. Any creature or object placed inside risks being digested and destroyed forever.
A living bough of petrified oak crowned with blossoming green leaves that never wither. It serves as a formidable druidic weapon and casts nature spells, or transforms into a living tree.
A gilded shepherd's crook inlaid with glowing celestial topaz that radiates righteous holy light. It channels radiant smites through clerical spells and wards allies against fiendish possession.
A gleaming silver shortsword inlaid with intricate constellations of luck-bearing starlight. It grants lucky rerolls on saving throws and can even alter reality by granting a single wish.
A blackened charred wood staff glowing with embers that flare with heat when grasped. It grants fire resistance and holds charges to unleash burning hands, fireball, and flaming wall spells.
A translucent staff sculpted from everlasting glacial ice that never melts in warmth. It grants cold resistance and unleashes freezing spells including cone of cold, ice storm, and wall of ice.

The pinnacle of arcane craftsmanship, this white ash staff is wrapped in gold filigree and studded with planar jewels. It absorbs hostile spells into internal charges, grants magic resistance, and unleashes dozens of legendary incantations.

A twisted bough of dead grey ironwood that chills the air and withers nearby plant life. Striking an opponent expends charges to rot their flesh and inflict severe necrotic damage with strength drain.
A spiraling staff of pearlescent crystal etched with intricate astrological wheel charts. It taps into cosmic destiny to manipulate the d20 roll results of nearby allies and enemies.

Thick armored pelts harvested from an apex prehistoric behemoth bound together with monster tendon. It grants immense resilience against crushing bludgeoning blows and reduces forced movement effects.
A chunk of volcanic obsidian pulsing with magma heat and runic fire scripts along its face. It turns your weapon attacks into molten lava bursts and grants total immunity to fire.
A pale blue rhomboid stone that circles your brow while radiating kinetic physical energy. It raises your Strength score and maximum capacity by two points while active.
A bone staff topped with the screaming horned skull of an ancient archlich that radiates necromancy. It drains hit points, curses targets to lose spell slots, and bypasses necrotic immunity.

A slender staff carved from sacred white ash capped with a blossoming silver lotus. It stores charges to allow clerics, druids, and bards to cast cure wounds, lesser restoration, and mass cure wounds.
A thick iron-cornered grimoire inscribed with ancient dwarven warding prayers and defensive runes. It reinforces abjuration spells, granting the caster a protective ward of temporary hit points.

A gnarled staff carved from weirwood topped with a roaring dragon head, tied directly to Waterdeep's Dragonward. Touching a dragon with the staff allows or denies it permission to enter the city of Waterdeep.
A polished ivory staff carved with delicate winter rose blossoms that radiates freezing majesty. It bolsters radiant and cold damage, slows attackers, and casts cone of cold and wall of ice.

Carved from a living branch of Yggdrasil, this staff sprouts golden leaves that blossom with planar dew. It allows the bearer to cast plane shift at will, heal catastrophic injuries, and banish extraplanar horrors.
A tall brass staff topped with a crackling toroidal copper coil that arcs with high-voltage electricity. It unleashes branching lightning bolts, creates electrified barriers, and shocks attackers.

A tall staff sculpted from primordial petrified coral that channels the raw elements of creation. It unleashes devastating elemental spells ranging from chain lightning to fire storm and heals wounds.

This staff functions as a +2 quarterstaff and holds ten charges to cast animate objects, haste, and slow. Whirring brass clockwork gears rotate at the head of a polished ash staff tipped with steel calipers.

This staff holds ten charges to cast fireball, lightning bolt, or ice storm with unpredictable bonus elemental bursts. Four entwined rods of brass, silver, iron, and glass spiral around a central chaotic elemental core.
A polished arcane wand carved from ash trees nourished by the planar warmth of Fernia. When casting evocation spells that inflict fire damage, it adds extra heat to burn targets.

This wand repairs damaged constructs or broken mechanical objects, restoring 2d8 hit points with each expended charge. Slender copper rod is fitted with interchangeable miniature screwdrivers and delicate springs.
A brass housing designed to integrate into a warforged's forearm, clamping around any standard wand. It allows the bearer to draw and fire the concealed wand with a mere thought.
A silver crescent blade that shines with soft lunar radiance, favored by druids and rangers. It increases spell attack rolls, save DCs, and adds healing power to curative spells.
A sacred parchment manuscript detailing the exact divine rituals and incantations required to craft a clay golem. Completing the prescribed rites brings an obedient stone-crushing construct to life.
A brass warhammer whose head is forged from solid, radiant sunstone that glows with morning light. It strikes fiends and undead with devastating radiant force, dispelling magical darkness on hit.
An ancient wooden recurve bow strung with spun golden fleece that never decays or loses tension. Arrows loosed from this divine bow sprout thorny vines that entangle and crush foes on impact.
An incandescent blue sphere that hovers near your temple with serene spiritual luminescence. It raises your Wisdom score and maximum capacity by two points while orbiting.
A glowing teardrop of celestial lunar pearl that fell from the Moon Maiden's orbital cluster. It radiates cleansing moonbeam light, dispels lycanthropy curses, and restores spell slots.
A silver-forged lance created by the god Paladine to pierce the scaled hides of chromatic dragons. When wielded from the back of a flying dragon mount, it deals catastrophic radiant damage.
A legendary heater shield forged from pure mithral and embossed with radiant solar runes. It offers peerless deflection against melee and ranged attacks, adding a +3 bonus to armor class.

A sacred sickle forged from lunar starmetal that sheds pure silver radiance across darkened groves. It provides a +3 bonus to nature spell attack rolls and save DCs while greatly amplifying healing spells.
A vorpal greatsword forged from glistening silver moon-glass that snickers softly when swung in combat. It lands devastating decapitating critical hits and adds your Charisma modifier to attacks.
A slender silver diadem set with a glowing crescent pearl that shines with lunar brilliance. It enhances clerical and druidic spellcasting, granting bonus healing and shedding protective moonlight.

A war scythe whose curved blade glows with the ominous crimson light of a planar blood moon eclipse. Striking a target drains their hit points to empower the wielder's next attack with necrotic wrath.
A polished obsidian rod capped with an all-seeing eye forged from tainted starmetal. It significantly empowers warlock spells and restores an expended pact slot during short rests.
A dark, jagged steel longsword hungry for the life force of mortal creatures. Landing a critical blow against a wounded foe can rip their soul from their body to instantly slay them.
A heavy flanged rod fitted with six mechanical buttons that reshape the device at will. It transforms into an axe, spear, sword, ladder, or battering ram while providing versatile utility functions.
A heavy steel quarterstaff capped with multifaceted adamantite striking heads. It functions as a +3 magical weapon and expends charges to deal devastating extra force damage on hit.
A polished ash quarterstaff bound with crackling conductive brass bands and lodestone caps. It unleashes deafening lightning bolts, thunderous claps, and electrified melee strikes in stormy battle.

A rod of dark magnetite tipped with a multifaceted diamond that drinks in ambient magical light. It safely absorbs hostile spells targeting the wielder, converting the arcane energy into personal spell slots.
A fluted brass rod capped with an all-seeing eye carved from polished carnelian. It alerts the owner to hostile creatures, boosts perception, and plants into the ground to project a protective ward.

A scepter of polished gold topped with a crown of sparkling emeralds that radiates regal authority. Waving it compels obedience from dozens of nearby humanoids, rendering them completely charmed and cooperative.

A slender iron rod inlaid with silver paradise motifs that can access an idyllic pocket dimension. Striking the rod transports up to two hundred creatures into a tranquil sanctum stocked with gourmet feasts and healing water.
A thin rod of smoked volcanic glass that stays warm to the touch and smells of sulfur. Pointing it unleashes a bright red streak that blossoms into a twenty-foot sphere of roaring flame.

A smooth wand of chameleon skin and cedar that shifts color when held in the hand. It discharges transmutation rays that transform enemies into harmless beasts or allies into massive combat predators.

A drow wand fashioned from hardened fungal chitin that discharges pressurized sticky alchemical slime. Struck targets become completely restrained by clinging goop that dissolves only when exposed to sunlight.
A rotary brass cluster of six enchanted wands linked to a revolving hand-crank mechanism. Cranking the lever fires rapid-fire volleys of force darts that shred opposing formations.
A conductive copper spear wired with trailing copper cable designed for hunting storm dragons. Impaling a target channels atmospheric lightning strikes directly into the hooked beast.
A scepter carved from solid starmetal inlaid with diamonds, serving as the ruling regalia of King Hekaton. It commands the Wyrmskull Throne, grants thunder immunity, and calls down storm strikes.

A tarnished bronze feather blessed by the treacherous derro deity Diirinka that radiates illusion magic. It grants advantage on deception checks, casts invisibility, and allows the bearer to feign death.
A scepter of pure black obsidian capped with a pulsing fiendish eye that radiates eldritch power. It grants a +3 bonus to warlock spell save DCs and attack rolls while restoring a pact slot daily.
A jagged adamantine rod salvaged from the titan colossus Vonindod that vibrates near starmetal. Pointing it reveals the direction and depth of buried adamantine fragments within a thousand feet.
A wand carved from a white dragon's horn that exhales freezing mist from its tapered tip. It expends charges to cast ice storm, ray of frost, and wall of ice in combat.

A wand carved from the wing bone of an ancient red dragon that radiates crackling evocation power. It boosts spell attack rolls for fire spells and expends charges to unleash explosive fireball bursts.

A stiletto forged from dark shadow-glass that drinks in all sound and light within five feet. It deals devastating psychic damage, silences struck foes, and allows the wielder to teleport through shadows.
A wand sculpted from pure petrified delerium that hums with unstable transmutational potential. It expends charges to cast disintegrate, polymorph, and blight, warping the fabric of reality.

This wand allows the caster to launch three phantom daggers that strike targets within sixty feet for 1d4+1 force damage each. A spiraling steel rod is tipped with a floating translucent crystal dagger point.

Holding this rod lets you direct two allies to use their reactions to move or attack when you take the Attack action. Burnished gold fluting encases a central core of meteoric iron crowned with an eagle pommel.
A silk pennant bearing the colors and heraldic badge of one of Strixhaven's five college branches. Waving it produces harmless collegiate sparks, displays floating crest illusions, and plays anthems.
A brass canister fitted with moisture-wicking intake valves that condenses atmospheric humidity into potable water. It produces up to four gallons of pure drinking water daily in the driest deserts.
A heavy ceramic jug that gurgles with mysterious liquids whenever tilted on its side. Speaking a chosen liquid's name causes it to produce daily gallons of beer, acid, honey, or oil.
A garment that shimmers with blinding, psychedelic rainbow patterns when activated in combat. The dazzling display blinds attackers and forces all incoming attack rolls to suffer disadvantage.
A deep blue robe stitched with twinkling silver stars that glow like the night sky. It allows the wearer to pluck stars to cast magic missiles and shift into the Astral Plane at will.
A broad belt of hammered brass and cinder-hardened leather that radiates furnace heat. Wearing it grants superhuman physical prowess, elevating your Strength score to twenty-five.
A titanic belt of electrified blue dragon hide adorned with crackling lightning sapphire studs. It raises the wearer's Strength score to twenty-nine, granting nearly limitless physical power.

A colossal spiral conch shell polished to an iridescent mother-of-pearl finish that sounds like crashing tides. Blowing into the conch teleports the user and up to thirty allies directly to King Hekaton's court.

Silver boots trailing celestial cosmic dust that grant effortless supersonic acceleration. Clicking your heels allows you to dash across skies leaving a fiery comet tail that blinds and scorches pursuers.

A garment woven from living moss and elder oak leaves that sprouts seasonal wildflowers as you walk. It enhances wild shape forms, grants permanent natural armor, and accelerates regional land rejuvenation.

A ceremonial mask adorned with the preserved, writhing serpent hair of an ancient medusa queen. Looking directly into its crystal eyes forces opposing creatures to save against permanent petrification.
An experimental sidearm that superheats noble gases into glowing spheres of volatile plasma. Striking an opponent inflicts extreme thermal fire and radiant damage, melting armor plates.
A cloak of shifting black velvet lined with runic gold threads that absorbs incoming magical spells. It nullifies targeted spells and discharges the absorbed energy to amplify your next melee strike.

These robes grant a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and allow the wearer to turn invisible for one minute once per dusk. Deep indigo velvet is embroidered with shifting silver thread constellations that trace true night skies.
A bowed string instrument held between the knees equipped with six strings and tied gut frets. It produces deep, velvety harmonic tones favored in chamber consorts and noble galas.
Luxurious clothing tailored from imported silk, velvet, and brocade, trimmed with silver buttons. Wearing it is expected when attending high-society galas and visiting the City of Splendors' palaces.
A polished leather travel chest containing fine clothes, ink, pens, sealing wax, perfume, and parchment. It equips courtly envoys and noble ambassadors to conduct official guild negotiations.
These supple doe-skin boots adjust to hug the wearer's feet in total comfort. Your footsteps make no sound regardless of the terrain you traverse, granting supreme stealth during infiltration.
Crafted from fabric so gossamer and fine that it appears as transparent glass until draped over shoulders. Pulling the hood over your head renders you and your carried gear completely invisible.
An exquisite silk robe trimmed with gold runes that hums with immense, ancient arcane weave energy. It bolsters armor class, spell attack rolls, spell save DC, and grants magic resistance.

A silk garment embroidered with dozens of stylized, unblinking eyes that peer in all directions. It grants three-hundred-and-sixty-degree vision, darkvision out to one hundred and twenty feet, and reveals invisible beings.
A ragged grey cloak woven from the molted carapaces and silk of swarming carrion insects. It allows the wearer to transform into a swarm of insects to pass through keyholes and cracks.
A dark hooded cloak woven by Underdark drow from spider silk and infused with shadow magic. It grants advantage on stealth checks and shields the wearer's heat signature from thermal detection.
A crimson silk robe decorated with golden sunbursts that radiates a perpetual comforting warmth. It grants cold resistance and keeps the wearer comfortable in the most bitter arctic blizzards.

A circular piece of black silk measuring six feet across that folds down to the size of a handkerchief. Unfolding it onto the ground opens a two-way planar portal leading to an alternate world or plane.
A masterwork drow cloak woven from ancient shadow-spider silk that absorbs light completely. It grants supreme stealth, turns the wearer invisible in shadows, and hides thermal heat signatures.
A swirling grey silk cloak that dissolves into vapor around the hem when stepping through mist. It grants immunity to environmental fog and allows the wearer to step through mist as if teleporting.
An elegant silk garment woven from enchanted moth cocoons that shifts hue in the light. It projects subtle sensory glamours that confuse attacking foes, imposing disadvantage on melee strikes.
A gossamer cape woven from morning breezes that billows even in motionless underground chambers. It allows the wearer to send whispering messages across miles and float gently down from cliffs.
A crimson silk robe embroidered with gold threads that flare with embers when the wearer moves. It provides resistance to fire damage, enhances pyromantic spell DC, and retaliates with fire shields.

A tailored cape woven from dark shadowfell silk that blends into surrounding shadows effortlessly. It grants advantage on stealth checks and allows the wearer to turn invisible as an action in dim light.
While falling, you can spread your arms to glide horizontally up to five times your vertical descent speed. Translucent moth-wing silk catches gentle currents and shimmers under direct moonlight.

These robes provide an AC of 13 + Dexterity modifier and grant climbing speed equal to walking speed on sheer walls. Weave of iridescent underdark silk glides silently without snagging on jagged dungeon stones.

This breathtaking cape grants a flying speed of ninety feet and lets the wearer cast prismatic spray once per long rest. Billowing celestial silk glitters with countless pinprick stars that mirror real nocturnal sky charts.

While in dim light or darkness, this cloak grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and resistance to cold damage. Deep black cloth woven from the shadow realm seems to absorb ambient torchlight.
A plain, unadorned gold band that seems to fade out of visibility when left in shadows. Slipping it onto your finger turns you completely invisible until you attack or remove it.

A massive tower shield layered with the thick chest scales of an ancient chromatic dragon. It absorbs elemental breath weapons entirely, redirecting the stored energy into an explosive counter-cone.
A massive two-handed sword carved from the petrified leg bone of an ancient primordial behemoth. It deals maximum damage against objects and structures, cleaving through dragons and giants alike.

These enchanted bronze wristbands allow the wearer to command elemental creatures and resist fire and lightning damage. Ancient giant glyphs from Xen'drik are etched deeply into heavy fire-hardened metal rings.

Rubbing the belly of this ceramic badger figurine grants good luck, adding 1d4 to one ability check made within the hour. Glazed brown earthenware depicts a cheerful tanuki holding a sake jug and wearing a straw hat.
A supple silver birch branch hung with delicate brass chimes that tinkle when evil is near. It serves as a druidic focus, detecting aberrations, fiends, and undead within sixty feet.
A personal trinket such as a locket, doll, or key intimately bound to a specific Domain of Dread. Clasping the talisman while entering the Mists guides your travel directly into that cursed domain.
A broad green ceramic basin etched with frothing waves and sea serpent carvings. Filling the bowl with water and reciting an incantation summons a powerful water elemental that obeys your commands.

A viscous amber resin contained inside an alchemically oiled flask that adheres permanently to any material. Once cured over one minute, the bond cannot be broken by any physical force short of universal solvent.
A droplet of primordial water encapsulated within a tear-shaped pearl that never dries. Metamagic causes a cleansing wave to wash over you, moving you twenty feet and dousing fire.

A heavy broadaxe whose forged steel head is permanently stained with ancient, dried crimson blood. It deals bonus necrotic damage on strike and heals the wielder ten hit points whenever it slays a foe.
An ornate bronze trident dripping with cold brine linked to the weeping depths of Olhydra. It grants underwater breathing, cold damage on hit, and unleashes destructive tidal wall of water waves.
A colossal war scythe whose blade burns with cold, pale green ghost-fire that consumes spirits. It strikes through physical armor to hit hit points directly, dealing necrotic and cold damage.

Massive carved stone gauntlets sculpted from the knuckles of an ancient earth titan that hum with seismic weight. They elevate physical Strength to twenty-seven and double all damage dealt against structural objects.

This regal circlet grants telepathic control over aquatic beasts and allows the wearer to cast control water at will. Aquamarine gemstones are set into polished coral spires resembling an oceanic throne.

Ringing this ceramic bell calls harmless nature spirits that point the direction toward clean fresh water or wild food. Glazed white clay is painted with smiling spirit faces and hung on red braided twine.

A tasteless, odorless liquid poison distilled from belladonna that dissolves cleanly into food or wine. Ingestion induces severe internal organ failure, inflicting heavy poison damage and poisoning the victim.
Ten feet of thin linen twine wound into a small spool that fits neatly into a belt pouch. It connects bells to tripwires, binds bundles of kindling, or ties off severed sacks.
A heavy spiked iron flail head linked by silver chain to a leather-wrapped shaft. Striking a target discharges a deafening thunderclap that blasts opponents backward and shatters crystal.
A silver amulet sculpted into the likeness of a calm, dreaming human profile. It allows the wearer to detect thoughts and pierce mental deceptions using stored charges.
A stylized javelin shaped like a jagged silver lightning bolt that crackles with electricity. Hurling it transforms the weapon into a bolt of lightning that shocks all creatures in its path.
A petrified aberrant eyeball mounted in a tarnished silver setting that swivels unnervingly in its socket. Gilded rays of telepathic madness project from its pupil to paralyze foes in terror.
A chilled silver blade rimed with perpetual rime that emits sub-zero freezing vapors in combat. It strikes with biting cold damage, snuffs nonmagical fires, and grants resistance to fire damage.

A majestic suit of ghost-silver plate that seems to fade into translucence around the edges. Speaking a command word shifts the wearer into the Border Ethereal, allowing them to stride through solid walls.

A silver ring set with three sparkling diamonds that gleam like celestial stars in the dark. It unleashes dazzling starlight spheres, sparks of lightning, and shooting star projectiles against enemy ranks.
An ancient silver battle horn inscribed with Ysgardian warrior runes along its rim. Blowing it summons spectral berserkers from Valhalla to fight fiercely by your side for one hour.
A hauberk woven from spun clouds and silver links that floats weightlessly around the wearer. It grants effortless levitation, misty teleportation, and physical resistance to bludgeoning blows.

A floating silver skull construct enchanted with encyclopedic knowledge of the Great Wheel cosmology. It speaks with a sardonic Sigilian cant, lecturing its owner on planar hazards, factions, and philosophy.
A silver lapel pin shaped like a harp nested within a crescent moon, worn by Harper agents. It shields the wearer from mind-reading, magical location tracking, and non-detection divination.
A crystal shard glowing with the silver sea of the Astral Plane that hovers near your focus. Using metamagic causes you to briefly teleport thirty feet through the silver void.

A belt of woven silver clouds fastened with an iridescent white-gold buckle depicting flying palaces. It elevates the bearer's Strength score to twenty-seven, allowing you to lift stone wagons easily.

A flawless quartz sphere measuring six inches across that rests in an ornate bronze claw stand. It allows an attuned spellcaster to cast scrying to spy on creatures and distant locations across the realm.
A shimmering crystal sphere imbued with potent telepathic enchantments that pulses with indigo light. While scrying through the ball, you can telepathically read the surface thoughts of targets.
A fabled deck of vellum cards housed in an ivory box inscribed with fateful divination sigils. Drawing cards unleashes catastrophic reality-altering boons, ruinous curses, wishes, or immediate death.
A magnificent silver helmet set with dozens of sparkling diamonds, rubies, fire opals, and opals. It casts daylight, projects walls of fire, and unleashes prismatic bursts of searing energy.
A foot-tall statuette of pure silver depicting a benevolent raven with outstretched wings. It projects a protective aura of sanctity that boosts saving throws and cures disease for thirty feet.
A sentient greatsword carved from obsidian that glimmers with distant stars like the midnight sky. It devours the souls of slain foes, granting the wielder temporary hit points and their memories.
A polished kite shield emblazoned with the noble silver dragon crest of the Order of the Silver Dragon. It grants bonus armor class, boosts initiative for nearby companions, and deflects evil spells.

A silver spear shaped like a stylized lightning bolt that hums with the howling breath of Yan-C-Bin. It functions as a +2 spear that deals extra lightning damage, grants flight, and casts control weather.
A silver-bound manuscript describing secret monastic warding techniques and divine meditations. Reading it grants temporary spell resistance, psychic warding, and heals restorative hit points.
A silver brow band set with a third eye made of cyclopean crystal that hums with divination energy. It grants darkvision out to sixty feet and reveals invisible creatures and hidden ethereal portals.

Exquisite studded leather armor crafted from shadow-touched leather and silver raven feathers. It grants cold and necrotic resistance, boosts death saving throws, and sprouts spectral raven wings for flight.
A sacred holy symbol fashioned from silver and moonstone that radiates gentle divine warmth. It boosts cleric or paladin spell save DCs and grants an additional use of Channel Divinity daily.
A weathered monastic text filled with deep spiritual meditations and divine parables. Immersing oneself in its lessons permanently increases your Wisdom score and maximum by two.
A radiant platinum pendant emblazoned with benevolent sun motifs that warms righteous wearers. Good clerics and paladins can expend its charges to open a yawning fissure that swallows evil creatures.
A radiant spear of pure sunlight that dazzles onlookers and burns evil with divine justice. Hurling the spear releases a blinding bolt of solar brilliance that strikes targets without error.
A crude terracotta talisman bound with wild boar tusks that pulses with feral rage. It awakens into a rampaging stone boar construct that tramples opposing infantry beneath heavy hooves.
A jagged iron talisman blackened by stage pyrotechnics that smells of brimstone and burnt sugar. It transforms into a razor-clawed cackler demon construct that leaps into melee with manic glee.
A platinum holy symbol shaped like a raven set with a glowing cabochon ruby in its chest. It channels sunlight to paralyze vampires, turns undead, and dispels gothic curses in Barovia.

A miniature human skull carved from polished black obsidian suspended from an iron link chain. Touching it allows the bearer to cast dimension door repeatedly, though it risks teleporting the user to Avernus.
A holy symbol crafted from polished platinum and sapphire that radiates warm divine grace. It provides a +2 bonus to cleric or paladin spell save DCs and grants an extra Channel Divinity daily.
A sacred relic blessed by high celestial archons that shines with pure, unyielding solar light. It grants a +3 bonus to divine spell attack rolls and save DCs while replenishing Channel Divinity.

A spiraling lance of pearl and silver consecrated to the celestial pegasi of Mount Celestia. Charging atop a flying mount doubles kinetic lance impact and blinds opposing evil formations in radiant light.
A heavy spiked flail linked by consecrated silver chains that burns with righteous holy fire. It breaks concentration on spells automatically upon landing a successful melee strike.

This radiant medallion emits bright solar light and grants immunity to blindness and sunlight sensitivity penalties. A brilliant golden sunburst encloses an amber cabochon that pulses with constant solar warmth.
A small glass monocle etched with tiny playing card suits along its golden wire rim. It grants advantage on insight checks to detect bluffing and discern hidden marking on cards.
An ornate platinum brooch set with a calcified central eye of a true beholder. It creates a fifteen-foot cone of antimagic that suppresses spells and magical items in front of you.
A vibrant purple prism that hovers in mid-air and absorbs spells for later retrieval. It stores up to three levels of spells cast into it, allowing any bearer to release them at will.
A golden clasp sculpted like a hunting falcon set with a gleaming amber eye in its brow. It grants advantage on perception checks to spot distant movement and prevents visual disorientation.
A hollow stone nodule lined with sparkling purple crystals that hums with reality-bending power. Cracking it open unleashes a localized arcane shockwave that dispels ongoing spell effects.

A system of grooved pulleys and tough braided cordage engineered to multiply mechanical lifting power. It allows a single adventurer to hoist four times the normal lifting capacity with minimal strain.
A heavy chunk of magnetic iron salvaged from a sunken galleon that pulls maritime metal toward it. It grants a swimming speed, allows underwater breathing, and attracts submerged metal treasures.
A pointed steel spike fitted with a welded eyelet ring designed to be driven into rock fissures. Climbers loop ropes through its eyelet to establish safe anchor points along sheer cliffs.
A collapsible folding steel shield that expands into a five-foot-wide defensive wall when dropped. It locks firmly into ground flagstones to provide half cover for two defending soldiers.

Throwing this ceramic sphere up to thirty feet creates a twenty-foot sphere of dense gray smoke that lasts for one minute. A brittle terracotta sphere is packed with alchemical sulfur, pitch, and dried leaves.
A multi-masted caravel rigged with expansive canvas sails designed for deep-water ocean crossings. It carries dozens of crew members and hundreds of tons of international trade cargo.
A metal pot, cast skillet, carving knife, stirring ladle, seasoning shakers, and skewers packed in canvas. It enables camp cooks to prepare nutritious trail meals that bolster morale during rests.

This four-foot-tall wooden mannequin spars with weapon wielders for training drills and folds into a flat backpack bundle on command. Hinged ash planks and padded canvas strike zones are held together with sturdy leather cords.
A three-pronged iron hook forged with a secure eyelet to anchor climbing ropes onto battlements or cliffs. Its curved claws catch firmly on stonework to support ascending climbers.
A hollow wooden cylinder wrapped in stretched goatskin head secured with adjustable leather tension ropes. It beats steady martial rhythms for marching soldiers and drives tribal dance rituals.
A barbed steel spearhead fastened to a reinforced shaft and fifty feet of trailing hempen cord. It impales monstrous prey to anchor fleeing beasts and prevent aquatic retreats.
A three-pronged barbed spear crafted for aquatic hunting and gladiatorial arena spectacle. It catches opposing blades between its tines and pierces thrashing beasts beneath the waves.
A delicate downy feather that transforms into an immense iron anchor when thrown into water. It moors a boat or galleon instantly in place, resisting raging storm tides and oceanic currents.
A barbed spear carved from the serrated leg spines of a giant subterranean remorhaz. It deals bonus piercing damage and hooks firmly into monstrous hides to drag beasts closer.

A three-pronged spear that hums with a tragic aquatic enchantment when submerged in fresh water. It compels the wielder to grasp it passionately, granting a swimming speed while making them yearn for deep oceans.

Harvesting herbs or casting druidic spells with this weapon increases healing rolled on leveled spells by 1d4. Flaked volcanic obsidian glass forms a keen crescent blade bound securely to petrified ashwood.

Impaling a creature with this +1 harpoon creates a silver tether of light that prevents the target from teleporting or turning invisible. Luminescent lunar pearl is inset along the barbed titanium head and fifty-foot silver cord.
A translucent, bright cerulean liquid suspended with tiny, effervescent air bubbles that never burst. Ingesting this draught allows the drinker to breathe underwater freely for one hour.
Supple sea-green leather armor embossed with cresting ocean waves and kelp fronds. It grants the wearer a swimming speed and automatically floats an unconscious bearer to the water's surface.
A delicate glass feather that shatters automatically if the bearer falls more than ten feet. Breaking the charm casts feather fall on the wearer to ensure a harmless, drifting landing.

A coat of scale mail grown from living coastal coral that remains damp and vibrant outside the ocean. It grants swimming speed, water breathing, and retaliates against melee attackers with razor-sharp spines.
An arrow tipped with a fragile glass ampoule containing pressurized liquid freon salts. Hitting a target encases their limbs in flash-frozen ice, dealing cold damage and reducing speed.
A glass ampoule containing alchemical salts that neutralize the earliest stages of eldritch contamination. Snapping it under the nose halts contamination progression and removes nausea.

Crushing this volcanic crystal empowers your next fire spell or weapon attack to ignore fire resistance and deal maximum damage. A jagged ember taken from the Sea of Fire radiates intense thermal heat through its lead wrapper.

Consuming this mossy tea grants water breathing, darkvision, and cold resistance for up to eight hours. A murky green herbal infusion floats with floating edible moss flakes and tastes like sweet ocean kelp.
A menacing steel sallet helmet etched with terrifying angular demonic visages. When donned, the wearer's eyes glow with an unnerving, hollow red light that intimidates onlookers.
An ancient bronze helm embossed with open ears and sprawling scripts in forgotten tongues. It allows the wearer to understand the literal meaning of any spoken or written language.
A polished steel helm shaped like an owl with wing-like temple guards and crystal eyes. It allows the wearer to read thoughts, communicate telepathically, and cast suggestion.
A fully sealed suit of lead-lined vulcanized rubber reinforced with steel joint struts and an airtight helm. It grants total immunity to environmental contamination, haze sickness, and toxic gases.

Wearing this blindfolded iron basin helmet prevents the wearer from being blinded and grants thirty feet of blindsight. Crude beaten iron covers the upper visage with etched runic talismans to ward off madness.
A simple leather pocket fastened between two cords used to whip lead bullets or smooth river stones. It offers an inexpensive, quiet ranged attack favored by scouts and pastoral shepherds.
Dark tinted lenses set into a flexible leather visor strapped securely around the head. They grant darkvision out to sixty feet to characters who otherwise cannot see in subterranean darkness.
Supple calfskin gloves adorned with tiny silver bucklers embroidered across the palms. They allow the wearer to intercept and catch incoming arrows and thrown weapons out of mid-air.
A tan leather sack embroidered with paw prints that smells faintly of cedar bedding. Hurling its fuzzy pellets summons beasts including warhorses, black bears, and tigers to aid you.
Supple leather gloves lined with amphibious webbing and rough micro-hooks on the palms. They grant effortless climbing and swimming speeds without imposing additional movement costs.
A jagged shard of extraplanar obsidian suspended from a dark leather thong around the neck. A warlock can channel its eldritch resonance to cast any warlock cantrip with an arcana check.
Dark leather goggles set with obsidian lenses that filter out blinding glare and bright light. They grant sixty feet of darkvision and eliminate sunlight sensitivity penalties for subterranean races.
A sharp peregrine falcon feather talisman that fastens to an archer's leather bracer. It increases ranged weapon attack precision and eliminates disadvantage when firing at long range.

Peering through this brass eyepiece reveals the current hit point percentage and vulnerabilities of monstrous enemies. Cracked multi-layered lenses of magnifying quartz are set into an ornate leather head-strap.

Wearing this talisman grants advantage on saving throws against breath weapons and fear effects from dragons. A sharp drake fang is scrimshawed with draconic runes and strung on a braided wyrm-leather cord.
Braided hemp rope tested to bear hundreds of pounds of suspended weight over perilous subterranean chasms. It forms the backbone of any dungeoneering expedition for climbing, binding, or hauling.
A fifty-foot coil of sturdy hemp rope woven with subtle threads of gold silk. If severed or cut into pieces, speaking its command word instantly rejoins the rope together seamlessly.
Fifty feet of braided elven silk cordage that is twice as light and supple as hemp rope. It bears massive weight without fraying and knots smoothly for climbing and rappel drops.
Includes lead forceps, containment jars, neutralizing rinses, and specialized surgical needles. It equips apothecaries to surgically excise contaminated eldritch growths before mutation takes hold.

Speaking the activation phrase causes this fifty-foot coil of hempen rope to extend horizontally and harden into a sturdy bridge. Golden threads are woven through standard sailor's cordage with reinforced steel eyelets.
A wide mesh woven from tough trailing cords weighted at its perimeter with lead sinkers. Hurling it across a creature ensnares their limbs, restraining them until cut free.
A leather case containing twenty short, heavy steel-tipped bolts built for crossbow prods. They deliver devastating piercing kinetic punch when loosed from mechanical bows.
Twenty cast-lead spheres weighted uniformly to maximize range and blunt concussive trauma. They carry far more aerodynamic force than irregular river stones when flung from a sling.
A colossal two-handed sword featuring a blunt squared tip and a heavy, weighted cleaving edge. It delivers terrifying decapitating momentum, dealing bonus damage against prone or restrained foes.
An enchanted steel shield that magnetically curves incoming projectile trajectories toward itself. While it protects adjacent allies from ranged attacks, it curses the bearer to catch every arrow.

Oval ash frames woven with raw rawhide webbing that strap securely onto traveling boots. They distribute body weight across deep snow, allowing travelers to walk without treating snow as difficult terrain.
A massive two-handed sword forged with substantial weight behind its sweeping edge. It delivers devastating cleaving blows capable of splitting shields and unseating cavalry.
A pair of delicate silver shears capable of physically severing shadows from living humanoids. Snipping a shadow brings it to life as an obedient shadowy servant that mimics your commands.
Consists of quilted layers of thick linen batting and wool stitched together into a protective gambeson. While light and inexpensive, its bulky padding rustles loudly during attempts at silence.

A three-tined silver spear decorated with ocean wave engravings and mother-of-pearl accents. It allows the wielder to cast dominate beast to compel sea creatures and telepathically communicate underwater.

A bulky suit of pressurized fabric fitted with a fishbowl glass helmet designed for spelljamming air envelopes. It provides the wearer with fresh breathable air and thermal insulation in the vacuum of wildspace.
A rustic grimoire bound in swamp birch bark holding dried medicinal mosses and fungal spores. It strengthens necromancy and curative spells, allowing the caster to drain life to heal allies.

Wearing these greaves allows you to walk across water, acid, and deep mud as if it were solid stone without sinking. Burnished copper plates are styled after elongated insect legs with buoyant felt soles.
A glossy black raven quill with an alchemical split nib that writes without requiring an inkpot. It transcribes spoken words onto paper automatically and can write in five different languages.

These miniature brass chimes can carry a whispered ten-word message on gentle breezes to a recipient within three hundred feet. Delicate leaf-shaped pendants swing from gossamer cords beneath a miniature gazebo frame.

This cast-iron teapot brews an endless supply of piping-hot, aromatic jasmine tea whenever clean water is poured in. Dark pebbled iron is decorated with relief carvings of blooming jasmine flowers and dragonflies.
Strikes with this +1 rapier deal an extra 1d6 cold damage and ignore underwater attack penalties. Its blade is grown from sharpened pink branch coral bound to a polished mother-of-pearl cup hilt.
A heavy iron-capped timber log equipped with side handles allowing two adventurers to swing in unison. It delivers immense blunt force to batter down fortified dungeon doors and barricades.
A wooden cargo sled equipped with steel-shod runners designed for travel across glaciers and tundra. It carries up to one thousand pounds of expedition freight when pulled by draft dogs or ponies.
A small, shallow-draft river vessel fitted with a single mast and oars for navigating inland waterways. It carries up to twenty tons of cargo along winding river channels and shallow coastlines.
A rectangular wooden frame holding horizontal brass wires strung with sliding polished beads. Merchants and tax collectors use it to calculate currency exchanges and tally cargo inventories.
A wooden pack tree fitted with broad breeching straps designed to hold bulky cargo baskets and sacks. It secures up to several hundred pounds of expedition gear onto a mule or pack horse.
A cylindrical container fashioned from treated leather with screw-on caps to protect rolled vellum. It keeps precious nautical charts, spell scrolls, and maps completely dry in heavy rain.
A brass navigational compass whose needle spins toward the nearest active planar portal in Sigil. Touching it reveals the portal's destination plane and the exact key required to activate it.

A portable brass sphere with clockwork crystal rings that model the surrounding wildspace system. It tracks planetary orbits, asteroid clusters, and celestial gravity planes in real time for astral navigation.
A polished steel bascinet engraved with compass roses that connect to planar ley lines. It allows the wearer to expend stored charges to cast teleport across great distances.
A longbow carved from pale maple adorned with soaring raptor carvings that screeches when drawn. Arrows loosed from this bow fly with supersonic velocity, deafening targets on impact.
Includes pitons, boot crampons, a lightweight harness, and carabiner rings stored in a durable sack. It anchors climbers to sheer cliff faces to prevent catastrophic falls during mountain ascents.
A ten-foot collapsible wooden pole that shrinks down into a foot-long wand for easy portage. Speaking the command word extends a magical fishing line and barbed hook from its tip.
A barbed fishing gaff inscribed with Auril's frost runes that never loses its biting grip. Hurling it hooks firmly into aquatic monsters or icy cliff faces to haul prey across frozen waters.

A curved razor-edged skinning knife forged with a gut-hook tip designed for harvesting monster hides. It grants advantage on survival checks to harvest usable pelts, glands, and scales from slain prey.
A pneumatic pistol that launches a four-pronged steel grappling hook trailing hundred-foot cable. Pulling the reverse lever triggers an internal spool to haul the climber upward rapidly.
A spring-wound forearm launcher fitted with an iron hook and sixty feet of braided steel cable. Pulling the release trigger rapidly recoils the wire to hoist an adventurer up walls or onto rooftops.
A fragrant calico pouch decorated with tiny embroidered vegetables and jars of peppercorns. Reaching inside allows the user to pinch out any culinary spice desired to flavor bland trail rations.
A clear, tasteless drop that instantly purifies up to ten gallons of brackish seawater into drinking water. It eliminates salt, disease, and toxins to prevent dehydration aboard long voyages.
A dense bar of fine-grit abrasive sharpening stone used with oil or water to hone edged blades. Soldiers and hunters use it regularly to remove nicks and restore razor edges to steel.
A dark, rubbery leather cloak tailored with wide wing-like folds reminiscent of ocean rays. In salt or fresh water, it allows the wearer to breathe normally and swim with fluid speed.

A matched pair of smooth, fist-sized river pebbles carved with ancient paired dwarven runes. Speaking into one stone transmits a twenty-five-word telepathic message directly to the holder of the other.
An unpolished piece of moss agate that feels reassuringly warm and smooth in your pocket. Carrying it grants a +1 bonus to all ability checks and saving throws.
A suit of polished steel armor infused with a mild abjuration enchantment that repels all filth. It never gets dirty, stained, or rusted regardless of muddy dungeon treks or blood spatter.
A spongy, brown, marble-sized pellet that dissolves into a mild broth flavor when swallowed. It provides a humanoid with all the vital nutrients and sustenance required for a full day.
Hardened mole-claw gauntlets fashioned from the chitin of deep subterranean burrowing creatures. They grant a burrowing speed through dirt and loose stone, turning hands into deadly natural weapons.
A specialized weapon designed to integrate seamlessly into the forearm chassis of a warforged soldier. It can be retracted or extended as a bonus action, ensuring the wielder cannot be disarmed.
A polished wooden talking board marked with ancient alphabets, numbers, and an ivory planchette. Touching the planchette allows a group to hold a séance and communicate with local restless ghosts.
A three-inch cube of solid brimstone that radiates continuous comfortable warmth across a fifteen-foot sphere. It prevents hypothermia and melts snow in sub-zero blizzards without requiring fuel.
An agate that appears to be a stone of good luck until attuned, whereupon its sinister curse takes hold. It secretly subtracts one from all ability checks and saving throws until dispelled.
A brass optical scope fitted with crosshairs and range-finding reticles that clamps onto crossbows. Looking through the scope eliminates long-range disadvantage and boosts critical chance.

Placing this smooth river stone in a fire pit keeps the surrounding campsite warm, dry, and protected from natural insects for twelve hours. Faint runes carved across the surface glow with cozy orange embers.
Any liquid poured into this small copper kettle boils within ten seconds without requiring an external fire source. Floral vine motifs wind around the handle and spout of this cozy traveling vessel.
A heavy spiked iron sphere connected to an oak handle by a foot of sturdy steel chain. Its flexible linkage whips around opposing shields and parrying blades with crushing impact.
An alchemically charged steel club equipped with an insulated grip and capacitive discharge prongs. Striking an opponent delivers nonlethal electrical shocks that stun and incapacitate.
A suit of chain mail or plate forged entirely from lightweight, flexible elven mithral. It imposes no disadvantage on Dexterity stealth checks and requires no minimum strength to wear.
A set of carved bone panpipes that emit an eerie, mournful melody when played. Creatures within thirty feet that hear the tune become frightened and paralyzed with terror.
This magical flail alternates between dealing 1d6 extra fire damage on one strike and 1d6 cold damage on the next. Two spiked meteoric iron heads hang from frostbitten and heat-blackened chain links.

When you strike an object or structure with this +1 warhammer, you deal maximum damage and release a spray of molten slag. The blocky basalt head glows cherry-red along carved volcanic cooling fissures.

This iron cudgel deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and can ignite flammable unattended objects with a simple tap. The heavy striking head glows with smoldering coal embers that flare brightly upon impact.

Priming the furnace miniature cartridge on this warhammer causes your next strike to trigger an explosive fiery concussion. A reinforced iron hammer head houses an internal blackpowder percussion chamber and flint striker.

Fired without a bullet, this pistol releases a blinding muzzle flash and concussive soundwave that interrupts enemy spellcasting. An elongated iron barrel is fitted with an internal sound-dampening chamber and muffled hammer.

This spring-loaded grappling hook launches up to sixty feet and pulls the user swiftly toward anchor points or massive foes. High-tension steel cables reel into a compact hip-mounted brass winch mechanism.
Targets hit by this dagger must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or become paralyzed for one round. A curved yellowed tooth from a Darakhul ghoul is fastened to a leather-wrapped bone hilt.
A bottle of pitch-black liquid that absorbs surrounding candle flames when left unstoppered. Words written with this ink can only be read in absolute darkness or through magical darkvision.
A hooded brass lantern chased with stylized eyes that burns with an eerie violet flame. Its illumination reveals invisible creatures and hidden magical objects within thirty feet.
A faceted glass lantern that burns without fuel to cast a warm, truth-revealing indigo glow. Its light pierces illusions and reveals magical footprints left by planar travelers within the hour.
A brass lantern housing the preserved, magically stimulated petrifying eye of a greater basilisk. Opening the shutter directs a petrifying beam that gradually turns enemies into solid stone.
A tin hooded lantern that burns with a pale green flame that shifts hue in the presence of specific prey. Its light flashes brightly when designated monsters approach within three hundred feet.
A sturdy oak storage chest reinforced with iron bands and fitted with a heavy brass hasp. It provides secure dry storage for up to three hundred pounds of valuable treasure.
A trapezoidal wooden soundbox strung with dozens of steel wires struck with small wooden hammers. It produces chiming, harmonic music suitable for courtly recitals and grand tavern performances.
A water-resistant leather container designed with a hinged cap that holds up to twenty crossbow bolts. It straps securely to the hip or thigh for swift bolt draws in tactical combat.
An unglazed ceramic jug with an arched handle and pouring spout that holds one gallon of liquid. It sits on kitchen tables and tavern counters to store water, cider, or wine.
A lightweight rifle fitted with a shortened rifled barrel and folding wire stock for mounted skirmishers. It balances mobility with rifle range, making it ideal for cavalry and chariot marksmen.
A heavy oak box completely lined with quarter-inch lead sheeting to contain hazardous materials. It prevents delerium crystals from emitting contamination or being detected by divination magic.
A balanced wedge of tempered iron mounted on a sturdy wooden haft suitable for melee chops or throwing. Woodcutters and front-line reavers carry it as both an everyday tool and a vicious weapon.
A weighted aerodynamic throwing spike feathered with fletching to stabilize flight. Monks and skirmishers carry multiple darts tucked into bandoliers for lightning-fast ranged reactions.
A curved wooden airfoil shaped from polished ironwood designed for aerodynamic hunting. When thrown at a target, it arcs cleanly through the air and returns directly to the thrower's hand on a miss.
This returning curved wooden weapon deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage and always flies back to your grasping hand on a miss. Aerodynamic runes are burned into curved ironwood polished smooth with beeswax.

When dropped below half health, the wielder deals an extra 1d12 damage on all melee weapon attacks made with this axe. Crude beaten iron forms a wide bearded double blade notched with dozens of fierce kill tallies.
A smooth glass orb holding a miniature golden compass needle floating in clear oil. Holding it in your palm reveals which direction is true north, functioning even in deep subterranean caverns.
A polished spherical crystal attuned to one of Eberron's thirteen outer planes. Holding it allows an arcane caster to reduce incoming damage from a specific elemental energy type.
A polished silver hand mirror that reflects the dreams and subconscious desires of sleeping creatures. Holding it over a sleeping target reveals their deepest secrets and most vulnerable fears.
This palm-sized mechanical beetle scuttles on command and emits a steady warm light in a twenty-foot radius. Its brass shell features intricate filigree that glows softly while active.

Sounding this spiral shell horn calms turbulent ocean waves within a hundred feet and summons friendly marine life to guide your vessel. Iridescent mother-of-pearl lines the spiraling lip of this natural conch horn.

Gazing into this frosty sphere allows you to cast scrying targeting any creature that has set foot in saltwater within twenty-four hours. Tumbled sea glass glows with soothing turquoise light while submerged in clean brine.

Any beverage stored inside this flask remains ice cold or piping hot indefinitely regardless of harsh outside weather. Overlapping scarlet red dragon scales cover a sturdy dwarven bronze drinking vessel.

A bundle of fragrant dried herbs and sulfur blocks that burns with pungent white smoke for eight hours. It drives away biting jungle insects and disease-carrying mosquitoes across a twenty-foot campsite.
An expressive spellbook painted with sweeping abstract elemental brushstrokes from Prismari College. It empowers creative fire and water spells, adding extra kinetic force and elemental defense.
A sealed waxed-paper parcel containing dried jerky, hardtack, dried fruit, and hard cheese. It provides dense caloric sustenance to keep an adventurer nourished through one day of travel.

Dropping this miniature carved raft into water expands it into a real two-person bamboo skiff with oars for eight hours. A small token carved from dried bamboo displays tiny miniature paddles and woven seat mats.
Speaking into this polished geode records up to ten minutes of sound that replays upon a whispered trigger word. Tiny crystalline formations inside shimmer with faint reverberating sonic vibrations.
A spherical glass compass holding a glowing speck of stardust floating in zero-gravity oil. It points constantly toward the gravitational center of the current wildspace planetary system.
A series of graduated cane pipes bound together with waxed cords that produce breathy hollow tones. Satyrs and woodland bards play it to charm wild beasts and soothe restless companions.
A freshly harvested sprig of golden mistletoe clipped with a golden sickle under moonlight. A druid holds it to channel primal nature energies for spellcasting incantations.

The silver needle of this celestial device always points toward the nearest planar portal or astral rift within one mile. Polished brass casing holds a face engraved with ancient constellations and starmaps.

This versatile steel blade features a double-edged design suitable for slashing or thrusting with one or two hands. It is standard military armament favored by guards and knights across the Sword Coast.
A compact steel blade designed for close-quarters fighting, quick concealment, or precision throwing. It serves equally well as a reliable camp utility tool or a deadly off-hand weapon.
A short curved crescent blade originally designed for harvesting grains and wild herbs. Druids and rural folk wield it in close combat to deliver hooking, flesh-tearing slashes.
A dense steel ball studded with vicious spikes affixed to a reinforced metal haft. It delivers puncture wounds combined with blunt trauma to bypass heavy layers of padding.
A sharp, pointed curved beak of hardened steel designed specifically to puncture heavy plate. Sapper units and cavalrymen use it to deliver concentrated kinetic strikes through rigid metal.
A triangular steel spike designed to lock securely over the muzzle of a firearm. It transforms a ranged blackpowder weapon into a formidable thrusting spear during close melee emergencies.
A silvered steel longsword that glows with the soft, ethereal brilliance of moonlight in darkness. It sheds bright moonlight across a fifteen-foot radius to reveal lurking nocturnal predators.
A single-handed front-loading firearm fitted with a flint striker and a flared steel muzzle. It offers a lethal close-range opening shot before drawing a melee blade in gritty duels.

A traditional Chultan short stabbing spear consisting of a three-foot wooden shaft fitted with an eighteen-inch steel blade. It delivers devastating thrusts in close-quarters skirmishes and can be hurled short distances.

A heavy steel longsword serrated with jagged iron spikes engineered to splinter enemy armaments. Striking a nonmagical weapon or object lands automatic critical hits to shatter shields and sunder structural barricades.
A sinister blade carved from dark meteor steel that drinks in the vital warmth of living flesh. Scoring a critical hit deals extra necrotic damage and grants the wielder ten temporary hit points.
A broad curved steel axe blade mounted on a reinforced wooden haft designed for one or two-handed swings. It serves as traditional dwarven and vanguard infantry armament across Faerûn.
A steel longsword professionally plated with pure alchemical silver along its double-edged cutting surface. It bypasses the damage immunities of lycanthropes, devils, and incorporeal wraiths.
A curved steel blade etched with divination constellations along its central fuller. Piercing a target grants glimpses of their next attack, allowing the wielder to parry with uncanny foresight.
A lightning-etched longsword forged from conductive starmetal that roars with thunderstorm winds. Striking a target discharges branching lightning arcs that jump to shock adjacent enemies.
A blackened steel blade etched with midnight moonstones along its fuller that absorbs ambient sound. Attacks made with this dagger create a sphere of silence that prevents victims from crying out.
A bearded battleaxe forged in glacial dwarven holds whose steel blade stays coated in biting frost. Striking a target inflicts severe cold damage and coats their armor in heavy, encumbering ice.

A steel longsword whose cutting edge is embedded with jagged violet delerium crystal shards. It strikes with volatile eldritch force, dealing bonus psychic damage and cutting through abjuration wards.

This +2 greatsword deals an extra 2d6 cold damage and can freeze standing water into ice sheets beneath your boots. Glacial blue steel carries a permanent frost sheen that chills the air around its massive blade.

This +1 longsword grants advantage on initiative rolls and allows the wielder to issue a tactical commander's strike as a bonus action. Traditional kech sharaat craftsmanship balances razor edges with a wide protective crossguard.

This +1 longsword deals an additional 1d6 psychic damage and can sever ethereal silver cords on a critical strike. The blade is carved from resonant purple-tinged crysteel quartz that rings when drawn.

You can use a bonus action to transform this weapon between a fast serrated short-cleaver and an extended reach long-blade. Jagged steel teeth line the heavy curved head, hinged to an iron-wrapped handle.

Whenever you reduce a minion or low-tier foe to zero hit points, any leftover damage carries over to another adjacent enemy. A broad cleaving blade of tempered steel features a thick reinforced spine and leather grip.
A durable waxed canvas pack equipped with leather shoulder straps and external tie-down loops. It holds up to thirty pounds of expedition gear while distributing weight evenly across the back.

A rugged leather backpack fitted with two side pouches and an expansive central extradimensional compartment. Whatever item you reach for always springs directly to the top of the pack for instant retrieval.
A satchel holding a blanket, ten candles, a tinderbox, an alms box, blocks of incense, and vestments. It equips itinerant clerics and paladins to conduct holy rites, blessings, and funerary rituals.

A leather satchel containing a book of historical lore, ink bottles, pens, sheets of parchment, and sand. It provides researchers and arcane apprentices with the tools needed to record field observations.
A leather-bound volume containing eighty blank sheets of pressed vellum stitched with linen cord. Scholars and explorers use it to record expedition journals, anatomical sketches, or maps.
A tightly folded silk canopy packed inside a canvas backpack equipped with a quick-release rip cord. Pulling the cord while falling slows descent rate to safe speeds, preventing falling damage.
A broad forged iron spade fixed to a reinforced ash handle for clearing earth and digging trenches. Explorers utilize it to unearth buried ruins, dig fortifications, or excavate treasure caches.
An iron judicial mallet inscribed with the Venn rune of friendship and truth. Striking it creates an impenetrable dome of protective force that shields companions from missile barrages.
A wooden tool roll holding saws, hand planes, chisels, an adze, claw hammer, and measuring squares. It allows carpenters to construct wooden barricades, repair carts, and frame shelters.
A velvet pouch holding jeweler's saws, micro-calipers, gemstone tweezers, magnifying loupes, and burnishers. It equips lapidaries to cut gemstones, assay precious jewelry, and set arcane foci.
A roll containing rotary leather cutters, edge bevelers, stitching groovers, mallets, and punch needles. It allows crafters to tailor leather armor, repair saddle straps, and shape scabbards.
Includes wooden potter's ribs, wire clay cutters, trimming tools, loop blades, and sculpting sponges. It allows artisans to throw ceramic storage jars, cooking pots, and alchemical alembics.
A set of gouges, curved carving knives, micro-rasps, and sharpening whetstones in a leather sleeve. It allows woodworkers to carve wooden holy symbols, sculpt wands, and fletch arrows.
A heavy two-handed iron sledgehammer designed to deliver concussive structural demolition blows. Miners and sappers use it to break stone boulders, crack masonry, and drive foundation piles.
A heavy forged iron pickaxe with a pointed beak on one end and a broad chisel on the other. Miners use it to quarry ore veins, chip through cavern stone, and excavate cave-ins.

This +1 pick deals double damage against stone constructs and can punch through solid rock walls with surprising ease. A reinforced pick-axe head of tempered dark iron is balanced by a blunt hammer face on a heavy haft.
A lightweight river vessel crafted from cedar ribs and waterproofed birch bark that carries up to six passengers. It navigates shallow jungle rapids easily and can be portaged between waterways.
A hardy desert pack animal capable of carrying heavy freight across scorching dunes for days without water. It serves caravan routes traversing the Anauroch desert with endurance.
A simple two-wheeled wooden wagon designed to be pulled by a single draft horse, mule, or ox. It carries up to two hundred pounds of produce or expedition equipment over rough dirt roads.
A formidable warship propelled by multiple tiers of rowing oars alongside square-rigged sails. It features reinforced naval rams and fighting decks designed to board opposing sea vessels.
A simple wooden dinghy fitted with two wooden oars and rowlocks, carrying up to three passengers. Ships carry them as shore landing craft, and fishermen row them across calm harbor waters.
A tapered, heavy wooden cavalry weapon built to channel the full kinetic momentum of a galloping mount. It pierces heavily armored knights at full tilt, though it proves cumbersome when unmounted.
A thick-furred northern husky trained to pull heavy sleds through sub-zero blizzards and mountain passes. Highly loyal and resilient, a team of dogs can haul cargo across frozen wastes for days.
A fist-sized bronze carving of a regal griffon rearing with outstretched talons. Speaking its command word transforms the figurine into a living griffon mount for up to six hours.
Three goat figurines carved from polished ivory, each with unique horns and posture. They transform into a swift traveling mount, a combat battering goat, or a giant terrorizing steed.
A black glass carving of a rearing stallion that feels cold and sharp to the touch. It transforms into an obedient nightmare mount that flies across planar skies and ethereal realms.
A green serpentine stone carving of a perched owl with wide observant eyes. It animates into either a normal scouting owl or a giant flying owl capable of serving as an aerial mount.
A sure-footed beast of burden known for stubborn resilience and load-bearing stamina along steep mountain paths. It hauls up to four hundred and twenty pounds of mining gear or treasure.
A swift, agile equine bred for overland travel, courier dispatch, and light scouting. It covers great distances daily at a rapid trot, though it lacks heavy combat training.
A stout, short horse perfectly proportioned to serve as a mount for dwarves, gnomes, and halflings. It navigates tight subterranean tunnels and mountain switchbacks with sure-footed stability.
A magnificent armored equine trained specifically to charge into the chaos and clamor of melee combat. It wears barding comfortably and tramples fallen foes with crushing iron-shod hooves.
A heavy blanket of interlocking steel rings draped over a quilted gambeson to armor a war mount. It shields the horse's flank and chest against slicing blades during cavalry charges.

Speaking the command word transforms this ivory figurine into a skeletal warhorse mount for up to eight hours once per week. Carved from mammoth tusk, the miniature equine sculpture has hollow ruby eyes.
A green feather inscribed with arboreal runes that erupts into a sixty-foot oak tree when planted. The instantaneous wooden trunk provides instant elevation, climbing holds, or barricade cover.

A petrified heart of rough obsidian that pulses with subterranean mineral vibrations when held. Placing it against your chest grants total immunity to petrification and turns your skin into resilient living granite.

This staff lets you cast pass without trace, spike growth, and tree stride to navigate ancient virgin woodlands. Polished white birch wood is capped with a clear river quartz wrapped in silvered bramble vines.

A massive two-handed sword carved from a single volcanic obsidian glass spire banded with gold. It lands razor-sharp critical strikes that inflict lingering bleeding wounds and shatter wooden shields.

This +1 double-bladed scimitar allows the wielder to make an extra bonus action strike dealing 1d4 slashing damage. Dual curved steel blades are attached to a central wood haft bound in Valenar horsehair.
A sturdy four-wheeled freight hauler built with high wooden slat walls and a driver's bench. Pulled by a team of draft horses, it transports bulk expedition supplies across long trade roads.
A broad wooden disc rimmed with iron and strapped to the forearm to parry melee strikes and catch missile fire. It grants essential defensive warding to any warrior holding the line.

A wooden buckler reinforced with iron bands and centered with a sharp, protruding nine-inch steel spike. It allows a skilled defender to bash opponents in melee, dealing piercing damage during close skirmishes.

A custom-tailored suit of boiled leather armor fitted with articulated joints to protect an equine mount. It provides essential protection against arrows and glancing cuts without overburdening the beast.
Articulated polished steel plates custom-forged to fit a warhorse's neck, head, and flanks. It transforms a noble steed into an armored juggernaut capable of shattering enemy spear lines.

These robes provide AC 13 + Dexterity modifier and grant immunity to the suffocation and vacuum penalties of outer planes. Swirling fabric woven from astral dark-matter flutters as if touched by cosmic winds.
A belt of tough red dragon leather fastened with a carved jade buckle depicting a coiled lung dragon. It provides a +2 bonus to monk ki save DCs and allows the wearer to regain ki in a surge.
A soft leather or drawstring cloth pouch that cinches tightly around a traveling belt. It stores up to twenty coins, spell components, sling stones, or small gemstones safely.
A thick belt of cured mammoth hide fastened with an iron buckle depicting a hill giant skull. It surges with primal vigor that elevates the wearer's physical strength to superhuman levels.
Crude armor fashioned from thick tanned pelts and cured hides of monstrous beasts. Barbarians and wilderness nomads wear it for essential torso protection without needing forged metal.
A suit of wild leather armor crafted from the pelt of an apex beast guardian that pulses with primal rage. It enhances wild shape forms, grants regeneration, and turns physical attacks aside.
A broad belt of cured ram-hide studded with heavy slate stones that grounds the wearer firmly to the earth. It prevents the bearer from being knocked prone, pushed, or grappled against their will.
Heavy combat boots crafted from thick green basilisk leather with stone-shod heels. They grant the wearer immunity to petrification and allow them to walk upright across treacherous scree.
A compact water-resistant canvas pack holding a hammock, camouflage tarp, snares, and field rations. It equips woodland rangers and scouts to survive comfortably in dense forest canopies.
A polished band of woven platinum inlaid with protective runes that gleam with soft luminescence. Wearing it envelops the user in a continuous ward that deflects attacks and resists spells.
A flat-ended iron rod featuring a small push button recessed into one end of its grip. Depressing the button anchors the rod in mid-air against thousands of pounds of applied force.
A thick glass vial filled with corrosive yellowish fluid that hisses when exposed to moisture. Hurling it splashes caustic liquid that dissolves organic matter and burns flesh on contact.
A whimsical brass pendant shaped like a sleeping feline filled with dried aromatic catmint leaves. It charms mundane felines and grants its wearer subtle feline grace and balance.
A massive, intelligent pachyderm trained to carry war howdahs and trample opposing battle lines. It hauls immense cargo timbers and serves as an imposing status mount for foreign dignitaries.
Four iron shoes forged for a horse or war mount that glow with faint aerodynamic enchantments. When shoed on an equine mount, they increase its base movement speed by thirty feet.

Delicate mithral horseshoes that allow a mount to tread four inches above any ground or liquid surface. The mount leaves no tracks and can gallop across water, mud, lava, and quicksand without sinking.
A miniature sculpture of a horsefly carved from solid jet and polished to a glassy sheen. It transforms into a horse-sized flying insect mount that carries you across rugged mountain terrain.
A muscular, broad-chested workhorse bred specifically for pulling heavy freight wagons and farm plows. It possesses great physical fortitude, moving ponderously under immense strain.
