A heavily reinforced naval vessel armed with ballistas and catapults to control coastal sea lanes. Its armored hull resists boarding actions and delivers devastating naval bombardments.

Spinning this massive wagon wheel weapon unleashes radiant bursts that crush undead and banish corrupt aberrations. A jagged wooden wheel bound with heavy spiked iron rims is fitted with holy prayer scriptures.

A long-barreled precision firearm equipped with a bolt action mechanism and grooved rifling for long-range marksmanship. It propels high-velocity metallic cartridges across hundreds of feet with pinpoint penetration.

Loading these silver-mercury rounds into a firearm empowers shots to count as magical and deal extra damage against shapeshifters. Heavy paper-wrapped cartridges contain gleaming liquid metal and refined alchemical powder.

Wearing this ring makes you immune to being slowed or temporally displaced, allowing you to react normally against time magic. A silver gear with twenty-four tiny teeth is set into an eternally turning central axle band.
A coarse burlap bag that holds up to thirty pounds or one cubic foot of loose gear. Explorers carry multiple folded sacks to haul out loose coins, ore, and salvaged dungeon goods.
A short curved crescent blade inscribed with autumn harvest runes that cuts grain and vines with ease. Striking plant creatures or blights deals maximum damage and reaps curative life energy.
A thick woven blanket of raw wool that retains body heat even when damp from mountain mist. It provides crucial thermal insulation for campers sleeping under open starry skies.

You can use an action to surround yourself in heavy fog and teleport up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Silvery-gray vapor constantly curls along the hem of this lightweight woolen cloak.
A full-length suit of thousands of hand-riveted steel rings worn over padded wool gambesons. It provides comprehensive body protection against slicing weapons at the cost of considerable weight.
A heavy set comprising iron tongs, shaping hammers, files, an apron, and quenching chisels. It equips a blacksmith to forge weapons, repair battered armor, and reshape structural metalwork.
A compact forearm gauntlet linked to a pressurized naphtha cartridge strapped to your belt. Pulling the ring trigger projects a twenty-foot jet of roaring liquid flame across enemy ranks.
A sturdy farm flail reinforced with iron hoops and barbed nails favored by gallus militia. It strikes over shields with crushing momentum, knocking down armored opponents in rural skirmishes.
Spiked iron fist wraps incorporating the calcified claw bones of a subterranean ghoul. Striking an opponent injects paralyzing necrotic bile that immobilizes humanoid targets for one minute.

Critical hits with this +2 maul trigger a concussive shockwave that deafens and knocks prone creatures within fifteen feet. A heavy storm-cloud anvil head is forged from electrified sky-iron and bound in leather.

This +1 greataxe decapitates stunned or incapacitated enemies, dealing an extra 3d12 damage on prone targets. A massive crescent of blackened carbon iron is stained with ancient dried blood along its broad head.
A solid sphere of polished obsidian or leaded glass that refracts raw weave energy. Sorcerers and wizards hold it in the palm to focus destructive evocation and abjuration magic.
A coarse linen traveling mantle treated with desert alchemicals that whips with grit in the wind. Spinning the cloak unleashes a blinding vortex of stinging sand that obscures vision and blinds foes.

A rubbery cloak fashioned from the hide of a deep-sea whale that smells of salt and dark depths. It grants underwater breathing, cold immunity, blindsight out to sixty feet, and crushing ocean resilience.
A silky gray-green traveling cloak woven by elven artisans from shadow-threaded woodland fibers. Pulling up the hood camouflages the wearer into surroundings, granting advantage on stealth checks.

A compact kit containing leather awls, cobbler's hammers, curved needles, lasting pliers, and resin thread. It permits cobblers to repair boots, reinforce traveling soles, and craft hidden heel compartments.
A leather-wrapped deck of hand-painted cards imbued with eccentric planar wild magic. Drawing cards manifests varied utility effects ranging from spectral steed summons to spontaneous weather shifts.
A pair of linked leather saddlebags designed for horses or griffons with extradimensional depth. They store up to one thousand pounds of expedition supplies without burdening the mount.
A hardened leather skullcap mounted with carved stag antlers that pulse with wilderness instinct. It grants advantage on initiative rolls and allows the wearer to gore charging enemies in melee.
A small glass phial filled with enchanted blood that hangs from a leather thong around the neck. It boosts sorcerer spell attack rolls and DCs while replenishing sorcery points during rests.
A handheld leather drum painted with swirling musical runes that beats with an internal rhythm. It increases bard spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing a Bardic Inspiration die.
A braided leather lash extending ten feet that cracks sharply through the air at supersonic speed. Finesse fighters use its supple reach to distract enemies, trip legs, or strike from safety.
A braided cable of alchemical copper links that crackles with dancing blue electrical arcs. Snapping the whip delivers shockwave thunder and pulls distant enemies ten feet closer.
A flexible green vine covered in hardened briar thorns that coils like a living serpent in your hand. Striking a target restrains them in barbed thorns, inflicting lingering piercing damage.
A ten-foot lash crafted from the muscular tentacle of a displacer beast tipped with horn pads. It strikes with reach, deals bonus force damage, and projects a shimmering optical decoy of the wielder.

This concealed weapon shifts between a rigid bludgeoning cane and a razor-segmented bladed whip with fifteen-foot reach. Polished mahogany wood conceals tempered segmented steel links bound by braided piano wire.

A heavy cloth bag containing 3d4 dried beans that crackle with volatile transmutation magic. Planting a bean in dirt and watering it produces random magical phenomena ranging from fruit trees to hungry monsters.
A preserved kelp necklace strung with dried sea beans that can be crushed in the fist. Breaking a bean casts plant growth or speak with plants to compel aquatic vegetation.
A rich purple-red elixir with a warm, pulsing glow that accelerates cellular regeneration on contact. It reknits traumatic injuries and restores substantial vigor to gravely wounded adventurers.
A rod of dark iron carved with eldritch runes that glow with eerie green light. It increases warlock spell save DCs and attack rolls while replenishing one expended spell slot daily.
A delicate band of spun electrum that hums with rapid reactive energy when danger nears. Expending its charges turns a failed Dexterity saving throw into a complete success.

Crafted with a dense steel head and an armor-puncturing back-spike, this versatile bludgeon delivers concussive trauma. It can be swung with either one hand or braced with both for bone-shattering force.
A simple rounded length of solid hardwood balanced for one-handed bludgeoning strikes. It is one of the most basic, accessible implements of defense found throughout taverns and homesteads.
A heavy two-handed bough reinforced with iron studs to deliver sweeping, bone-breaking blows. Primitive brutes and desperate peasants swing it with momentum to knock opponents sprawling.
A colossal two-handed sledgehammer forged from solid iron to deliver immense crushing force. It shatters stone barricades, splinters wooden gates, and obliterates reinforced armor.

A stubby, thick-bored blackpowder hand cannon designed to unleash massive lead grapeshot at close quarters. It delivers terrifying concussive stopping power capable of knocking charging beasts off their feet.
A traditional military long gun utilizing a matchlock mechanism to fire heavy lead balls. It produces a massive smoke bloom and loud thunderclap that punches cleanly through thick armor.
A massive two-handed executioner's axe forged with a heavy crescent blade designed for cleaving blows. Barbarians and frontline berserkers swing it with momentum to cleave through shields and bone.
A versatile warhammer whose flanged head and rear spike are encased in dense alchemical silver. It delivers concussive blunt force that shatters gargoyles and repels silver-vulnerable abominations.
An insulated steel baton fitted with conductive copper terminals powered by a grip battery cell. Striking a target delivers nonlethal electrical shocks that stun and disarm opponents.
A longsword forged from unworked, unheated cold iron mined deep beneath ancient haunted hills. It pierces the natural resistances of fey creatures, fiends, and incorporeal phantoms.
A bundle of twenty ash shafts tipped with steel bodkin heads and fletched with goose feathers. They fit neatly into any standard quiver to supply archers on lengthy campaigns.
Six six-sided dice carved from polished animal bone with carved black pips stored in a velvet pouch. Gamblers and tavern patrons roll them in popular betting games across Waterdeep's drinking dens.
A wind instrument consisting of a sealed leather air bladder, a blowpipe, and tuned wooden drones. Its piercing, drone-heavy chords carry across windswept highlands to rally marching highland clans.
A slender side-blown musical tube crafted from polished cherrywood or bone with precision finger holes. It produces sweet, clear bird-like melodies favored by wandering minstrels and pastoral bards.
A classic fretted string instrument with a pear-shaped bowl back and an angled tuning pegbox. It provides rich acoustic accompaniment for courtly singing, ballads, and bardic spellcasting.
A one-handed utility hammer fitted with a flat striking face and a straight claw for pulling spikes. It is an indispensable tool for securing pitons, driving wedges, and camp construction.
A crisp, lightweight sheet made from pressed wood pulp and cotton rags suitable for rapid writing. It is less durable than treated vellum but provides an affordable medium for letters.
A hand torch connected to pressurized acetylene and oxygen canisters that generates white-hot flame. It cuts through iron bars, welds broken steel gates, and mends damaged automatons.
A heavy oak warhammer imbued with surprising kinetic momentum that hums when swung. Landing a strike on a creature has a chance to knock the target completely prone onto the ground.

Hanging these metal chimes outside an encampment alerts sleeping allies if an unnatural aberration or undead approaches within sixty feet. Slender silver tubes ring with a crisp melodic chime whenever spiritual danger draws near.

Ringing this tiny brass bell creates a sphere of silence that prevents outside eavesdropping within a five-foot radius. Hand-turned brass bell is engraved with quiet monk motifs and muffled by a velvet clapper.
A tarnished brass flagon sealed with a heavy lead stopper that feels hot to the touch. Removing the stopper unleashes an endless torrent of thick gray smoke that blinds an entire district.
An alchemically treated wooden dowel that erupts with thick, opaque gray smoke when snapped and struck. It blankets a twenty-foot sphere in dense fog to obscure vision and facilitate hasty retreats.
A small glass sphere filled with pressurized phosphor salts and powdered magnesium. Shattering it produces a blinding flash and concussive bang that disorients and blinds nearby enemies.
A sealed wooden keg containing twenty pounds of volatile alchemical blackpowder equipped with a fuse. Detonating it shatters stone fortifications and blasts all creatures within twenty feet.
A water-resistant powder horn fashioned from hollow bull horn holding two pounds of blackpowder. It provides enough measured powder charges to fire up to forty firearm rounds.
A small metal tube fitted with a magnesium fuse that detonates in a blinding white flash and sharp crack. It momentarily blinds and deafens guards, providing crucial seconds for infiltration.
A pressurized container holding cryogenic chemicals that freezes solid upon contact with open air. Shattering it encases targets in brittle frost that slows movement and freezes water.
A clear, odorless liquid stored in an airtight lead vial that dissolves glues, resins, and adhesives. Pouring it over bonds or sticky monster webs instantly breaks the adhesive hold.
A small glass ampoule containing pungent ammonia and aromatic wintergreen salts. Snapping it under an unconscious or stunned creature's nose immediately awakens them to full consciousness.

Wrapping these herbal linens around a wounded creature stabilizes them instantly and restores 1d4 hit points over ten minutes of rest. Soft woven strips of medicated willow bark are scented with eucalyptus and dried mint.

Whispering a message to this folded paper bird sends it flying across the island to deliver your words to a named recipient. Delicate washi paper is folded into the graceful shape of a flying crane with gilded wing tips.
A bronze brooch shaped like a sling bullet that fastens cleanly onto cloaks or tunics. It magically produces smooth lead sling bullets on command so the bearer never runs out of ammunition.
A thick padded wool coat embedded with hundreds of protruding hardened porcupine quills. It protects the torso while dealing retaliatory piercing damage to enemies that attempt to grapple you.
A heavy crossbow engineered with an enlarged flight track designed to fire sharpened wooden stakes. It allows vampire hunters to deliver lethal piercing stakes from safe tactical range.
High leather boots adorned with small white feathered wings that flutter near the ankles. They grant their wearer four hours of flight daily, carrying them effortlessly through the air.
A weather-treated oiled canvas shelter with collapsible wooden poles and ground stakes. It offers two adventurers dry shelter and protection from biting winds during long overland travels.
A small metal container holding a flint stone, a steel striker, and dry shredded kindling. It enables explorers to strike sparks quickly and kindle torches or campfires in cold environments.

A fortune-telling card deck featuring fifty-four richly illustrated cards depicting ancient archetypes and tragic fates. Vistani seers and fortunetellers use it to read destiny, unveil hidden truths, and lay curses.
A tarp of waxed canvas measuring twelve feet square supported by collapsible bamboo corner stakes. It funnels rainwater into a central collecting spout to harvest up to eight gallons of fresh water.
A small wooden puzzle device carved by Tabaxi hunters featuring sliding beads and interlocking pegs. Solving it provides mental focus, granting advantage on concentration checks during rest periods.
Includes copper rivets, alchemical solder, specialized spanners, and wooden replacement pegs. It allows engineers to stabilize and patch damaged warforged chassis in the field.
A double-reed woodwind instrument that produces a loud, piercing, buzzy acoustic timbre. Heralds and military pipers sound it during open-air festivals and outdoor troop parades.
A sturdy wooden ladder crafted from straight pine rungs lashed to twin upright ash poles. It provides quick access to rooftops, haylofts, and dungeon ledges up to ten feet high.
Tough yet pliable leather reinforced with hundreds of close-set steel rivets over vital organs. It deflects glancing slashes while remaining quiet enough for scouts and thieves.
A sweeping polearm whose blade is carved from the serrated mandible of an apex predator insect. It rends flesh with brutal efficiency and vibrates when venomous creatures approach within sixty feet.
A slender rapier crafted from dark drow starmetal and infused with Lolth's spider venom. It cuts with deadly finesse, injects paralyzing venom, and casts dark webs across the battlefield.

A barnacle-encrusted rod salvaged from the abyssal depths that radiates cold, crushing oceanic pressure. Pointing it crushes targets in localized hydraulic force, pinning enemies to the floor under tons of pressure.
A barbed flail forged from abyssal iron and hooked spikes that hungers for mortal suffering. It deals devastating necrotic damage on hit, imposes crippling agony, and stores stolen life force.

This wicked scythe deals an extra 1d10 necrotic damage and prevents slain humanoids from rising as undead unless you command it. A jagged bone blade is attached to a polished ebony wood shaft wrapped in funeral shrouds.
A compact leather roll containing delicate lockpicks, torsion wrenches, wire cutters, and a tiny mirror. It provides the essential instruments required to bypass locks and disarm mechanical traps.
A viscous black paste stored in a sealed ceramic jar to coat edged blades and arrowheads. Struck targets suffer toxic systemic shock as the venom seeps into their bloodstream.
A compact velvet-lined case containing glass distillation tubes, extraction forceps, and toxic venom phials. It provides the reagents necessary to safely harvest animal poisons and synthesize venoms.
Fifty delicate steel needles packed inside a grooved wooden travel tube. Their slender barbed points deliver venom directly into the target's bloodstream with barely a prick.
A blackened steel blade etched with serrated fangs that drips with alchemical toxin on command. Once per day, a successful strike injects virulent poison that sickens and harms targets.

Plate armor forged from chitinous plates harvested from giant scorpions in the steaming jungles of Chult. It grants superior stealth and resilience in extreme heat, though donning it risks a venomous sting.
A serpentine whip woven from solidified darkness that crackles with virulent necrotic venom. It strikes foes with agonizing poison and can summon shadowy fiends to obey your will.
A hollow blowgun needle tipped with concentrated, unadulterated venom harvested from an adult wyvern. Striking a target injects lethal toxin that inflicts catastrophic poison damage.
An invisible, insidious poison that lies dormant in the bloodstream for hours after ingestion. At the stroke of midnight, the venom suddenly activates to inflict catastrophic internal damage.
A terrifyingly lethal venom harvested from the stinger tail of an adult purple worm. Coating an edged weapon inflicts forty-two points of instant necrotic poison damage on hit.
A golden, translucent venom milked from the fangs of giant subterranean poisonous snakes. Coating a blade or arrowhead delivers immediate poison trauma to the target's bloodstream.
A thick black venom extracted from the tail stinger of a wyvern that smells of rotten meat. A weapon coated in this venom deals twenty-four points of severe poison damage on hit.
A supple hauberk crafted from iridescent serpent scales that move with silent serpentine grace. It grants poison resistance, swimming speed, and imposes no disadvantage on stealth checks.

Up to three times per day, an arrow pulled from this leathern quiver transforms into a poisoned manticore tail spike dealing 2d6 poison damage. Thick manticore hide and bristling quills cover the rugged cylindrical container.

This undulating wavy blade deals an extra 1d8 poison damage and allows the wielder to climb vertical surfaces effortlessly. Carved from the petrified mandible of a giant cave arachnid, it glistens with dark venom.
This whip splits into two barbed lashes that can grapple targets up to ten feet away on a successful hit. Scaled serpent leather is tipped with twin hollow copper fangs that channel contact venom.

Absorbing poison damage with this shield charges it to unleash a venomous green spray on your next shield bash attack. A serpentine visage of embossed brass opens its fanged jaws across the central shield boss.
A lightweight parrying buckler crafted from the layered shell plates of an ankheg queen. It deflects incoming venomous bites and grants acid resistance to the warrior wielding it.

A blackened iron amulet inscribed with sinister fiendish runes that chill the surrounding air. An evil spellcaster can channel its malice to open abyssal chasms that devour champions of righteousness.
A symbiotic suit of chitinous plating and pulsing tendrils grown in deep Daelkyr flesh vats. It bonds intimately with the wearer, bolstering physical defenses while feeding on life energy.
A piece of petrified rot-wood inscribed with fungal decay sigils from the undercity swarms. It animates into a skittering giant beetle construct with venomous mandibles and hard chitin.
A carved bone ring set with a serpent's eye emerald that detects toxic substances. Wearing it grants permanent resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against poison.
A stiletto forged from dark cinnabar ore whose blood-red blade leaves toxic traces in open wounds. Struck targets suffer recurring mercurial poison damage that hinders their combat movement.
A slender punching dagger whose blade is fashioned from the calcified beak of an adult cockatrice. Piercing an opponent injects petrifying venom that gradually turns their limbs into rigid stone.
A colossal warhammer forged from the curved iron-hard horn of an Abyssal labyrinth minotaur. Charging at least twenty feet before landing a strike doubles impact force and knocks monsters sprawling.
A suit of full plate armor crafted from the impervious black chitin of an ancient arachnid queen. It grants total poison immunity, web-walking freedom, and summons spectral swarms to defend you.
A folding stiletto concealed within a leather forearm bracer equipped with a wrist-flick release. Snapping your wrist projects the steel blade into your hand for sudden surprise assassinations.
A platinum pendant set with an emerald that shifts color with the whims of fate and fortune. It grants immunity to poison and paralysis while allowing the wearer to alter dice rolls with divine luck.

On a critical hit, this weapon injects venom that paralyzes the target until the end of its next turn on a failed Constitution save. The tapered blade is forged from burnished gold alloyed with lethal chitinous barb.

Strikes with this heavy purple-sheened byeshk weapon bypass damage resistance on aberrations and deal an extra 1d6 damage to Daelkyr horrors. A spiked spherical head of ancient goblinoid metallurgy rests on a reinforced steel shaft.

Attuning to this fleshy parasite replaces your tongue, granting an acid-spitting ranged strike and the ability to speak Deep Speech. The glistening purple annelid wriggles comfortably within the host's mouth when resting.

This chitinous bio-armor bonds to your torso, providing AC 15 + Dexterity modifier (max 2) and regenerating 1d6 hit points every turn. Mottled purple carapace pulses like living muscle and flexes with the wearer's breathing.

Grafting this fleshy lash to your arm deals 1d6 piercing damage plus 1d6 psychic damage and can poison targets on failed saves. A muscular violet tentacle writhes with needle-sharp barbs and a snapping alien eye near the wrist.

This shadowy organism merges into your back, extending shadowy tendrils that impose disadvantage on attack rolls against you as a reaction. Wispy umbral appendages peel from your natural silhouette and whisper secrets into your mind.

Burrowing into your ear canal, this symbiont translates alien telepathy and lets you cast detect thoughts once per short rest. A small segmented centipede-like creature nestles snugly inside the auditory canal without discomfort.

Attached to the skin, this rubbery leech absorbs lethal toxins to grant advantage on Constitution saving throws against disease and poison. Translucent leathery skin reveals pulsating fluids that filter toxins from the host's veins.

This organic chitin beetle can be thrown up to sixty feet for 1d6 piercing damage plus acid, flying back to your palm after striking. Iridescent green carapace covers miniature barbed legs that cling comfortably to your knuckles.

Striking an enemy with this sacrificial blade confuses their senses, forcing them to attack nearby allies on failed saves. Carved from the petrified femur of a forgotten plague beast, it oozes dark foul marrow.

A hollow bamboo or polished metal tube engineered to propel tiny needles silently with lung power. Assassins and scouts use it from hiding to deliver venomous coatings without alerting surrounding guards.
A shimmering crimson brew that invigorates the senses with the sweet scent of morning dew. It cures all exhaustion and poison while maximizing any healing received for twenty-four hours.

A silken black cloak woven with subtle gray spiderweb patterns that cling softly to clothing. It grants permanent spider climbing, poison resistance, and the ability to cast web across large chambers.

A colossal war flail featuring five distinct dragon-headed spiked balls linked by adamantine chains. Each head strikes with a different chromatic elemental breath, unleashing acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
An intricate iron puzzle box sealed with infernal locks and sharp barbed needles. Solving its mechanical riddle requires profound intellect, while failing pricks the fingers with hellish poison.
A milky, oily secretion extracted from subterranean cave spiders and sealed in dark glass vials. Striking a target with a coated blade forces them to fall unconscious into a paralyzed stupor.
A milky, bitter tincture that slowly ravages the digestive tract of any creature that ingests it. The poisoned target suffers continuous daily damage and cannot recover hit points normally.
A thick belt of studded leather fastened with a carved gold dwarven clan buckle. It grants darkvision, poison resistance, advantage on dwarven charisma checks, and causes thick beard growth.
A brilliant peridot suspended from a delicate gold chain that warms against the collarbone. It makes the wearer completely immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.
An emerald green liquid disguised as a potion of healing that smells pleasantly of wild mint. Drinking it induces immediate violent poisoning, dealing heavy recurring poison damage.
A gnarled wooden quarterstaff whose head is sculpted like the fanged head of a venomous viper. Speaking its command word animates the head into a biting snake that delivers lethal poison in melee.
An emerald mask shaped like a crested green wyrm that smells of toxic chlorine gas and pine needles. It grants poison immunity, amphibious breathing, and adds poison damage to all weapon strikes.

A leather shoulder sash fitted with padded spring-clip holsters that hold up to twelve alchemical flasks. Drawing and hurling an alchemical vial or poison from the bandolier can be done as a bonus action.

Implanting this mechanical marvel into your chest replaces your heart, granting immunity to disease, poison, and exhaustion. Complex miniature clockwork gears and ticking quartz escapements beat with rhythmic precision.

This +2 buckler grants resistance to acid damage and can poison attackers on successful shield deflection reactions. A colossal emerald dragon scale is bordered with sea-green bronze and rune-carved rivets.
A small glass or ceramic container sealed with a snug cork stopper that holds up to four ounces of liquid. It stores precious alchemical reagents, perfumes, holy waters, or deadly poisons safely.
Symbiotic chitinous gloves grown by aberrant flesh-crafters that bond intimately with your forearms. They enhance manual dexterity, granting a bonus to sleight of hand checks and lockpicking.
A leather muzzle fitted with alchemical charcoal canisters and brass check valves. It filters out toxic spores, smog, and inhaled poisons to provide clean air in subterranean mines.

A ten-foot whip braided from the scaled hide of an abyssal sea serpent that stays slick with brine. Striking a creature wraps the coils around their limbs, pulling them underwater or restraining them.

This abyssal gem lets you absorb one spell of 5th level or lower cast at you and redirect it on your following turn. A pitch-black crystal hangs on an obsidian chain, reflecting no ambient light whatsoever.
Fingerless gloves crafted from invisible phantom silk that mold seamlessly to the palms. They grant a +5 bonus to sleight of hand checks and lockpicking attempts with thieves' tools.
A small gelatinous capsule containing enchanted deep-sea oils that dissolves upon the tongue. Swallowing it protects the user from catastrophic pressure sickness and cold in deep abyssal trenches.
A small glass jar containing thick, aromatic herbal unguent that smells faintly of crushed aloe. Applying a dose restores hit points, neutralizes active poisons, and cures all nonmagical diseases.

A spear tipped with a barbed tooth harvested from an abyssal kraken that drips with caustic ocean brine. It pierces underwater beasts effortlessly, dealing extra acid damage and granting swimming speed.

This marine rune grants resistance to psychic damage and immunity to magical sleep or nightmarish visions. Spiraling oceanic glyphs evoke unfathomable abyssal trenches where forgotten horrors slumber.
An intricate iron padlock fitted with deceptive keyways and shifting internal brass pins. It imposes disadvantage on any thief attempting to pick it with thieves' tools.
A sleek obsidian token carved with spider and horror motifs favored by House Dimir. It transforms into an elusive shadowy horror that slips through cracks to spy or assassinate.
A heavy iron tumbler padlock accompanied by a tailored brass key to secure doors and chests. A skilled thief requires thieves' tools and a successful check to pick its internal mechanism.
A weighted combat net woven from the sticky, elastic webbing of a subterranean ettercap broodmother. Ensnared creatures are poisoned by contact neurotoxins and restrained until cut free.
Consuming this sharp tonic cures mundane poisoning and grants advantage on Constitution saves against disease for one hour. Pale green liquid bubbles gently within a corked glass apothecary vial.
A bitter chalky tonic concocted from distilled charcoal and protective mountain herbs. Swallowing the vial fortifies the drinker's constitution against debilitating venoms and deadly toxins.
A viscous contact poison distilled from rare white poppy seeds that absorbs through exposed skin. Touching the oil puts the victim into an unresponsive sleep lasting for several hours.
A stiff leather beaked mask packed with dried camphor, sage, and crushed cloves. It grants absolute immunity to airborne diseases, inhaled poisons, and sickening necrotic stenches.
Wearing this silver pin grants darkvision out to sixty feet and provides advantage on saving throws against poison. The brooch is sculpted as a delicate blooming water lily cradling a luminous pearl.

Swallowing this coagulated pellet enters a state of beastly fury, increasing melee damage while reducing defensive AC by 2. Dried clotted monstrosity blood is rolled into a pungent sphere coated in grave dust.

Imbibing this forbidden vintage grants immense physical strength and temporary hit points at the risk of temporary madness. Dark thick blood wine sloshes inside a sealed ceramic amphora stamped with royal seals.

Crushing this fossilized skull grants immediate inspiration and reveals one secret weakness of an observed creature. Dried parchment-like skin clings to a yellowed human skull marked with arcane eye carvings.
A sturdy woolen travel cloak sewn with sixteen cleverly concealed interior slip pockets. Each pocket can hold a small vial, a set of lockpicks, or up to ten coins with zero exterior bulging.
Crafted from oiled supple calfskin with reinforced arch stirrup-grooves and high fold-over knee cuffs. Famous across the Heartlands for blister-free long-distance cavalry travel.
Woven with bleached reflective linen on one side to deflect searing desert heat, and dense camel wool on the reverse to retain body heat during freezing wilderness nights.
A wide, shimmering silk waist sash dyed in fashionable Waterdhavian guild heraldry. The weighted tassel ends are filled with lead shot, doubling as a discreet, balanced bludgeon in brawls.
items.Iconic Storefront: Aurora's Realms Shop (Street of Bells Counter)

items.Properties / Flavor: Soft kidskin shoes fitted with chamois-padded leather soles and sound-dampening wool lining. They leave no distinctive tread prints and muffle footfalls across polished stone and slate roofs.
A quilted double-linen arming doublet packed with boiled wool. Designed to be worn beneath plate or mail to eliminate armor pinch, absorb concussive chafing, and wick away sweat.
A full-length, heavy leather greatcoat lined with polar bear pelt and trimmed with wolverine fur around the deep hood. Grants natural advantage against sub-zero mountain exposure.
items.Theme Tags: Cold Weather, Icewind Dale, Survival, Fur

items.Properties / Flavor: Spun from gossamer threads cultivated by Halruaan aeromancers. The iridescent fabric shifts hue as light passes through it and naturally sheds dust, water, and wine stains.
A thick, handsome leather trouser belt featuring a slit-edge zipper lining holding up to twenty platinum or gold trade bars completely flat against the wearer's spine.
A cross-chest leather sword harness fitted with an alchemical brass trigger buckle. The wearer can instantly unhitch their heavy sheathed weapon as a free action if grappled or falling.
Quality riding boots with a discreet spring-release mechanism in the left stacked-leather heel, revealing a 1x2 inch secret chamber suitable for a skeleton key, a poison vial, or rolled parchment.

A slender steel bracer worn beneath a sleeve with a pneumatic slide mechanism. A subtle tendon-flex of the wrist ejects a concealed dagger directly into the wielder's hand as a free object interaction.
A brass compass tool mounting a suction handle and a rotating industrial diamond tip. Allows an operative to score and remove a silent 8-inch glass disc from leaded window panes.
A palm-sized, oiled steel drill bit with a knurled crossbar. Bores silent pinhole peepholes through timber doors and wooden partitions in under two minutes without splintering.
A three-foot length of braided high-tensile steel wire fastened between two turned mahogany dowel grips. Used for silent takedowns and close-quarters choking from stealth.
Cast lead knuckle-guards molded to fit the fingers inside a closed fist. Enhances unarmed strikes with devastating concussive bone-fracturing impact while remaining easily pocketed.
Carved bone six-sided dice drilled with microscopic lead plugs beneath the pips. Always rolls high on a hard surface unless inspected with a magnifying loupe and DC 15 Investigation check.
A reinforced crossbow bolt mounting a sealed ampoule of alchemical vitriol behind a steel puncture needle. Destroys wooden lock mechanisms or deals extra acid splash on impact.
A folded parchment envelope of magnesium salts and powdered amber. Tossing it into an open flame or striking it against stone unleashes a blinding white flare that dazzles pursuers.
A stoneware flask of thickened alchemical pitch and petroleum gel. Unlike standard alchemist's fire, it sticks tenaciously to stone or hulls and continues burning underwater for two rounds.
A pungent oil distilled from marsh moss, bog iron, and red fox glands. Rubbed onto boots and cloaks, it deadens human scent and causes tracking bloodhounds to lose trail scent for 4 hours.
A jar of thick waxy paste buffed into iron and steel weapons or armor. Prevents seawater oxidation, pit corrosion, and grants temporary immunity against rust monster antennae touch for 24 hours.
A fragile ceramic ampoule holding compressed sal ammoniac and phosphorus oil. Shatters on impact against hard stone to instantly bloom a 10-foot radius sphere of dense, vision-blocking gray fog.
A soothing herbal balm compounded from mountain arnica flowers, silver willow bark, and beeswax. Applied to bandaged wounds during a short rest to restore an extra +2 Hit Points per Hit Die spent.
items.Theme Tags: Healing, Herbalism, Short Rest, First Aid

items.Properties / Flavor: Tart mint wafers pressed with powdered charcoal, dried snake-root, and candied honey. Dissolving one on the tongue grants advantage on saving throws against ingested poisons for one hour.

A hollow reed tube packed with fine river sand, crushed charcoal, and silver wire screen mesh. Drinking stagnant swamp or pond water through the straw filters out grit, parasites, and mundane waterborne illness.

A hinged sheet-tin cube that unfolds over a charcoal brick. The insulated double-wall draft vents heat into cooking pots while suppressing firelight and releasing zero detectable smoke in hostile territory.
A 16-foot octagonal wax-impregnated canvas pavilion with spruce center poles and iron stakes. Shelters up to eight adventurers and their gear against torrential mountain rains and blizzards.
Adjustable steel-band frames fitted with ten sharp downward spikes, strapping securely beneath standard boots. Grants advantage on Athletics checks to ascend sheer ice walls and frozen waterfalls.
An ingenious brass lantern engineered with telescoping hood rings and a fold-flat convex glass lens. Unfolds into a fully functional 60-foot directional beam in three seconds.
A weighted arrow with spring-loaded barbs folded against the shaft. On impact with wood or stone battlement, the spring releases four barbed claws anchoring fifty feet of trailing silk cord.

A dense, rock-hard loaf of stone-ground oats, iron-grit, and dried mountain honey. Completely immune to rot, mold, or insects. Soaking in boiling water yields thick porridge; dry loaves deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage if swung.

Thin, golden wafers baked with honey, flower nectar, and elven wheat, wrapped in protective leaves. Eating a single wafer satisfies a character's food and water requirement for a full day of forced march.
Carved whalebone slit-goggles tied with seal sinew cords. Restricts blinding glare reflected from arctic snowfields, granting immunity to snow blindness and sun glare penalties in Icewind Dale.
items.Theme Tags: Cold Weather, Icewind Dale, Arctic, Goggles

items.Properties / Flavor: A bound ledger of eighty heavy vellum pages hand-ruled in red and black ink with gilded brass edge clasps. The scraped calfskin paper does not tear or smear when exposed to harbor dampness.
A seamless threaded cylinder of spun copper with oiled rubber gasket seals. Keeps up to four parchment spell scrolls bone-dry even if submerged in ocean depths.
items.Iconic Storefront: Aurora's Realms Shop (Street of Bells Counter)

items.Properties / Flavor: Clear alchemical fluid that dries entirely invisible on parchment. Re-reading the text requires holding the parchment within five feet of an open flame or under a violet blacklight candle.
A contoured volcanic pumice stone chemically treated with mild citrus acid. Gently rubs dried iron gall ink off parchment and vellum sheets without scarring or weakening the skin fibers.
A handsome folding bookstand of polished Cormyrian mahogany with brass page clips. Props massive spell grimoires open hands-free during campfire ritual casting.
A fitted suede belt holding twenty-four stoppered crystal phials in padded loops. Allows spellcasters to draw material spell components swiftly without fumbling through bulky pouches.
A dense, chewy brick of sun-dried Calimshan figs pressed with cardamom, ground almonds, and date molasses. Packed in greasecloth, it provides high energy on long desert treks.
A three-pound wax-dipped wheel of sharp cheddar smoked over applewood in the Shire of Luiren. The heavy red wax seal keeps the cheese fresh for months of travel.

items.Item Name: Spiced Coffee Beans of Amn (1 lb)
items.Properties / Flavor: Dark, oily roasted beans harvested from the Cloudpeak foothills, dusted with cinnamon and nutmeg. Chewing several beans whole dispels mundane exhaustion grogginess during night watches.
A heavy, sweet, midnight-dark red vintage renowned along the trade ways of the Heartlands. Celebrated for its rich blackberry finish and potent warming alcoholic kick.
The peerless elven liqueur brewed from sun-ripened forest berries and distilled over decades. Shimmers with faint ruby luminescence and induces a state of lucid euphoria without hangovers.
A walking stick of polished ebony with a brass griffon-head handle. Twisting the pommel releases a razor-sharp, spring-tempered steel rapier blade concealed inside the hollow shaft.
Three leather-covered lead balls linked by braided rawhide cords. Hurled at a Medium or smaller fleeing quarry to entangle legs and knock the target prone on a successful ranged strike.
A flat-ground triangular stiletto engineered to lock securely into an ankle sheath inside tall riding boots. Undetectable by casual pat-downs and drawn swiftly with a heel-click.
A spring-brass ring holding six master tumbler-profile blanks filed by veteran Waterdhavian burglars. Grants advantage on Sleight of Hand checks to bypass standard domestic padlocks.
A heavy iron padlock engineered with a spring-loaded spring needle in the keyhole. Failing a lockpicking check by 5 or more trips the needle, pricking the picker with coated poison.
A compact spool of hundred-foot dyed black silk tripwire and three tuned brass clapper bells. Strung across campsite perimeters to alert party members to sneaking nocturnal intruders.
An expandable forged-steel bar with knurled lock screws and floor anchor teeth. Wedged against doors to increase the DC to break down the door by +5 against battering rams.
A hollow brass blow-reed packed with ground ghost-chili dust and slaked lime. Blown into an adjacent foe's face to force a DC 13 Constitution save or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

Molded lavender beeswax plugs that fit snug inside the ear canal. Grants advantage on saving throws against thunder damage and auditory effects (like Harpy song), but causes deafness to subtle whispers.
items.Iconic Storefront: Aurora's Realms Shop (Street of Bells Counter)

items.Properties / Flavor: A baked clay orb packed with sulfur, skunk cabbage essence, and fermented fish paste. Shatters on impact creating a 10-foot nauseating stench cloud that clears guard posts and rooms.
Rendered goose fat whipped with wintergreen, pine oil, and camphor resin. Buffed onto ears, fingers, and toes before snow treks to prevent frostbite tissue necrosis.
A thick knitted sailor watch-cap sewn with flexible sheet-lead plates inside the crown. Grants subtle blunt-force protection against sucker punches in harbor taprooms.
A tailored coat with fine royal blue velvet and brass guild crests on the outer shell, which can be turned inside-out in ten seconds to reveal stained, threadbare dock-worker wool.
Steamed white ash frames webbed with oil-treated elk rawhide lacing. Distributes weight over deep snowdrifts, allowing travel through heavy snow without difficult terrain movement penalties.
A polished horsehide forearm guard with brass lace eyelets and a waxed bowstring slide channel. Protects archers' arms from bowstring slap during rapid battlefield volleys.
A heavy cast-brass inkpot packed with dense sea-sponge saturated in dark gall ink. Even if dropped, tipped over, or shaken inside a saddlebag, not a single drop spills.
items.Iconic Storefront: Aurora's Realms Shop (Street of Bells Counter)

items.Properties / Flavor: A precision brass odometer wheel with geared dial and ivory handle. Rolling the wheel along winding trail paths on cartographic maps accurately calculates league travel distances.
A polished rosewood handle with interchangeable engraved brass signet dies and four sticks of red shellac sealing wax. Used to notarize guild contracts and royal correspondence.
A crisp, ruby red table wine from the sun-drenched vineyards of Cormyr. Prized by merchant factors for its clean, dry tannin profile that complements game meats.
Distilled from malted barley dried over bog-peat fires on the isle of Gwynneth. Rich smoke notes and deep amber warmth make it a favorite among veteran sea captains.
Lean venison pounded dry with melted suet, crushed black peppercorns, and tart dried cranberries. Wrapped in parchment, one slab provides concentrated nourishment for five days.
A heavy off-hand parrying dagger forged with deep combed teeth along the spine. Allows an agile combatant to catch and trap an incoming blade on a parry reaction.
Heavy cross-pins fitted behind a barbed steel broadhead. Designed to anchor securely into sea monsters, dragon wings, or ship rigging without tearing free under strain.
A silver pin sculpted in the shape of a harp nestled within a crescent moon. Twisting the central pin reveals a concealed precision lockpick and a magnetized compass needle.
items.Iconic Storefront: Aurora's Realms Shop (Street of Bells Counter)

items.Properties / Flavor: Chemically treated black steel blade that casts zero reflection or glare under torchlight. Features a textured serpent-scale grip favored by Black Network enforcers.
A heavy bridle-leather sword belt embossed with the purple dragon of Cormyr and fastened with a cast-brass buckle. Holds scabbard, dagger sheath, and coin pouch in perfect military alignment.
Woven in the Gem of the North from thistle-silk and silver threads. The pale blue fabric provides comfortable insulation in chilly mountain winds while weighing less than a feather.
A shortened seven-foot ash polearm mounting a heavy spearhead and a wicked reverse gaff-hook. Engineered for clearing ship gunwales and hauling enemy boarding nets down.
Carved from dire wolf rib-bone by tribal shamans of the northern tundra. Inscribed with crude beast runes that reassure hunting animals and draft horses.
A deluxe kidskin roll holding twelve blue-tempered steel picks, three tension wrenches, and miniature magnifying tweezers. Favored by master thieves across the Western Heartlands.
A coiled, hand-blown borosilicate glass retort and condensing tube. Essential apparatus for isolating delicate herbal essences, alchemical solvents, and perfume bases.
A rugged canvas haversack dipped in hot beeswax and linseed oil with copper riveted stress seams. Keeps rations, dry kindling, and parchment dry even in river crossings.
A pair of looped webbing foot-stirrups fitted with friction-cam ascender buckles. Enables an adventurer to ascend or rest suspended on a vertical rope without consuming arm stamina.

A folding navigator's sextant of machined brass with micrometer vernier scale and tinted sun filters. Grants advantage on Survival checks to navigate open seas or trackless wilderness by celestial stars.
A pot of frictionless alchemical tallow. Smeared onto armor, it grants advantage to escape grapples; dumped on the floor, it creates a 10-foot square of slippery Grease for 1 minute.
Hollow lead-clad clay balls packed with flash-powder. When slung against stone or armor, they explode in a sharp concussive pop and blinding flare.
Pine wood splints tipped with wax-coated sulfur and phosphorus paste. Strikes on any rough stone surface to ignite instantly, even after being dropped into a stream.
Dense volcanic basalt quarried from the Earthfast Mountains. Features a coarse grit side for grinding out blade notches and a fine water-honing side for razor-sharp edges.
The fabled elven mead fermented with honey from giant bees of the High Forest and blessed by Seldarine priests. Grants temporary resistance to magical charm effects for 8 hours after consumption.
Sweet white wine infused with honey, cloves, ginger, and saffron. Served hot at Waterdhavian winter galas to thaw chilled adventurers.
A five-piece tin cookware set comprising a handled skillet, a two-quart lidded pot, a kettle, and two deep mugs that nest together into a compact canvas sack for trail travel.
A paraffin-dipped heavy canvas envelope designed to encase standard bedrolls. Prevents ground moisture, mud, and morning dew from soaking sleeping adventurers.
A double-walled copper flask lined with cork and wrapped in heavy wool. Keeps spring water ice-cold through desert marches or tea piping hot during mountain blizzards.
A padded ash-wood cross-tree saddle fitted with two woven willow cargo baskets. Allows mules, ponies, or oxen to carry up to 250 lbs of adventuring supplies safely.
A tripod folding stool of turned white ash and riveted leather seat. Weighs almost nothing and straps to the side of a backpack, providing dry seating off muddy campsite soil.
A water-sealed steer horn holding dry charred linen cloth, a striker steel, and flint shards. Produces an instant glowing ember with a single strike even in driving rain.
A 12-inch heavy skillet cast in the smithies of Mirabar. Retains heat over open campfire coals and doubles as an improvised bludgeon dealing 1d4 damage in camp ambushes.
A two-foot length of serrated, braided high-carbon steel wire with finger rings at both ends. Can be rolled into a pocket watch case and cuts silently through iron bars or oak beams.
A heavy gold or electrum signet ring bearing a carved crest. A twist of the bezel swings open a spring-latched reservoir holding a dose of contact poison or powdered blinding ash.
A T-shaped, double-edged punch dagger seamlessly integrated into a heavy brass belt buckle. Undetected by routine weapons frisks and drawn instantly with one hand.
A stout five-foot ash walking staff with an unscrewable brass ferrule, revealing a hollow core holding rolled maps, spell scrolls, or three blowgun darts with zero rattle.
A wooden box with four cakes of forest, swamp, or rock pigment made from tallow, charcoal, and ochre. Applied to skin and gear to grant advantage on Stealth checks to blend into terrain.
A 54-card deck of painted pasteboard cards bearing microscopic line scratches on the decorative back scrollwork, revealing the suit and rank to an observant card shark.
A fist-sized nodule of treated Underdark fluorite. Exposing it to sunlight or torch flame for one minute charges it to cast a soft 15-foot green glow for one hour with zero heat or smoke.
Chalk sticks infused with luminescent minerals and sharp mint oil. Marks dungeon walls with glowing arrows visible only in dim light, and detectable by scent in pitch darkness.
items.Iconic Storefront: Aurora's Realms Shop (Street of Bells Counter)

items.Properties / Flavor: Triple-distilled whale oil that burns completely clear with zero smoke and zero greasy odor. Prevents subterranean monsters with keen smell from detecting burning lanterns.
A natural sea sponge treated with dry alkaline salts. When pressed over fresh acid burns or acid trap sprays, it neutralizes up to 2d6 acid damage as a reaction.
A jar of thick mica-clay paste buffed into cloaks, leather armor, or hair. Grants resistance against mundane fire sparks and catches no flame for 8 hours.
Warm boots sewn from seal hide lined with thick caribou fur, worn by the Reghed nomads of Icewind Dale. Keeps feet dry and warm in tundra blizzards.
A broad-brimmed felt hat supporting a cylindrical fine copper-mesh veil that drapes over the shoulders. Grants total immunity to insect swarm stings and toxic swamp gnats.
A square cape of heavy flax linen boiled in linseed oil with a drawstring hood. Repels torrential sea squalls and harbor downpours without soaking through.
Ten yards of woven saffron and emerald silk wrapped in royal Calishite fashion. A concealed fold inside the crown holds jewels or a small dagger safely.
A boiled cuir-bouilli cylinder with water-tight wooden cap and shoulder strap. Prevents maps and naval charts from being crushed or creased during travel.
Precision machined brass dividers with needle-sharp steel points. Essential tool for plotting navigational bearings and copying dungeon blueprints accurately.
A slow-drying gum ammoniac adhesive ink. Scribes paint letters on vellum, wait until tacky, and press gold leaf foil onto the text to create royal illuminated manuscripts.
A broad, double-curved steel blade with a camel-bone handle and chased brass scabbard. Standard weapon of honor worn proudly by warriors of Calimport.
A fire-hardened ash spear tipped with razor-sharp mountain flint and bound in white sinew. Forged by Rashemi berserkers for hunting snow wolves in the high steppes.
A thick, crimson tallow candle inscribed with Red Wizard sigils. Burns with a crackling blood-red flame for 4 hours, giving off the faint scent of copper and incense.
Tightly bound bundles of dried fever-flower and wild sage from the Chultan peninsula. Smolders slowly for two hours, repelling poisonous jungle insects and biting midges.
Dense, slow-burning peat cut from the bogs of the Moonshae Isles. Burns with high, steady heat and minimal visible smoke for up to 6 hours.
A sturdy, single-edged utility and combat knife stamped with the roaring purple dragon insignia of Cormyr. Double-quilloned brass pommel doubles as a field hammer.
Spun silver-wound catgut strings tuned to elven octaves, favored by the minstrel colleges of Silverymoon. Produces resonant, crystalline sustain.
Spun from elven silkworms raised on duskwood leaves in Evereska. Billows silently in high mountain winds, shedding rain, snow, and desert dust effortlessly.
Pressed oil from pungent fever-tree nuts harvested in the jungles of Chult. Rubbed over temples and pulse points, grants advantage on saving throws against jungle fevers and malaria for 8 hours.
Short-hafted iron handaxe featuring a reverse curved spike for hooking ship gunwales or cutting rigging nets during boarding skirmishes.
Raw rawhide thong strung with smoked dire wolf teeth and bone beads from the Blackford Road wildlands. A mark of tribal bravery across the northern Savage Frontier.
